definition.en: A widely used Vitis riparia × Vitis rupestris rootstock.
definition.zh: Vitis riparia × Vitis rupestris 杂交砧木，初期生长较快但赋予的长势有限；对干旱敏感，较适合供水充足、较深且少石灰的土壤。其抗根瘤蚜、石灰适应性和生长周期影响应结合具体接穗与场地。

sources.title: Plantgrape, INRAE–IFV–Institut Agro — 101-14 Millardet et de Grasset

definition.en: A Vitis berlandieri × Vitis rupestris rootstock widely associated with drought tolerance and vigor.
definition.zh: 110 Richter 是 Vitis berlandieri × Vitis rupestris 砧木，通常赋予较强长势，耐旱性好，但对土壤积水敏感；可延后生长周期及成熟。石灰适应性与接穗品种有关，不能仅按一个通用阈值选用。

definition.en: Historic Bordeaux classification ranking Médoc red wines, Haut-Brion, and Sauternes/Barsac sweet wines.
definition.zh: 历史性波尔多分级：Médoc 红酒及 Graves 的 Haut-Brion 分 First–Fifth Growth；Sauternes/Barsac 甜白另分 Premier Cru Supérieur、Premier Cru 与 Deuxième Cru。它不作定期重评，但历史上有变更，例如 Mouton Rothschild 于 1973 年晋升。

definition.en: A commonly used grapevine rootstock, also known as Couderc 3309.
definition.zh: Vitis riparia × Vitis rupestris 杂交砧木，通常赋予低至中等长势，初期生长较慢。对突然水分胁迫和水分过多均较敏感，适合较深、少石灰的土壤；表现依接穗、土壤与管理而变。

definition.en: Ordering individual dishes from a menu, with each item priced separately.
definition.zh: 从菜单中分别选择菜肴，每道通常独立标价；与固定组合套餐不同，服务时可帮助客人搭配课程和分量。

examples.en: You may choose the tasting menu or order à la carte.
examples.zh: 您可以选择品鉴套餐，也可以单点菜肴。

definition.en: To complete a task successfully or achieve a result.
definition.zh: 成功完成任务或达成目标。接任务或目标名词，如 accomplish a task、accomplish a goal；不直接接 to do。

examples.en: We accomplished our main task.
examples.zh: 我们完成了主要任务。

definition.en: Acidity contributes sourness and freshness. Titratable acidity measures acid neutralised by titration, whereas pH describes hydrogen-ion activity; the two values are related but not interchangeable.
definition.zh: 酸度带来酸味与清新感。可滴定酸测量滴定中被中和的酸量，pH 表示氢离子活度；两者有关联，但不能互相替代。

examples.en: The wine has bright acidity.
examples.zh: 这款酒的酸度很鲜明。

definition.en: A thick Portuguese bread dish cooked with prawn stock, garlic, coriander and prawns.
definition.zh: 将面包吸入虾高汤后慢慢煮软，与蒜、橄榄油、香菜和虾肉融合，形成浓稠、可用勺舀的面包糊。部分做法最后拌入鸡蛋增加柔润感；口感并非烤面包丁汤。

sources.title: Henrique Sá Pessoa / 24Kitchen — Açorda de Camarão

examples.en: This açorda is made with bread cooked in prawn stock, with prawns and coriander.
examples.zh: 这道 açorda 用虾高汤把面包煮软，再加入虾肉和香菜。

definition.en: Tiny pinched pasta parcels from Piedmont, often filled with cooked meat and vegetables and served with butter or meat juices.
definition.zh: 皮埃蒙特的小型捏褶馅面，plin 体现制作时捏合面皮的动作。常见馅料有熟肉和蔬菜，配黄油或炖肉汁；当地没有唯一固定馅料，点单介绍时应补充本店所用肉类与酱汁。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — agnolotti del plin

examples.en: These agnolotti del plin are filled with braised beef and cabbage.
examples.zh: 这款皮埃蒙特小馅面填的是炖牛肉和卷心菜。

definition.en: A garlic-and-oil sauce; many modern versions also contain egg yolk.
definition.zh: 传统蒜油酱以蒜和油乳化制成，现代版本常加入蛋黄或采用蒜味蛋黄酱；服务时应确认实际配方。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Mediterranean Condiments and Sauces

examples.en: I will check whether our aioli contains egg.
examples.zh: 我会确认我们这款蒜香酱是否含蛋。

zh: 安达卢西亚杏仁蒜味冷汤

definition.en: An Andalusian cold soup made by crushing or blending almonds, garlic and bread with water, olive oil and vinegar until smooth.
definition.zh: 安达卢西亚冷汤，将杏仁、蒜和面包捣碎或搅打，再加入水、橄榄油和醋调成顺滑汤体。它的浅色与浓稠感主要来自杏仁和面包。

examples.en: Ajoblanco is a smooth cold soup with almonds, bread and a noticeable garlic flavour.
examples.zh: 阿霍布兰科是一款以杏仁和面包制成的顺滑冷汤，蒜味较明显。

definition.en: Cooked until tender but still offering a slight firmness when bitten, especially pasta.
definition.zh: 通常形容意面煮熟后仍保留适度咬感，也可用于米饭等；不是要求食材生硬或中心未经适当烹调。

examples.en: We serve the pasta al dente, with a slight bite.
examples.zh: 我们的意面保留适度嚼劲，咬下去略有弹性。

definition.en: Spanish-style seasoned meatballs, commonly browned and then simmered in sauce.
definition.zh: 用调味肉末塑成丸子，常先煎炸定形再放进酱汁慢煮。牛肉与猪肉混合是常见做法，但肉类、黏合材料和酱汁各有版本；服务时应说明本店实际肉馅。

examples.en: Our albóndigas are beef and pork meatballs simmered in a savoury sauce.
examples.zh: 我们的 albóndigas 用牛肉与猪肉制丸，再在咸鲜酱汁中慢煮。

zh: 阿利戈拉丝奶酪土豆泥

definition.en: Mashed potatoes worked with fresh melting cheese and cream into a smooth, stretchy mixture.
definition.zh: 热土豆泥与新鲜可融化奶酪、奶油反复拌合，形成顺滑拉丝质地的奥布拉克风味配菜，常带蒜香。

examples.en: The aligot is a smooth potato-and-cheese mash with a distinctive stretchy texture.
examples.zh: 这道阿利戈是土豆与奶酪拌成的泥，顺滑且有独特拉丝口感。

definition.en: Secondary white grape of Burgundy.
definition.zh: 勃艮第重要白葡萄之一，通常酿成高酸、清新的 varietal white；Bouzeron 是关键独立 appellation。

definition.en: Having an allergic reaction to a particular substance.
definition.zh: 表示对某种物质过敏：be allergic to + 名词。allergy 是名词，allergic 是形容词；接到客人说明后应按餐厅过敏原流程与厨房核实。

examples.en: I’m allergic to nuts.
examples.zh: 我对坚果过敏。

zh: 瑞士高山奶酪土豆通心粉

definition.en: Swiss Alpine pasta with potatoes and cheese, often topped with fried onions and served with apple purée.
definition.zh: 将通心粉、土豆和奶酪煮成柔润的瑞士高山家常菜，常撒炸脆或炒香的洋葱，旁边配苹果泥。土豆与意面同在一盘，是辨认它的要点；苹果泥提供果香和酸甜，通常另放。

sources.title: Emmentaler AOP Switzerland — Emmentaler Alpine macaroni

examples.en: The Alpine macaroni includes potatoes and cheese, with apple purée on the side.
examples.zh: 这道高山通心粉含土豆和奶酪，旁边配苹果泥。

zh: 阿马特里切番茄猪颊肉意面

definition.en: Pasta with a tomato sauce enriched by cured pork cheek and finished with Pecorino cheese.
definition.zh: 意面搭配番茄、风干猪颊肉及佩科里诺奶酪制成的浓味酱汁，常见空心长面或细长面版本，肉味鲜明。

examples.en: The amatriciana combines tomato sauce, cured pork cheek, and Pecorino cheese.
examples.zh: 这道阿马特里切意面结合番茄酱、风干猪颊肉和佩科里诺奶酪。

definition.en: Clams cooked with olive oil and garlic, then finished with coriander and lemon.
definition.zh: 葡萄牙经典蛤蜊菜：以橄榄油和蒜烹煮蛤蜊，再加入香菜及柠檬汁。贝壳中释放的汁液成为鲜美的汤汁；Bulhão Pato 是菜名中的专名，不应按 pato 直译为鸭肉。

sources.title: Turismo de Portugal hotel and tourism schools — Ameijoas à Bulhão Pato, p. 7

examples.en: These clams are cooked with garlic and olive oil, then finished with coriander and lemon.
examples.zh: 这份蛤蜊用蒜和橄榄油烹煮，最后加入香菜和柠檬。

zh: 餐前小点／主厨迎宾小食

definition.en: A small bite offered before the meal, usually chosen by the chef rather than ordered.
definition.zh: 正式菜肴前供应的一口或小份迎宾小食，通常由主厨安排；上菜时仍须介绍主要原料并核对饮食需求。

examples.en: The chef has prepared a small amuse-bouche to begin your meal.
examples.zh: 主厨准备了一份餐前小点，为您开启今晚的用餐。

definition.en: Sparkling method where a single fermentation is completed in bottle after partially fermented wine is bottled.
definition.zh: 在一次发酵尚未结束时装瓶，使剩余发酵在瓶中继续；常见于 Pét-Nat 等风格。

sources.title: WSET · A guide to sparkling wine production methods and regional styles

definition.en: A small fish often cured in salt or oil and used to add savoury depth.
definition.zh: 体型较小的鱼，常以盐渍或油浸形式用于酱汁与调味；即使融入酱汁看不见，仍属于鱼类原料。

examples.en: This dressing contains anchovies; may I check an alternative for you?
examples.zh: 这款沙拉汁含鳀鱼，我为您确认一下其他选择好吗？

definition.en: Central-west Loire subregion important for Chenin Blanc, Cabernet Franc, sweet and sparkling wines.
definition.zh: Loire 风格最复杂区域之一，覆盖 dry/sweet Chenin、Cabernet Franc reds 与 traditional-method sparkling。

definition.en: Appellation d’Origine Contrôlée: the French national recognition protecting an origin-linked product name under an approved specification and controls; AOP is the corresponding EU protection.
definition.zh: Appellation d’Origine Contrôlée：法国对与原产地相联系的产品名称给予的国家级认可，依照核准规范并接受检查；AOP 为相应的欧盟保护。

definition.en: An alcoholic drink served before a meal, often offered while guests consider the menu.
definition.zh: 正式用餐前饮用的酒，服务中常在客人看菜单时提供选择；应询问喜好，不必将它限定为某一种酒。

examples.en: May I offer you an aperitif while you look at the menu?
examples.zh: 您看菜单时，需要来一杯餐前酒吗？

definition.en: An apple-filled pastry roll, commonly made with thinly stretched dough, cinnamon and raisins, then baked. Some versions include buttery breadcrumbs inside.
definition.zh: 将苹果片、肉桂及常见的葡萄干包入拉得很薄的面皮中，卷起后烘烤成苹果卷。有些做法还加入用黄油炒香的面包糠，以吸收果汁。

examples.en: The apple filling is wrapped in thin pastry and baked with cinnamon.
examples.zh: 苹果馅包裹在薄面皮中，与肉桂一起烘烤。

definition.en: A designated name used for a wine’s origin. In a protected appellation system, use of the name depends on geographical origin and compliance with its production specification.
definition.zh: 用于标识葡萄酒来源的名称。在受保护的产区制度下，名称的使用须符合地理来源及相应生产规范。

definition.en: Breaded, deep-fried rice balls or cones, often enclosing cheese, meat ragù, or other fillings.
definition.zh: 将煮好的米饭包入奶酪或肉酱等馅料，裹屑炸至金黄的饭团；形状与馅料有地区差异，应介绍当日版本。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — How to Make Arancini

examples.en: These arancini have a crisp coating and a soft rice centre; I can explain the filling.
examples.zh: 这些炸饭团外层酥脆、米饭内层柔软，我可以为您介绍里面的馅料。

definition.en: Rare authorised Champagne variety.
definition.zh: Champagne 允许的少量传统白葡萄品种之一；种植面积很小，可用于认识主流三品种之外的香槟组成。

definition.en: Rice slowly cooked with milk and sugar into a creamy dessert, often flavoured with cinnamon and citrus peel.
definition.zh: 米与牛奶、糖慢煮到柔滑浓稠，常带肉桂和柠檬皮香气。可撒肉桂粉，也有表面烧糖的版本；这里是西班牙菜单中的甜米布丁，不是咸味烩饭。

examples.en: This rice pudding is creamy, with cinnamon and a gentle lemon aroma.
examples.zh: 这款米布丁口感绵滑，带肉桂和淡淡柠檬香。

definition.en: Portuguese rice cooked with seafood and stock, often served loose and brothy.
definition.zh: 米饭吸收海鲜与高汤的味道，常保留较湿润的汤汁；可用虾、蛤蜊、鱿鱼或其他当日海鲜。与干爽型炒饭不同，海鲜组合和稠度应按本店做法介绍。

sources.title: Chef Telmo Faria / Williams Sonoma — Arroz de Marisco

examples.en: The seafood rice is served slightly brothy, with prawns, clams and squid.
examples.zh: 这道海鲜饭保留少量汤汁，配有虾、蛤蜊和鱿鱼。

definition.en: Rice cooked in duck stock, layered with shredded duck and commonly browned in the oven with sausage.
definition.zh: 先煮鸭取肉及汤，再以鸭汤煮饭，和鸭肉丝组合后入炉烤香。常见表面配 chouriço 或培根，因此不宜只按名称推断全部肉类成分。

sources.title: Chef Paulo Matias / Procatering — Arroz de Pato
Chef José Maria Lino / RTP — Arroz de pato

examples.en: The rice is cooked in duck stock and baked with shredded duck and slices of chouriço.
examples.zh: 米饭用鸭汤煮制，再与鸭肉丝和葡式香肠片一同烤香。

definition.en: Spanish rice cooked with squid or cuttlefish, seafood stock and ink.
definition.zh: 以鱿鱼或墨鱼、鱼或海鲜高汤及墨汁烹制的西班牙米饭，墨汁使米粒呈深黑色并带海鲜鲜味。常以洋葱、蒜和番茄起底；这是米饭菜肴，与墨汁意面不同。

examples.en: The arroz negro gets its dark colour from squid ink.
examples.zh: 这道墨汁海鲜饭的深色来自鱿鱼墨汁。

definition.en: A vegetable whose immature flower head provides tender edible bases and a central heart.
definition.zh: 通常指球形洋蓟的未开花花蕾，可食部分包括嫩的苞片基部及中心；与菊芋是不同食材。

examples.en: The salad includes marinated artichoke hearts.
examples.zh: 这道沙拉里有腌渍洋蓟心。

definition.en: Prosecco DOCG centered on the Asolo hills.
definition.zh: Prosecco 的另一 DOCG 产区节点，与 Conegliano Valdobbiadene 分开学习。

sources.title: Consorzio Asolo Montello · Asolo Prosecco DOCG

definition.en: A vegetable served as slender spears with tender tips. Green and white varieties appear on menus, often grilled, blanched or paired with eggs and butter-based sauces.
definition.zh: 以嫩茎和笋尖食用的蔬菜，菜单上常见绿芦笋与白芦笋。可焯、烤或煎制，适合作前菜或主菜配菜，也常搭配鸡蛋与荷兰酱；介绍时可说明品种和熟后是否保留脆感。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook asparagus

examples.en: Our green asparagus is grilled and served with hollandaise on the side.
examples.zh: 我们的绿芦笋采用烤制，荷兰酱另放在旁边。

definition.en: The compass orientation of a slope or vineyard surface.
definition.zh: 葡萄园坡面相对于太阳和主导风向的朝向，会影响光照、热量积累、蒸散和成熟节奏。

sources.title: NC State Extension — Vineyard site selection and aspect

definition.en: Blending component wines, varieties or lots to create the final wine.
definition.zh: 波尔多核心工艺与风格逻辑之一，用来组合不同品种、地块、成熟度与结构特征。

sources.title: CIVB — The Art of the Blend

definition.en: Piemonte DOCG associated with aromatic Moscato-based wines, including Asti sparkling styles.
definition.zh: 意大利 Piemonte 的 DOCG，以 Moscato Bianco 芳香型酒著名；Asti 起泡酒并非只可为甜型，也有较干风格。2026 年已正式加入 Moscato 与 Brachetto 混酿的 Rosé 类型。传统甜型常以受控、提前停止的罐内发酵保留葡萄糖分。

sources.title: Consorzio Asti DOCG · La dolce valle
Consorzio Asti DOCG · Benvenuto Asti Rosé
Gazzetta Ufficiale · Asti specification amendment, 23 March 2026

definition.en: The British English name for eggplant, a vegetable used in roasting, grilling, and stewing.
definition.zh: 英式英语中对茄子的称呼，美式英语通常说 eggplant；菜单需结合烧烤、炖煮等做法向客人解释。

examples.en: The aubergine is roasted and served with a tomato sauce.
examples.zh: 这道茄子经过烘烤，配以番茄酱汁。

definition.en: Breakdown of dead yeast cells during lees ageing.
definition.zh: 酵母细胞死亡后逐渐自我分解，释放成分，影响酒的香气与口感。Champagne 的酒泥熟成包含这一过程；不能仅凭面包香就断定某种唯一酿造工艺。

definition.en: Ready or free to be used, supplied or booked.
definition.zh: 能够提供、使用或预订。桌位、客房与酒款均可用 available 描述。

examples.en: Is a table available at seven?
examples.zh: 七点有空桌吗？

zh: 巴斯克蒜香乳化汁鳕鱼

definition.en: A Basque salt-cod dish, made after desalting the fish, gently cooking it in garlic-flavoured olive oil and emulsifying the oil with the fish juices into a sauce.
definition.zh: 巴斯克风味盐渍鳕鱼：鱼肉先浸泡脱盐，再在蒜香橄榄油中轻柔加热，通过摇动锅具等方式，让鱼汁与油乳化成浓滑酱汁。

sources.title: Basque Government Tourism — Bacalao al Pil Pil

examples.en: The cod is gently cooked and served with a smooth garlic-and-olive-oil sauce.
examples.zh: 鳕鱼经过轻柔烹煮，搭配细滑的蒜香橄榄油酱汁。

definition.en: Flaked salt cod combined with fine fried potato strips, onions and softly set eggs.
definition.zh: 将浸泡脱盐的盐渍鳕鱼拆散，与洋葱、炸细薯丝及鸡蛋拌炒；鸡蛋将食材裹合成柔软口感。菜单常保留葡语名称，不能仅译成烤鳕鱼。

sources.title: Chef José Avillez / RTP — Bacalhau à Brás

examples.en: Bacalhau à Brás combines flaked salt cod, crisp potato strips and soft eggs.
examples.zh: 这道葡式鳕鱼薯丝炒蛋把鳕鱼碎、酥脆细薯丝与柔软鸡蛋结合在一起。

zh: 戈梅斯式鳕鱼土豆烤盘

definition.en: A Portuguese baked dish of salt cod, sliced potatoes and onions, commonly finished with boiled eggs and olives.
definition.zh: 脱盐鳕鱼与土豆片、炒软的洋葱组合后入炉，常配水煮蛋片、橄榄及欧芹。与 à Brás 的薯丝炒蛋不同，这道菜以较完整的土豆片和分层烤制见长。

sources.title: Chef Luís Machado / RTP — Bacalhau à Gomes de Sá

examples.en: The cod is baked with sliced potatoes and onions, then finished with egg and olives.
examples.zh: 鳕鱼与土豆片、洋葱一同烤制，再配上鸡蛋和橄榄。

definition.en: Flaked salt cod baked with potatoes, onions and a creamy sauce.
definition.zh: 将脱盐鳕鱼拆成鱼肉片或碎块，与洋葱、土豆和奶油酱组合后入炉焗烤。内里柔润、表面可烤成金黄；区别于鳕鱼薯丝炒蛋，这道菜的重点是奶油酱和烤制。

examples.en: Bacalhau com natas is a creamy bake of salt cod, potatoes and onions.
examples.zh: 这道葡式奶油焗鳕鱼由盐渍鳕鱼、土豆和洋葱一起焗制，口感柔润。

definition.en: Cooked preserved cod whipped with oil into a light spread, traditionally served with polenta.
definition.zh: 把泡发并煮熟的鳕鱼与油逐渐搅打成蓬松鱼泥，常配软玉米糊或烤玉米糕。威尼斯传统所说的 baccalà 可指未盐腌的风干鳕鱼 stockfish；其他做法也会用盐鳕鱼或牛奶，不能把 creamy 自动理解成加了奶油。

sources.title: Dogale Confraternita del Baccalà Mantecato — The Original Recipe

examples.en: The baccalà mantecato is a light whipped cod spread served with grilled polenta.
examples.zh: 这道威尼斯鳕鱼泥口感蓬松，搭配烤玉米糕。

zh: 皮埃蒙特蒜香凤尾鱼暖蘸酱

definition.en: A warm Piedmontese anchovy, garlic and oil dip, served with vegetables.
definition.zh: 皮埃蒙特将凤尾鱼、蒜和油慢慢加热成温热蘸酱，配生蔬菜或熟蔬菜食用；有的配方加入黄油或用牛奶处理蒜。它虽然配蔬菜，酱里却有鱼类成分，介绍时要明确。

examples.en: The vegetables come with a warm garlic and anchovy dip called bagna cauda.
examples.zh: 蔬菜配的是温热蒜香凤尾鱼蘸酱，叫 bagna cauda。

definition.en: Thin pastry layers baked with chopped nuts and butter, then soaked with sweet syrup.
definition.zh: 多层薄如纸的 phyllo 面皮夹碎果仁、刷黄油烤酥后浇糖浆。希腊常见核桃与香料版本，其他地区及餐厅可使用不同果仁；这是一种跨地区甜点。

examples.en: This baklava has crisp layers of pastry, chopped walnuts and an aromatic syrup.
examples.zh: 这款 baklava 有酥脆薄皮、碎核桃和带香气的糖浆。

definition.en: Cooked sausages served over mashed potatoes, often finished with onion gravy.
definition.zh: 将煎烤熟的香肠放在土豆泥上，常配带甜香的洋葱肉汁。Bangers 是英式口语中的香肠，mash 在这里指 mashed potatoes。入口有香肠的肉香、柔滑土豆泥与浓汁，适合练习解释菜单里的口语名称。

sources.title: Gordon Ramsay — Bangers & Mash in 10 Minutes

examples.en: Bangers and mash is our sausage dish with mashed potatoes and onion gravy.
examples.zh: Bangers and mash 就是我们的香肠配土豆泥和洋葱肉汁。

definition.en: A sweet pie combining a crisp base, soft toffee or caramel, bananas and whipped cream.
definition.zh: 在酥脆饼底上叠放柔软的太妃糖或焦糖馅、香蕉片和打发奶油的甜派。奶油的轻盈、香蕉的柔软和焦糖的甜香形成层次。名称 banoffee 把 banana 与 toffee 连在一起，能帮助记住它的核心组合。

examples.en: The banoffee pie combines banana, soft caramel and whipped cream.
examples.zh: 香蕉太妃派把香蕉、软焦糖和打发奶油组合在一起。

definition.en: Traditional Bordeaux barrel, commonly around 225 liters.
definition.zh: 顶级波尔多红白酒 élevage 的重要容器节点；需结合 new oak proportion、toast 与 oxygen exchange 理解。

definition.en: Sweet-wine appellation within the Sauternes zone whose wines may use Barsac or Sauternes designation.
definition.zh: 与 Sauternes 一起学习，需连接 limestone-rich soils、botrytis 与 1855 sweet classification。

definition.en: Supported or developed using particular facts, ideas or evidence.
definition.zh: 以某些事实、想法或证据为基础。常用 be based on + 名词。

examples.en: My conclusion is based on the evidence.
examples.zh: 我的结论基于这些证据。

definition.en: To spoon or pour fat, cooking juices or another liquid over food during cooking, often over meat in a pan or oven.
definition.zh: 在烹调过程中把热油脂、肉汁或其他液体反复淋到食物表面，常见于煎肉和烤禽。butter-basted 表示以黄油淋浇；这与上桌后才浇酱的动作不同。

examples.en: We baste the steak with butter and thyme while it cooks.
examples.zh: 煎制牛排时，我们会反复淋上黄油和百里香汁。

definition.en: Stirring the lees in a vessel.
definition.zh: 搅动酒泥以增加其与酒液接触，可影响口感、香气、还原/氧化平衡和营养物质释放。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: An aromatic leaf used to infuse soups, stocks, stews and sauces. Often included in a bouquet garni, it contributes herbal depth during cooking rather than a fresh garnish.
definition.zh: 用于熬煮时浸出香气的调味叶，常加入汤底、炖菜和酱汁，也常放在香草束中。它提供的是缓慢释放的草本层次；向客人解释菜肴风味时，可说明它参与了汤汁的熬制。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Bay leaf recipes

examples.en: The stew is slowly cooked with bay leaf for a deeper herbal flavour.
examples.zh: 这道炖菜加入月桂叶慢煮，让草本风味更有层次。

definition.en: A warm butter-and-egg emulsion flavoured with a vinegar reduction and herbs, especially tarragon.
definition.zh: 温热的蛋黄黄油乳化酱，以醋、红葱头及龙蒿等调味，常配牛排；香草风味是其辨识重点。

examples.en: The steak comes with béarnaise, a buttery sauce with tarragon.
examples.zh: 这道牛排配贝亚恩酱，是带有龙蒿香气的黄油酱。

definition.en: Southern wine region historically linked with Burgundy and centered on Gamay.
definition.zh: 当前官方体系有 12 appellations：Beaujolais、Beaujolais Villages 与 10 Crus；Gamay 为核心。

definition.en: Early-release Beaujolais wine sold shortly after harvest under specific rules.
definition.zh: 新酒是 Beaujolais 的一部分，不代表全部产区风格；Cru Beaujolais 与 Nouveau 需要彻底分开学习。

definition.en: Appellation covering designated villages largely in the northern Beaujolais zone.
definition.zh: 介于 regional Beaujolais 与 10 Crus 之间；官方资料现列 38 个 villages。

definition.en: A milk-based white sauce thickened with a cooked mixture of butter and flour.
definition.zh: 以牛奶和黄油面粉糊制成的基础白酱，常用于焗烤或千层面；不能仅凭白色外观判断酱汁种类。

sources.title: Escoffier — How to Make the 5 Mother Sauces

examples.en: The lasagne is layered with béchamel and meat ragù.
examples.zh: 这道千层面分层加入了贝夏梅尔白酱和肉酱。

definition.en: Beef fillet coated with a cooked mushroom mixture, wrapped in puff pastry and baked. Additional layers, such as pâté, depend on the recipe.
definition.zh: 将牛菲力裹上炒熟的蘑菇碎馅，再包进酥皮烤制。部分配方会增加肉酱等夹层；切开后可见牛肉、馅料及酥皮的层次。

examples.en: The beef fillet is wrapped with mushrooms in golden puff pastry.
examples.zh: 牛菲力与蘑菇馅一起包裹在金黄酥皮中。

definition.en: A compact head of pale, slightly bitter chicory leaves, also called witloof. Its leaves can be served raw, while whole heads are often braised or baked.
definition.zh: 叶片紧密包合、颜色乳白至淡黄的菊苣，称 witloof，带有清爽苦味。可拆叶生食，也可整颗焖煮或焗烤；英语 endive 与 chicory 的用法因地区而异，不能都视为这一种。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Salad leaf variety guide

examples.en: The Belgian endive is braised until tender, with a pleasant bitter edge.
examples.zh: 这道比利时菊苣焖煮至软嫩，仍保留一点清爽的苦味。

aliases: berenjenas fritas con miel de caña

definition.en: Fried aubergine finished with dark cane syrup for a sweet and savoury contrast.
definition.zh: 将茄子切条炸香，淋上颜色较深的甘蔗糖浆。Miel de caña 字面带“蜜”，这里是甘蔗糖浆，并非蜂蜜；若菜单只写 con miel，应向厨房核对所用甜味料。

sources.title: Real Academia de Gastronomía — Berenjenas fritas
Spain.info — Andalusian fried aubergines with cane syrup

examples.en: The fried aubergine is drizzled with cane syrup, giving it a sweet and savoury finish.
examples.zh: 炸茄子淋有甘蔗糖浆，带出甜咸交织的口感。

definition.en: An emulsified butter sauce built on a reduced mixture of white wine, vinegar, and shallots.
definition.zh: 白葡萄酒、醋和红葱头先收汁，再逐步拌入黄油形成乳化酱，常配鱼类；经典做法不靠蛋黄乳化。

examples.en: The fish comes with beurre blanc, a tangy butter sauce.
examples.zh: 这道鱼配白黄油酱，是略带酸味的黄油酱汁。

definition.en: A Portuguese sandwich of thin pork slices cooked with seasoning and served in a bread roll.
definition.zh: 将薄猪肉片腌味后煎煮，夹入小面包，常带蒜香和肉汁。不同地区在切片厚度、辣度、酱汁及是否使用啤酒上有差别；这里按菜单中的三明治含义解释。

sources.title: Teleculinária — Bifanas à moda de Vendas Novas

examples.en: The bifana is a warm bread roll filled with thin slices of seasoned pork.
examples.zh: Bifana 是热面包夹薄切调味猪肉。

definition.en: A Swiss cold oat dish with grated apple, milk or yoghurt and nuts.
definition.zh: 瑞士经典冷食燕麦，先将燕麦浸软，再拌入磨碎的苹果、乳制品和坚果等。早期做法使用炼乳及柠檬汁，现代常换成牛奶或酸奶；口感柔软湿润，适合早餐或早午餐，不是烘烤成脆块的格兰诺拉。

sources.title: Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs — Muesli: the world-famous Swiss breakfast classic

examples.en: Our Bircher muesli is a cold oat dish with grated apple and yoghurt.
examples.zh: 我们的 Bircher 燕麦是冷食，拌有磨碎的苹果和酸奶。

definition.en: A smooth, concentrated lobster soup built from a shell-based stock, often finished with cream.
definition.zh: 先用龙虾壳与香味蔬菜熬出汤底，再过滤、调浓并常以奶油收尾的细滑浓汤。龙虾香气可以主要来自虾壳；是否另放龙虾肉、如何增稠，要以实际菜谱说明，不能只凭菜名保证。

sources.title: Gordon Ramsay Restaurants — Lobster and Cornish Crab Bisque

examples.en: The bisque gets its deep flavour from lobster shells and is finished with cream.
examples.zh: 这道浓汤以龙虾壳熬出浓郁风味，最后加入奶油。

zh: 佛罗伦萨式带骨厚牛排

definition.en: A thick, large bone-in beef steak grilled over high heat, traditionally served with a rare centre.
definition.zh: 大块带骨厚切牛排以高温烤制，经典呈现保留较生的中心；服务时应说明重量、分享人数及厨房可提供的熟度。

examples.en: The Florentine steak is a thick bone-in cut; let me explain its size and cooking style.
examples.zh: 佛罗伦萨牛排是厚切带骨牛排，我为您说明分量和烹调方式。

definition.en: Loire terroir concept for dark schist/slate-based Massif Armoricain geology.
definition.zh: 指 Anjou 西部/旧岩体系的深色片岩、板岩等，和 White Anjou 的 chalky limestone 对照。

sources.title: InterLoire · Climate and geology of Loire wines

definition.en: A layered cake of chocolate sponge, cherries and whipped cream, traditionally flavoured with kirsch.
definition.zh: 德国黑森林樱桃蛋糕，常以巧克力海绵蛋糕、樱桃和打发奶油层叠而成，表面饰巧克力屑。经典做法用樱桃蒸馏酒 kirsch 浸润蛋糕层；介绍时应说明樱桃和奶油的层次，而非只说巧克力蛋糕。

sources.title: Chef Alfred Boch / Hochschwarzwald Tourism — Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte

examples.en: The Black Forest cake has layers of chocolate sponge, cherries and whipped cream.
examples.zh: 这款黑森林蛋糕层叠了巧克力海绵蛋糕、樱桃和打发奶油。

definition.en: White wine made from white grapes; in Champagne, most often Chardonnay.
definition.zh: Blanc de Blancs 指以白葡萄酿成的白葡萄酒。Champagne 中最常见为 Chardonnay，但这个词本身不保证 100% Chardonnay，也不只用于香槟。

sources.title: Comité Champagne · Understanding the Champagne label

definition.en: White wine made from black-skinned grapes; in Champagne, chiefly Pinot Noir and/or Meunier.
definition.zh: Blanc de Noirs 指用黑皮葡萄酿成的白葡萄酒。在 Champagne 中通常是 Pinot Noir 和／或 Meunier；温和压榨并减少果皮接触，避免大量提取颜色。

sources.title: Comité Champagne · Understanding the Champagne label

definition.en: To cook briefly in boiling water, often followed by rapid cooling to stop further cooking.
definition.zh: 食材在沸水中短时间加热，之后常迅速冷却以停止继续受热；用于初步熟化、去皮或后续烹调准备。

sources.title: Iowa State University — Methods of Preparation

examples.en: The beans are blanched before being finished in the pan.
examples.zh: 这些豆角先焯水，再下锅完成最后烹调。

definition.en: Veal gently simmered in broth, then served in a pale, creamy sauce made from its cooking liquid.
definition.zh: 小牛肉在芳香高汤中温煮，再用煮肉汁制成浅色奶油酱，强调肉质柔嫩与酱汁顺滑，常配米饭。

sources.title: Paul Bocuse / Académie du Goût — Blanquette de Veau à l’Ancienne

examples.en: The blanquette is tender veal in a smooth, pale cream sauce.
examples.zh: 这道白汁炖小牛肉肉质柔嫩，裹着顺滑的浅色奶油酱。

definition.en: A sandwich named for its three main fillings: bacon, lettuce and tomato.
definition.zh: BLT 是 bacon、lettuce、tomato 的首字母，即培根、生菜和番茄三种主要馅料。常配蛋黄酱夹在面包中，培根的咸香、叶菜的脆感和番茄的多汁形成对比。介绍时把缩写展开，客人就容易理解。

sources.title: GBC Kitchen / Great British Chefs — Ultimate BLT Sandwich

examples.en: BLT stands for bacon, lettuce and tomato; it comes with mayonnaise.
examples.zh: BLT 指培根、生菜和番茄，这份还配蛋黄酱。

definition.en: A paper or digital document used when boarding a flight.
definition.zh: 登机时使用的纸质或电子凭证，与护照 passport 不同。

examples.en: May I see your boarding pass?
examples.zh: 可以看一下您的登机牌吗？

definition.en: A slow-cooked beef dish with generous carrots, onions, herbs and stock, often with wine in the braising liquid.
definition.zh: 以适合慢煮的牛肉部位，搭配较多胡萝卜、洋葱、香草及高汤，焖至肉质软嫩、胡萝卜甜味融入酱汁。不同厨师可用白葡萄酒或红葡萄酒烹调，菜名重点在牛肉与胡萝卜的组合。

sources.title: Alain Ducasse / Académie du Goût — Bœuf aux carottes

examples.en: The beef is slowly braised with carrots and herbs until tender.
examples.zh: 牛肉与胡萝卜、香草一起慢焖至软嫩。

definition.en: Beef slowly braised in red wine with aromatic vegetables, often with bacon and other garnishes.
definition.zh: 牛肉与红葡萄酒、洋葱、胡萝卜等慢炖至软嫩的浓汁菜，常加入烟肉；蘑菇、小洋葱等配料依版本而异。

sources.title: France.fr — Bœuf Bourguignon by Thomas Dossi

examples.en: The beef bourguignon is gently braised in red wine until the meat is tender.
examples.zh: 这道勃艮第炖牛肉用红葡萄酒温和慢炖至肉质软嫩。

definition.en: An assortment of meats gently simmered until tender, sliced and served with condiments such as salsa verde or mostarda.
definition.zh: 将不同部位或种类的肉以小火清煮至软嫩，再切片组合上桌。可包含牛肉、牛舌、禽肉或意式猪肉肠，搭配意式香草绿酱或芥末水果酱；misto 表示混合拼盘。

sources.title: Chef Leonardo De Paoli / La Cucina Italiana — Bollito misto

examples.en: The bollito misto is a selection of gently simmered meats, with the sauces served alongside.
examples.zh: 这道清煮肉类拼盘包含几种慢煮肉类，酱料另外奉上。

definition.en: A slowly cooked meat ragù associated with Bologna, commonly served with pasta such as tagliatelle.
definition.zh: 源自博洛尼亚的慢煮肉酱，以肉类为主体并配蔬菜等原料，常搭配宽面；不只是加入碎肉的番茄汁。

examples.en: The tagliatelle is served with a slowly cooked bolognese ragù.
examples.zh: 这道宽面配慢火熬制的博洛尼亚肉酱。

definition.en: High-quality sweet Chenin Blanc appellation within the Layon area.
definition.zh: Loire 经典甜白 AOP，常以 botrytis / tries / high acidity 为核心。

definition.en: Anchovy fillets marinated in vinegar and served with olive oil, garlic and parsley.
definition.zh: 鲜凤尾鱼去骨取鱼柳后作醋渍冷盘，常配橄榄油、蒜及欧芹。与深色、重咸的盐渍凤尾鱼是不同制法；也不是高温煮熟的鱼。

sources.title: Real Academia de Gastronomía — Boquerones en vinagre

examples.en: These anchovy fillets are vinegar-marinated and served cold with garlic and parsley.
examples.zh: 这些凤尾鱼柳用醋腌渍，配蒜和欧芹冷食。

definition.en: Major wine region in southwest France centered on the Garonne, Dordogne and Gironde estuary.
definition.zh: 波尔多是法国西南部大型葡萄酒产区，核心空间逻辑由 Garonne、Dordogne 与 Gironde 水系，以及 Left Bank / Right Bank / Entre-Deux-Mers 构成。

sources.title: CIVB — Bordeaux wine regions and appellations
Bordeaux Tourism and Convention Bureau — Bordeaux Métropole, Garonne/Dordogne confluence

definition.en: Regional Bordeaux appellation covering multiple wine colors and styles.
definition.zh: 区域级基础产区，可生产多种颜色与风格，是理解波尔多 appellation hierarchy 的底层节点。

sources.title: CIVB — Bordeaux, Bordeaux Supérieur and Crémant

definition.en: Traditional copper sulfate and lime-based fungicidal mixture.
definition.zh: 以硫酸铜和石灰配制的传统保护性杀菌剂，历史上用于葡萄园霜霉等病害防治；有助于理解湿润气候下的病害压力。

sources.title: University of California IPM — Bordeaux Mixture

definition.en: Regional Bordeaux appellation with stricter production requirements than basic Bordeaux for qualifying wines.
definition.zh: 区域级但要求高于普通 Bordeaux AOP；学习时重点理解其与具体 commune appellation 的区别。

definition.en: Fungus capable of causing noble rot under suitable conditions or destructive grey rot under others.
definition.zh: 在 Sauternes/Barsac 特定秋季湿度与干燥循环下可形成 noble rot；条件不佳则可能造成 grey rot。

definition.en: An individual puff-pastry case filled with a creamy savoury mixture, often featuring poultry, mushrooms or veal sweetbreads.
definition.zh: 一人份的圆形酥皮盅，装入奶油风味的咸馅，常见配料有鸡肉、蘑菇或小牛胸腺，顶部可盖回小酥皮盖。酱汁常以禽类高汤和油面糊为基础，再加入奶油；点餐时应说明本店实际馅料。

sources.title: Chef Philippe / Meilleur du Chef — Bouchées à la reine

examples.en: Our bouchée à la reine is a puff-pastry case filled with chicken and mushrooms in a creamy sauce.
examples.zh: 我们的酥皮盅装入鸡肉和蘑菇，配浓滑的奶油酱汁。

zh: 马赛鱼汤／普罗旺斯炖鱼汤

definition.en: A fish soup or stew associated with Marseille, traditionally featuring several Mediterranean fish.
definition.zh: 与马赛相关的地中海鱼类汤菜，传统上使用多种鱼，常配面包和鲁伊酱；具体鱼种和上菜方式各有版本。

examples.en: Let me explain today’s fish selection for the bouillabaisse.
examples.zh: 我为您介绍一下今天这道马赛鱼汤使用的鱼类。

definition.en: Cabernet Franc appellation in Touraine.
definition.zh: Touraine 重要 Cabernet Franc 产区，砂砾与石灰岩地形差异明显。

sources.title: InterLoire · Climate and geology of Loire wines

definition.en: Côte Chalonnaise appellation dedicated to Aligoté.
definition.zh: Aligoté 的核心独立 AOC，是勃艮第非 Chardonnay 白葡萄酒的重要节点。

definition.en: To cook food gently with a small amount of liquid in a covered vessel.
definition.zh: 将食材放在加盖容器内，以少量液体缓慢烹煮，肉类常先煎上色；适合解释软嫩慢炖类菜肴。

examples.en: The beef cheeks are braised until tender.
examples.zh: 这道牛脸颊肉经过慢炖，口感软嫩。

definition.en: Desalted salt cod worked with olive oil into a creamy preparation, with dairy or other additions depending on the recipe.
definition.zh: 把盐渍鳕鱼浸泡脱盐、煮熟后，与橄榄油搅拌成绵滑鱼泥；可加入蒜、奶油等调整风味和质地。它是熟鱼制品，不是生鱼泥，也不能仅因外观细白就当作普通土豆泥。

sources.title: Jeremy Lee / Great British Chefs — Brandade de morue

examples.en: The brandade is made from salt cod blended with olive oil; this version also contains cream.
examples.zh: 这道鱼泥由盐鳕鱼与橄榄油搅拌而成，这个版本也含奶油。

definition.en: Beef slowly braised with Barolo wine and aromatic vegetables, then sliced and served with its rich cooking sauce.
definition.zh: 把牛肉与巴罗洛红葡萄酒及芳香蔬菜慢慢焖至软嫩，切片后淋上浓郁的烹调酱汁，常配玉米糊等吸收酱汁的主食。Brasato 提示的是焖煮方式，Barolo 则是这道菜使用的烹调酒。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — Brasato al Barolo

examples.en: The beef is braised in Barolo wine and served with creamy polenta.
examples.zh: 牛肉用巴罗洛红酒焖制，配柔滑的玉米糊。

definition.en: Buttered bread baked in an egg-and-milk custard, often with dried fruit.
definition.zh: 把抹黄油的面包铺入烤盘，加入鸡蛋与奶制品调成的蛋奶液，烤至凝固；常夹葡萄干等干果。面包可用吐司、布里欧修等，因此口感和配料会有变化。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Bread and Butter Pudding
Great British Chefs — Bread and Butter Pudding Recipes

examples.en: The bread and butter pudding has soft custard-soaked bread and a golden top.
examples.zh: 黄油面包布丁内部是吸收蛋奶液的柔软面包，表面烤至金黄。

definition.en: Small pieces of bread used in cooking, often dried. They can form a crisp coating on meat or fish, add texture to toppings or help bind fillings.
definition.zh: 把面包加工成的碎屑，烹饪中常使用干燥版本，可裹在肉或鱼外形成脆壳，也可撒在表面增加口感或帮助馅料结合。Panko 是其中一种风格，不能与所有面包屑直接画等号。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to crumb meat or fish
Great British Chefs — How to cook with panko breadcrumbs

examples.en: The fish has a breadcrumb coating, which becomes crisp when fried.
examples.zh: 鱼肉外面裹了面包屑，炸后形成酥脆外层。

definition.en: Having a salty, seawater-like impression; often used to describe oysters and other seafood or brined ingredients.
definition.zh: 带有类似海水或盐水的咸鲜感觉，常用来介绍生蚝、贝类或盐渍食材。重点是盐水般的咸味印象，不是腥味，也不能与 umami 所说的鲜味直接画等号。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — native oyster gratin

examples.en: These oysters have a briny flavour with a gentle sweetness.
examples.zh: 这些生蚝有海水般的咸鲜味，同时带一点柔和的甜味。

definition.en: In common US kitchen usage, to cook or brown food close beneath intense direct heat; often called grilling in British English.
definition.zh: 美式厨房常指把食物放在强烈上方热源下炙烤，使其烹熟或表面上色；英式英语常用 grill 表达这种做法。介绍菜单时说明热源和处理方式，避免与炭火烧烤混淆。

examples.en: The salmon is broiled under high heat and served with lemon butter.
examples.zh: 这份三文鱼用强烈上火炙烤，配柠檬黄油。

definition.en: A Beaujolais cru around the foot of Mont Brouilly, distinct from Côte de Brouilly.
definition.zh: 围绕 Mont Brouilly 的广泛 cru 区，与 Côte de Brouilly 是两个独立 AOC。

definition.en: Toasted bread rubbed with garlic and topped with tomatoes, basil, and olive oil.
definition.zh: 烤脆的面包擦上蒜香，再铺番茄、罗勒并淋橄榄油，是常见意式开胃小食；番茄是这一具体版本的配料。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — How to Make Bruschetta

examples.en: The tomato bruschetta combines crisp toast with fresh tomatoes, basil, and olive oil.
examples.zh: 这道番茄烤面包结合了脆面包、鲜番茄、罗勒和橄榄油。

definition.en: A light rectangular Belgian waffle with a crisp exterior and an airy centre.
definition.zh: 通常呈长方形，外层酥脆、内部松软轻盈的比利时华夫饼。面糊可借打发蛋白和发酵获得空气感，常撒糖粉或另加水果、奶油等配料；与面团中带珍珠糖的列日华夫饼不同。

sources.title: Visit Brussels — Everything you need to know about waffles in Brussels

examples.en: Would you like your Brussels waffle with just icing sugar or with an extra topping?
examples.zh: 您的布鲁塞尔华夫饼要只撒糖粉，还是另外加配料？

definition.en: Sparkling-wine sweetness term for sugar content below 12 g/L.
definition.zh: Brut 是起泡酒甜度术语，也适用于 Champagne。欧盟标示标准为含糖量低于 12 g/L；这是最终含糖量，不是直接加入糖的数量。

definition.en: Sparkling-wine sweetness term: below 3 g/L, with no sugar added after secondary fermentation.
definition.zh: 欧盟起泡酒甜度术语：最终含糖量低于 3 g/L，并且二次发酵后没有添加糖。允许二次发酵前的 tirage 用糖；不能简单解释为“酿造全程无糖”。

definition.en: The stage when a dormant bud opens and new leaf tissue becomes visible; it marks the resumption of shoot growth.
definition.zh: 休眠芽展开、可见新生叶片组织的阶段，标志新梢恢复生长。

sources.title: New Mexico State University — Grapevine Growth and Phenology

definition.en: Chicken wings coated in a tangy hot-sauce-and-butter mixture.
definition.zh: 鸡翅烹熟后裹上辣椒酱与黄油调成的酸辣酱汁，常配西芹和蓝纹奶酪蘸酱。Buffalo 在此是美国城市名称，不表示水牛肉；辣度与炸烤方式可因餐厅而异。

examples.en: The Buffalo wings are tangy and spicy, with a blue-cheese dip on the side.
examples.zh: 水牛城鸡翅带酸辣风味，旁边配蓝纹奶酪蘸酱。

definition.en: Historic French wine region structured around a hierarchy of precisely delimited places.
definition.zh: 勃艮第的核心不是单一“产区风格”，而是从区域、村庄、Premier Cru Climat 到 Grand Cru AOC 的地点层级。

definition.en: A fresh cheese with a mozzarella shell enclosing a soft filling of cream and cheese strands.
definition.zh: 外层是马苏里拉乳酪，内包乳酪丝与奶油的鲜乳酪，切开后馅心柔软流动；与整球马苏里拉不同。

examples.en: The burrata has a creamy centre and is served with tomatoes.
examples.zh: 这款布拉塔有柔软的奶油乳酪内馅，搭配番茄供应。

definition.en: Fluffy griddle pancakes made with buttermilk, often served with butter and maple syrup.
definition.zh: 用酪乳加入面粉和鸡蛋面糊，再用泡打粉、小苏打等膨松剂做成的厚松饼。面糊倒在热铁板或平底锅上煎成两面金黄，内部松软，酪乳带轻微酸香；常叠放并配黄油和枫糖浆。

sources.title: Charlotte Rutledge / King Arthur Baking — Buttermilk Pancakes

examples.en: The buttermilk pancakes come in a stack with butter and maple syrup.
examples.zh: 酪乳松饼叠放上桌，配黄油和枫糖浆。

definition.en: Having a noticeable butter-like flavour or containing generous butter; useful for pastry, sauces and vegetables.
definition.zh: 带明显黄油香味，或形容制作时用了较多黄油的食物，常用于酥皮、酱汁和配菜。作为感官描述时只说明风味，确认实际用料仍应查看菜品配方。

examples.en: The potatoes have a buttery flavour and are finished with parsley.
examples.zh: 这份土豆带有黄油香味，最后加入了欧芹。

definition.en: Sold as an individual glass rather than requiring the guest to purchase a full bottle.
definition.zh: 葡萄酒等按单杯而非整瓶售卖的方式，适合不同课程或偏好的选择；服务时应说明酒款、杯量和价格。

sources.title: WSET — How to Read a Wine List in a Restaurant or Bar

examples.en: This Riesling is available by the glass as well as by the bottle.
examples.zh: 这款雷司令可以按杯点，也可以按瓶点。

definition.en: A black grape central to Loire red wines and important in Bordeaux blends, especially on the Right Bank.
definition.zh: Cabernet Franc 是 Chinon、Bourgueil、Saumur-Champigny 等卢瓦尔红酒的核心品种，在波尔多右岸也很重要；常表现红色水果、花香、草本与清新结构。卢瓦尔当地也称 Breton。

sources.title: CIVB — The Art of the Blend

definition.en: Late-ripening black grape central to many Left Bank Bordeaux blends.
definition.zh: 在波尔多左岸常提供结构、单宁、黑色水果、耐久性；偏好排水良好且较温暖的 gravel sites。

sources.title: CIVB — The Art of the Blend

definition.en: A hearty Tuscan fish-and-seafood stew, commonly tomato-based and served with garlic-rubbed toast.
definition.zh: 托斯卡纳沿海的浓炖鱼汤，以利沃诺风格尤为常见，通常加入番茄，按不同烹调时间下入鱼、头足类和其他海鲜，配擦蒜烤面包。所用渔获与配方会变化，介绍时要说清当天海鲜，不能承诺固定鱼种或无刺。

examples.en: The cacciucco is a rich seafood stew served over garlic-rubbed toast; I can explain today’s fish selection.
examples.zh: 这道浓炖海鲜汤配擦蒜烤面包；我可以为您介绍今天使用的鱼类。

definition.en: Pasta coated in a sauce formed from Pecorino Romano, black pepper, and starchy cooking water.
definition.zh: 用佩科里诺罗马诺奶酪、黑胡椒与煮面水拌成酱汁的意面，顺滑质地来自乳化；面形可以不同。

sources.title: Turismo Roma — Spaghetti Cacio e Pepe

examples.en: Cacio e pepe has a rich sheep's-cheese sauce with a distinct black-pepper flavour.
examples.zh: 这道意面用羊奶奶酪制成浓润酱汁，黑胡椒风味鲜明。

definition.en: A salad typically combining romaine lettuce, croutons, Parmesan, and a savoury dressing.
definition.zh: 经典组合以罗马生菜、面包丁、帕尔马干酪和浓味沙拉汁为主；酱汁及加料各有版本，须核对实际配方。

sources.title: James Beard Foundation — Kale Caesar Salad

examples.en: Our Caesar dressing contains anchovies and egg; I can check another option.
examples.zh: 我们的凯撒沙拉汁含鳀鱼和蛋，我可以为您确认其他选择。

definition.en: Stony limestone soils common in Centre-Loire.
definition.zh: Centre-Loire 的石质石灰岩土壤术语，见于 Sancerre 与 Pouilly-Fumé；与 terres blanches、clay-flint 一起构成重要地质对照。

definition.en: Squid rings dipped in batter and deep-fried until golden, served hot. Batter ingredients and accompanying sauces vary by kitchen.
definition.zh: 鱿鱼切圈后裹面糊，下油锅炸至外层金黄酥脆，趁热供应。面糊与蘸酱配方因餐厅而异；这里指西班牙菜单中的炸鱿鱼圈菜名。

sources.title: Leioa Hospitality School — Calamares a la romana

examples.en: These squid rings are dipped in batter and fried until crisp.
examples.zh: 这些鱿鱼圈裹上面糊后炸至酥脆。

zh: 炭烤加泰罗尼亚甜葱配罗梅斯科酱

definition.en: Flame-grilled Catalan calçot onions served with a romesco-style dipping sauce.
definition.zh: 将加泰罗尼亚特有的细长甜葱 calçots 用明火烤至外层焦黑，剥掉外皮后，蘸罗梅斯科风格的酱食用。葱心柔软、带甜味；餐桌上常用手剥食，服务时可说明剥皮和蘸酱的方法。

sources.title: Catalan Tourist Board — Valls: calçotades y castells
Bodega Joan — Calçots a la brasa con salsa romesco

examples.en: Peel away the charred outer layer, then dip the tender calçot in the sauce.
examples.zh: 先剥掉焦黑的外层，再将柔嫩的葱心蘸酱享用。

definition.en: A potato-based soup with finely shredded leafy greens, often served with sliced Portuguese sausage.
definition.zh: 以土豆、洋葱和蒜煮出柔滑汤底，再加入切得很细的甘蓝类叶菜。常配 chouriço 等葡式香肠和玉米面包；名字虽含“绿色”，并不代表一定是素汤。

sources.title: Visit Portugal / Lisbon Tourism and Hospitality School — Caldo-Verde

examples.en: Our caldo verde has a smooth potato base with finely shredded greens and slices of sausage.
examples.zh: 我们的葡式甘蓝汤以柔滑土豆汤为底，加入细切叶菜和香肠片。

zh: 我可以把这些餐盘收走吗？

definition.en: A request for permission to remove used plates.
definition.zh: 服务员收餐盘前征求同意。clear 在这里表示撤走餐具，不是清洗或把菜吃光；问句中的 these plates 要与实际准备撤走的盘子一致。

sources.title: Oxford Advanced Learner’s Dictionary · Clear: remove plates
British Council · Requests, offers and invitations

examples.en: Can I clear these plates, or are you still enjoying the food?
examples.zh: 我可以把这些餐盘收走吗，还是您还在用餐？

definition.en: An offer to start taking a guest’s food or drink order.
definition.zh: 服务员开始点单时使用。take your order 是记录客人的点单，不是把订单拿走；Can I 在这里用于主动提供服务。

sources.title: British Council · Requests, offers and invitations
British Council · English for the World of Work: Tourism / Catering Services

examples.en: Can I take your order, or would you like to look at the menu a little longer?
examples.zh: 现在可以为您点单吗，还是您想再看看菜单？

definition.en: Duck served with a sweet-sharp orange sauce, traditionally presented as a roast duck dish.
definition.zh: 烤鸭或烹熟的鸭肉配兼具甜味与酸味的橙汁酱，酱汁可含高汤、橙皮、焦糖和酒类。这里的 orange 指橙子风味，不表示酱汁只是鲜榨果汁；整鸭与鸭胸等版本应按菜单说明。

sources.title: Le Cordon Bleu — Duck à l’orange, published on ckbk

examples.en: The roast duck is served with an orange sauce that balances sweetness and acidity.
examples.zh: 烤鸭搭配橙汁酱，酱汁兼具甜味与酸味。

definition.en: Pruning that retains one or more longer one-year-old canes.
definition.zh: 保留较长的一年生结果母枝及一定数量芽眼的修剪方式，Guyot 是经典体系之一。

sources.title: Penn State Extension — Dormant cane and spur pruning

definition.en: Small fluted cakes made from a milk-and-egg batter, usually flavoured with vanilla and rum, with a dark caramelised exterior and a soft centre.
definition.zh: 以牛奶、鸡蛋、面粉与糖调成面糊，常加入香草和朗姆酒，在带纵向沟纹的小模具中烘烤。外层颜色较深、焦香而有韧脆感，内部柔软湿润，介绍时可用 caramelised outside and soft centre 描述这种反差。

sources.title: Chef Philippe / Meilleur du Chef — Classic canelés

examples.en: Our canelés have a caramelised crust and a soft centre flavoured with vanilla and rum.
examples.zh: 我们的可露丽外层焦香，内部柔软，带香草和朗姆酒风味。

definition.en: Large pasta tubes filled with meat ragù, covered with sauce and cheese, and baked.
definition.zh: 将肉酱填进粗管意面或卷起的面皮，再加酱汁和奶酪焗烤；常见牛肉版本会用贝夏梅尔白酱。Cannelloni 仅说明面卷形态，di carne 才说明这里是肉馅，不能将菠菜奶酪版一并解释为肉馅。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — cannelloni di carne

examples.en: The cannelloni are filled with meat ragù and baked under béchamel and Parmesan.
examples.zh: 这款面卷填入肉酱，上面覆盖贝夏梅尔白酱和帕尔马干酪后焗烤。

definition.en: Crisp fried pastry tubes filled with sweetened ricotta, with toppings that vary.
definition.zh: 把薄面皮卷成管状炸脆，再填入甜瑞可塔奶酪馅的西西里甜点，常有巧克力、蜜饯果皮或开心果等变化。外壳和馅分开制作，临近上桌填馅有助于保留脆感；cannolo 是单数。

examples.en: The cannoli have crisp pastry shells and a sweet ricotta filling.
examples.zh: 这些奶酪酥卷有酥脆的外壳，里面填的是甜瑞可塔奶酪。

definition.en: Management of shoots, leaves, and fruit-zone architecture.
definition.zh: 通过整枝、绑蔓、摘叶、疏梢等方式调节光照、通风、病害风险、光合作用和果实成熟。

sources.title: New Mexico State University — Grapevine Growth and Phenology
Penn State Extension — Wine Grape Production

definition.en: The floating mass of skins and solids formed during red fermentation.
definition.zh: 红葡萄酒发酵时 CO₂ 把果皮等固体推至液面形成的层，需要通过不同管理方式保持提取与卫生。

definition.en: South African bottle-fermented traditional-method sparkling-wine category.
definition.zh: 南非传统法起泡酒体系，Western Cape 生产者广泛使用 Chardonnay / Pinot Noir 等。

definition.en: A small flower bud, usually preserved in brine, vinegar, or salt for a sharp flavour.
definition.zh: 刺山柑尚未开放的花蕾，通常经盐渍或醋渍使用，带咸酸风味；菜单中的酸豆并不是豆类。

examples.en: The sauce has capers, which add a salty, tangy note.
examples.zh: 这款酱汁加入了酸豆，带来咸鲜和酸味。

definition.en: A cooked aubergine dish with vegetables, olives, and capers, balanced by sweet-and-sour seasoning.
definition.zh: 以炸过的茄子搭配芹菜、橄榄、酸豆等烹成的酸甜蔬菜菜肴，常放凉供应；葡萄干和坚果等配料随版本变化。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — Aubergine Caponata by Manuela Zangara

examples.en: The caponata is a sweet-and-sour aubergine dish with olives and capers.
examples.zh: 卡波纳塔是一道带有橄榄和酸豆的酸甜茄子菜。

zh: 卡普雷塞番茄乳酪沙拉

definition.en: A fresh salad of tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil, usually dressed simply with olive oil.
definition.zh: 将番茄与马苏里拉乳酪搭配罗勒、橄榄油制成的沙拉，重视食材本味；沙拉汁和额外配料可因餐厅而异。

examples.en: The Caprese salad is a simple combination of tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and basil.
examples.zh: 卡普雷塞沙拉简单搭配番茄、新鲜马苏里拉乳酪和罗勒。

definition.en: To heat sugars until they develop caramel colour and flavour; caramelize is the US spelling.
definition.zh: 加热糖分，使其产生焦糖的色泽与香味；美式拼写为 caramelize。焦糖化不等于所有上色：肉类表面的褐变常涉及糖与氨基成分的美拉德反应，两者应区分。

sources.title: Institute of Culinary Education — know your ingredients: dairy

examples.en: We caramelise the sugar on the crème brûlée just before serving.
examples.zh: 上桌前，我们会把焦糖布丁表面的糖烤成焦糖脆壳。

zh: 卡邦尼意面／罗马蛋酱意面

definition.en: A Roman pasta preparation using eggs, cured pork cheek, Pecorino cheese, and black pepper.
definition.zh: 罗马经典做法以蛋、风干猪颊肉、佩科里诺奶酪和黑胡椒拌面形成酱汁；传统版本不以奶油为基础。

examples.en: Our carbonara uses egg, guanciale, Pecorino, and black pepper.
examples.zh: 我们的卡邦尼意面使用蛋、风干猪颊肉、佩科里诺奶酪和黑胡椒。

definition.en: Sparkling-wine production by direct injection of carbon dioxide into still wine.
definition.zh: 向静态葡萄酒直接加入外源 CO₂ 形成气泡；充气过程本身不产生二次发酵或酵母自溶特征，基酒仍可能有自身的熟成风味。

sources.title: WSET · Level 3 Award in Wines specification

definition.en: Intracellular fermentation in intact grapes under carbon-dioxide-rich conditions.
definition.zh: 完整葡萄在富 CO₂、低氧环境中发生细胞内代谢，随后仍需由酵母完成酒精发酵。常带来鲜明果香，具体提取与结构依工艺而变；并非所有 Beaujolais 都采用纯 carbonic maceration。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: A Flemish stew of beef and onions slowly cooked with beer. Bread, mustard or spiced cake may be used to flavour and thicken the sauce, depending on the version.
definition.zh: 将牛肉与洋葱放入啤酒中慢炖的弗拉芒炖菜。不同版本会加入面包、芥末或香料蛋糕来调味、增稠，通常搭配土豆或薯条。

examples.en: The beef is slowly cooked with beer and onions until tender, with a rich sauce.
examples.zh: 牛肉与啤酒、洋葱一起慢炖至软嫩，酱汁浓厚。

definition.en: Trimmed artichokes deep-fried until the leaves are crisp and the centre is tender.
definition.zh: 罗马犹太饮食传统中的炸洋蓟，修整后整颗下锅，叶片展开形成花朵状，外层酥脆而中心柔软。这里的 giudia 标示菜式传统，不等于餐厅具有任何宗教饮食认证；与焖煮的 alla Romana 是两道菜。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — carciofi alla giudia

examples.en: The artichokes alla giudia are fried, with crisp leaves and a tender heart.
examples.zh: 这道犹太式洋蓟是炸制的，叶片酥脆，中心柔嫩。

definition.en: Whole trimmed artichokes gently cooked with garlic, herbs, oil and a little liquid.
definition.zh: 把修整好的洋蓟填入蒜、欧芹、mentuccia 等香草调味，在锅中以油和少量液体慢慢焖软。口感柔嫩，区别于油炸酥脆的 carciofi alla giudia；所用酒和香草组合需按餐厅配方描述。

sources.title: MICHELIN Guide — Carciofi! Alla giudìa o alla romana?

examples.en: The artichokes alla Romana are gently braised with garlic and herbs.
examples.zh: 这道罗马式洋蓟用蒜和香草慢慢焖至柔嫩。

definition.en: Marinated pork cooked with clams and usually served with fried potatoes.
definition.zh: 将猪肉块以蒜、甜椒酱和葡萄酒等调味后煎炖，再加入蛤蜊，常拌炸土豆块。是肉类与贝类合做的一道菜，点单介绍时应明确含蛤蜊。

sources.title: Chef Luís Machado — Carne de porco à alentejana

examples.en: This dish combines marinated pork with clams and golden fried potatoes.
examples.zh: 这道菜将腌制猪肉、蛤蜊与金黄炸土豆搭配在一起。

zh: 卡帕乔薄切生食〔常指牛肉〕

definition.en: A preparation of very thinly sliced raw meat, classically beef, served with dressing and garnishes.
definition.zh: 经典形式为极薄切的生牛肉配调味与点缀；现代菜单也有其他食材版本，应说明具体食材和生熟状态。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — How to Make Carpaccio of Beef

examples.en: The beef carpaccio is served raw, sliced very thinly.
examples.zh: 这道牛肉卡帕乔以生食方式供应，牛肉切得很薄。

definition.en: To perform a planned task, check or course of action.
definition.zh: 执行计划或开展工作，如 carry out a plan、carry out a check。代词作宾语时说 carry it out。

examples.en: Let’s carry out the plan.
examples.zh: 我们来落实这个计划。

zh: 西西里瑞可塔夹心蛋糕

definition.en: A Sicilian sponge-and-ricotta cake commonly finished with marzipan, icing and candied fruit.
definition.zh: 海绵蛋糕与甜瑞可塔奶酪组合的西西里甜点，常用杏仁糖膏、糖霜和蜜饯水果装饰。馅料可能含巧克力，蛋糕或奶酪馅也可能加入利口酒；这里指蛋糕做法，而不是所有也叫 cassata 的冷冻甜品。

examples.en: This cassata layers sponge cake with ricotta and has a marzipan finish.
examples.zh: 这款卡萨塔将海绵蛋糕与瑞可塔奶酪叠在一起，外面有杏仁糖膏。

definition.en: A slow-cooked white-bean casserole with meats such as pork, sausage, or duck, finished in the oven.
definition.zh: 白豆与猪肉、香肠或鸭肉等共同慢煮再入炉的浓厚焖锅，肉类组合随地方传统与厨房版本变化。

examples.en: The cassoulet is a hearty white-bean casserole, slowly cooked with a selection of meats.
examples.zh: 这道卡苏莱以白豆和多种肉类慢煮，口感厚实浓郁。

definition.en: A rustic chestnut-flour cake made with water and olive oil, commonly topped with rosemary, pine nuts, raisins and sometimes walnuts.
definition.zh: 将栗子粉与水、橄榄油调成面糊烘烤，再以迷迭香、松子、葡萄干或核桃增添风味。它呈现栗子的自然甜味与香草气息，是质地较扎实的栗粉烤糕，适合用 chestnut-flour cake 向客人解释。

examples.en: The castagnaccio is made with chestnut flour and has rosemary, pine nuts and raisins.
examples.zh: 这款栗粉烤糕用栗子粉制作，带有迷迭香、松子和葡萄干。

definition.en: Fish and shellfish cooked with vegetables in a covered cataplana pan.
definition.zh: 将鱼块、蛤蜊、虾与洋葱、番茄、甜椒等放入带盖的 cataplana 锅中焖煮。Cataplana 同时指锅具和这类菜；这里特指鱼贝海鲜版本，配料随菜单变化。

sources.title: Visit Portugal / Lisbon Tourism and Hospitality School — Cataplana de Peixe

examples.en: This cataplana brings fish, clams and prawns together in a fragrant vegetable broth.
examples.zh: 这道葡式海鲜锅把鱼、蛤蜊和虾焖在带有蔬菜香气的汤汁中。

definition.en: Spanish traditional-method sparkling wine under DO Cava.
definition.zh: 西班牙传统法起泡酒体系，经典品种包括 Macabeo、Xarel·lo、Parellada，并有现代 ageing / zoning framework。

sources.title: DO Cava · Types and varieties of Cava

definition.en: Cava category with minimum 9 months ageing.
definition.zh: DO Cava 当前基础 ageing category，最低 9 个月瓶中熟成。

definition.en: Top Cava category tied to a qualified single site and minimum 36 months ageing.
definition.zh: 来自被认可的特殊 vineyard site，最低 36 个月熟成并附带更严格 viticulture / production requirements。

sources.title: DO Cava · Types and varieties of Cava

definition.en: Cava de Guarda Superior category with minimum 30 months ageing.
definition.zh: Cava de Guarda Superior 下的 Gran Reserva 类别，最低瓶中熟成 30 个月。

definition.en: Cava de Guarda Superior category with minimum 18 months ageing.
definition.zh: Cava de Guarda Superior 下的 Reserva 类别，最低瓶中熟成 18 个月；现行 Guarda Superior 体系强调有机葡萄与更严格的来源追溯。

definition.en: A knobbly root vegetable with a celery-like, nutty flavour. It is crisp when raw and becomes mildly sweet when cooked, making it useful for slaws, purées and soups.
definition.zh: 外形粗糙的根用蔬菜，也称 celery root，风味近似芹菜并带坚果气息。生食爽脆，可切丝做沙拉；熟后略甜，适合打成泥、煮汤或烤制，是解释配菜时常见的食材词。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — How to cook celeriac

examples.en: The purée underneath the beef is celeriac; it has a gentle celery flavour.
examples.zh: 牛肉下面的蔬菜泥是根芹泥，带有淡淡的芹菜风味。

definition.en: Eastern Loire wine area centered on Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Noir.
definition.zh: Sancerre、Pouilly-Fumé、Menetou-Salon 等产区所在区域，以 Sauvignon Blanc 为白酒核心。

definition.en: Northern Burgundy Chardonnay appellation with its own hierarchy.
definition.zh: 以 Chardonnay、高酸和石灰质地质背景著称；需分 Petit Chablis、Chablis、Premier Cru、Grand Cru。

sources.title: Chablis and Chablis Premier Cru - Bourgogne wines

definition.en: Grand Cru appellation in Chablis covering seven named climats.
definition.zh: 夏布利最高层级，集中在 Serein 右岸的经典坡地；需掌握 7 个主要 Grand Cru climat 名称。

definition.en: Village-level Chablis wines from designated Premier Cru climats.
definition.zh: Premier Cru 不是独立 region，而是 Chablis appellation 内的特定 climats designation。

sources.title: Chablis and Chablis Premier Cru - Bourgogne wines

definition.en: Highly porous calcareous subsoil central to many Champagne vineyards.
definition.zh: 白垩是富含碳酸钙、由古代海洋生物微小遗骸形成的多孔岩石。Champagne 许多葡萄园的白垩底土既能排出多余水分，也能储存并缓慢供水。

sources.title: Comité Champagne · Champagne and its soil

definition.en: Côte de Nuits village appellation centered on Pinot Noir.
definition.zh: 夜丘的重要 Pinot Noir 村庄级 AOC，拥有多个 Premier Cru climat；村域内还有独立的 Musigny 和部分 Bonnes-Mares Grand Cru 葡萄园。

definition.en: French sparkling-wine region and protected appellation in northeastern France.
definition.zh: 法国东北部受保护的起泡酒产区与 AOC，核心由四大主要葡萄种植子区、瓶中二次发酵、长期酒泥熟成与复杂调配体系构成。

definition.en: Addition of fermentable sugar before or during fermentation to raise potential alcohol.
definition.zh: 主要目的是提高潜在酒精度，不等于给成酒增甜；合法性依地区、类别和年份而异。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: Principal white grape of Burgundy.
definition.zh: Chablis、Côte de Beaune、Mâconnais 的核心白葡萄；风格差异主要来自 site、ripeness、oak/lees choices 与 producer。

definition.en: Rare authorised pink-skinned Chardonnay mutation in Champagne.
definition.zh: Chardonnay 的粉红果皮变异型，2025 年正式列入 Champagne 允许品种；目前仍属极少量品种。

definition.en: Côte de Beaune village producing both Chardonnay and Pinot Noir.
definition.zh: 与 Montrachet family Grand Crus 紧密相关，同时也有红酒生产。

definition.en: White grape used for Pouilly-sur-Loire.
definition.zh: 白葡萄品种；在 Loire 的关键对应产区是 Pouilly-sur-Loire，必须与 Sauvignon Blanc 酿制的 Pouilly-Fumé 区分。

definition.en: A pot of warm melted cheese into which diners dip pieces of bread.
definition.zh: 将奶酪加热融化在共用锅中，客人用长叉蘸取面包块食用。常见瑞士版本会用白葡萄酒调和，奶酪组合多样；cheese fondue 不等于巧克力或油炸肉类火锅。

sources.title: Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs — Switzerland’s National Dishes

examples.en: The cheese fondue comes in a shared pot with bread for dipping.
examples.zh: 奶酪火锅以共享锅上桌，配面包块蘸食。

definition.en: A slab of cheese coated lightly and fried until its outside is golden, usually served with lemon.
definition.zh: 将适合煎炸的芝士，如 kefalotyri 或 kasseri，裹薄粉后煎至金黄，常配柠檬。Saganaki 也用于虾或其他小锅菜名，因此这里明确为芝士版本。

sources.title: Chef Akis Petretzikis — Greek fried cheese, Saganaki

examples.en: The cheese saganaki has a golden crust and is served with lemon on the side.
examples.zh: 这道香煎芝士表面金黄，柠檬另配。

definition.en: Versatile Loire grape capable of dry, sweet and sparkling wines with high acidity.
definition.zh: 卢瓦尔核心白葡萄，可从极干到贵腐甜酒，也可用于 traditional-method sparkling；高酸和陈年潜力是核心。

definition.en: Requiring repeated chewing before swallowing; this can be enjoyable in bread or toffee, but unwelcome in a tough steak.
definition.zh: 需要多嚼几下才能咽下的质地。形容面包或糖果时可表示有嚼劲，形容牛排时也可能是在说韧、难嚼。服务时要结合食物和客人的语气判断褒贬。

examples.en: Our sourdough has a chewy centre and a crisp crust.
examples.zh: 我们的酸种面包内部有嚼劲，外壳香脆。

definition.en: A Louisiana chicken-and-sausage stew with a browned roux and aromatic vegetables, served with rice.
definition.zh: 以鸡肉、烟熏香肠、洋葱、芹菜和青椒熬煮的路易斯安那浓汤，常以炒成棕色的油脂面粉糊 roux 打底。长时间炖煮让香味融合，上桌时配另煮的米饭；这是 gumbo 家族中的鸡肉香肠版本。

sources.title: Explore Louisiana — Chicken and Sausage Gumbo

examples.en: Our chicken and sausage gumbo is a rich stew served with rice.
examples.zh: 我们的鸡肉香肠甘博是一道浓郁炖汤，配米饭食用。

definition.en: Touraine appellation dominated by Cabernet Franc red wines.
definition.zh: Cabernet Franc 核心产区，gravel terraces 与 tuffeau/clay-limestone slopes 可形成不同结构。

sources.title: InterLoire · Climate and geology of Loire wines

definition.en: Small squid gently cooked in a dark sauce made with squid ink and vegetables.
definition.zh: 小鱿鱼在加入自身墨汁的深色酱汁中慢煮，酱底可含洋葱、番茄和蒜。部分做法会把鱿鱼须等填回鱼身，常与白米饭同上；深色来自墨汁，并非烧焦。

sources.title: Spain Tourism — Chipirones en su tinta con arroz blanco

examples.en: The squid is cooked in its own ink sauce and served with white rice.
examples.zh: 小鱿鱼以墨汁酱慢煮，并配白米饭。

definition.en: Rich chocolate tray-baked squares, ranging from dense and fudgy to lightly cake-like.
definition.zh: 把巧克力或可可、黄油、糖、鸡蛋和面粉调成面糊，在平烤盘里烘烤后切块的甜点。口感可偏湿润绵密，也可略带蛋糕般蓬松感。Fudgy 描述浓密湿润的口感，不表示必须夹有软糖馅。

sources.title: PJ Hamel / King Arthur Baking — Fudge Brownies
King Arthur Baking — Types of Brownies

examples.en: These chocolate brownies have a rich flavour and a moist, fudgy centre.
examples.zh: 这些巧克力布朗尼风味浓郁，中心湿润绵密。

zh: 乔里索香肠／西班牙风味香肠

definition.en: A strongly seasoned sausage associated with Spain and Latin America, with regional styles and preparations.
definition.zh: 西班牙及拉美常见的浓味香肠，地区配方、辣度和熟成方式各异；介绍时需确认具体类型与做法。

sources.title: Nigella Lawson — Chorizo for Quick Chilli

examples.en: I will check which type of chorizo the kitchen uses.
examples.zh: 我会确认厨房使用的是哪一种乔里索香肠。

definition.en: Cabbage filled with a savoury stuffing, commonly minced pork, herbs and sometimes rice, then slowly cooked in stock.
definition.zh: 将包心菜叶烫软，包入猪肉馅、香草，有时加入米饭等配料，再放入高汤中慢慢烹熟。既可做成整颗包心菜，也可分成单人份，入口结合柔软菜叶与多汁肉馅。

examples.en: The cabbage is stuffed with pork, rice and herbs, then gently cooked in stock.
examples.zh: 包心菜内填猪肉、米饭和香草，再用高汤慢慢煮熟。

zh: 阿尔萨斯酸菜肉肠拼锅

definition.en: Sauerkraut cooked with aromatics and served with sausages, cured meats, and usually potatoes.
definition.zh: 发酵酸卷心菜与香料烹煮，再配香肠、腌制或烟熏肉及土豆的丰盛菜肴；具体肉类组合依餐厅而定。

sources.title: Kaysersberg Valley Tourist Office — Alsatian Sauerkraut

examples.en: The choucroute garnie combines tangy sauerkraut with sausages, cured meats, and potatoes.
examples.zh: 这道阿尔萨斯酸菜拼锅搭配香肠、腌肉和土豆，酸菜带有爽口酸味。

definition.en: Piped strips of dough fried until crisp, commonly dusted with sugar.
definition.zh: 面团挤成长条或环形后油炸，常撒糖趁热吃，可作早餐、下午点心或配巧克力饮品。传统基础配方可很简单，不能据菜名推断所有店家的鸡蛋或奶使用情况。

examples.en: The churros are freshly fried and lightly coated in sugar.
examples.zh: 这些 churros 现炸后薄薄撒了一层糖。

definition.en: A tomato-based seafood stew combining fish and shellfish in a savoury broth.
definition.zh: 以番茄、洋葱、蒜和葡萄酒熬出汤底，再加入鱼肉与虾、蟹、蛤蜊或贻贝等海鲜的炖汤。常见于旧金山意式海鲜餐厅，重点是番茄汤汁与多种海鲜的鲜味；具体海鲜组合可随供应变化。

examples.en: The cioppino brings fish and shellfish together in a tomato-based broth.
examples.zh: 这道 cioppino 用番茄汤底把鱼肉和贝虾类海鲜炖在一起。

definition.en: Cherries baked in a soft, egg-rich batter, giving a texture between a pudding and a cake.
definition.zh: 把樱桃放入富含鸡蛋的面糊中烘烤，成品质地介于布丁与蛋糕之间，通常没有独立派皮。奶、奶油及杏仁等配方会变化；本词条限定樱桃版，服务时也应确认樱桃是否去核。

sources.title: Pascal Aussignac / Great British Chefs — Griotte cherry clafoutis

examples.en: The cherry clafoutis is baked in a soft batter and has a tender, custard-like texture.
examples.zh: 樱桃烘蛋糕以柔软面糊烤成，口感细嫩，带有类似蛋奶布丁的质地。

definition.en: A name for several types of bivalve shellfish used in cooking. Their flesh and juices add seafood flavour to pasta, rice dishes, chowders and sauces.
definition.zh: 烹饪中对多种蛤类双壳贝的称呼，并非只指某一个品种。贝肉及其汁液能为意面、米饭、浓汤和酱汁增加海鲜风味；向客人介绍时可同时说明品种、是否带壳及所配汤汁。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook clams

examples.en: The spaghetti is tossed with clams and their juices for a clean seafood flavour.
examples.zh: 这款长意面拌入蛤蜊及其原汁，海鲜风味清晰。

definition.en: To make a meaning, detail or request easier to understand.
definition.zh: 把信息、意图或要求解释清楚。服务中可用来确认客人真正需要什么。

examples.en: Could you clarify what you mean?
examples.zh: 您能解释一下您的意思吗？

definition.en: Organic sparkling-wine designation within DO Penedès.
definition.zh: DO Penedès 内的有机起泡酒名称，与 Cava 及 Corpinnat 是不同体系。强调 Penedès 来源与瓶中熟成；生产规则也包含 ancestral 类型，不能简单定义为只允许二次发酵传统法。

definition.en: A very fine soil particle fraction; clay-rich soils generally retain more water than sandy soils.
definition.zh: Clay 可指极细的黏粒，也常指富含黏粒的黏土质土壤。通常保水能力较强，但并非所有被保留的水都可被根系利用；右岸 Merlot 的表现还取决于排水、土层与当年水分条件。

sources.title: Oregon State University Extension — Soil-plant-water relationships

definition.en: A precisely delimited Burgundian vineyard site with a distinct identity shaped by nature and winegrowing history.
definition.zh: 勃艮第特有 terroir 概念，可存在于不同 appellation hierarchy 层级；Climat 不等于单纯“微气候”。

definition.en: A vineyard historically or physically enclosed by walls.
definition.zh: Clos 是地点/历史边界概念，不代表质量等级；可出现在 Village、Premier Cru 或 Grand Cru 语境。

definition.en: Large walled Grand Cru in Vougeot with many owners.
definition.zh: 巨大且多 owner 的 Grand Cru，是说明同一 appellation 内 producer / parcel 差异极大的经典案例。

definition.en: A layered toasted sandwich with chicken or turkey, bacon, tomato, lettuce and mayonnaise.
definition.zh: 常用三片烤面包叠出两层馅料，夹鸡肉或火鸡肉、培根、番茄、生菜和蛋黄酱，再切成小块固定上桌。它的重点是多层结构与禽肉、培根组合，部分版本会再加鸡蛋。

sources.title: James Beard Foundation — James Beard on Making Super Sandwiches

examples.en: Our club sandwich has chicken, bacon and salad between three slices of toast.
examples.zh: 我们的总会三明治用三片吐司夹鸡肉、培根和沙拉蔬菜。

definition.en: Coopérative de Manipulation producer category.
definition.zh: Champagne 标签注册代码，Coopérative de Manipulation：合作社使用成员葡萄生产并以合作社品牌销售香槟。

sources.title: Comité Champagne · Understanding the Champagne label
Union des Maisons de Champagne · Etiquetage

definition.en: A substantial salad with greens, chicken, bacon, egg, avocado, tomato and blue cheese.
definition.zh: 美式主食沙拉，把鸡肉、培根、鸡蛋、牛油果、番茄和蓝纹奶酪等配在生菜上，常配油醋汁。食材有时排成条带后再拌匀；不同餐厅可能调整配料或酱汁。

sources.title: Chef Billy Parisi — Traditional Cobb Salad

examples.en: The Cobb salad includes chicken, bacon, egg and avocado, with blue cheese for extra flavour.
examples.zh: 科布沙拉里有鸡肉、培根、鸡蛋和牛油果，并用蓝纹奶酪增添风味。

definition.en: Suckling pig seasoned and oven-roasted until the meat is tender and the skin crisp. It is a well-known dish of Castile and León.
definition.zh: 西班牙烤乳猪，将乳猪调味后放入烤箱烘烤，追求肉质软嫩、表皮金黄酥脆。它是卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂地区常见的代表菜肴。

examples.en: This roast suckling pig has tender meat beneath a crisp golden skin.
examples.zh: 这道烤乳猪外皮金黄酥脆，里面的肉质软嫩。

definition.en: A Madrid-style dish of chickpeas, meats and vegetables simmered together. It is commonly served in stages, with noodle broth followed by chickpeas, vegetables and meats.
definition.zh: 以鹰嘴豆、多种肉类和蔬菜慢炖而成的马德里菜。传统上常分次上桌：先是加细面的汤，接着供应鹰嘴豆、蔬菜及炖肉；具体肉类随配方变化。

examples.en: This Madrid-style stew brings together chickpeas, vegetables and several cuts of meat.
examples.zh: 这道马德里炖菜汇集了鹰嘴豆、蔬菜和多种肉类。

definition.en: Pre-fermentation maceration at low temperature.
definition.zh: 在明显酒精发酵前低温浸泡葡萄皮与汁液，常用于提取色素、香气前体和部分风味成分，同时尽量延缓发酵。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: To work well with something and enhance it through a suitable combination.
definition.zh: 与另一事物相配或互相补充。餐酒语境表示搭配能相互衬托；不要与 compliment（赞美）混淆。

examples.en: This wine can complement the dish.
examples.zh: 这款酒可以与这道菜相互衬托。

zh: 科内利亚诺-瓦尔多比亚德内普罗塞克优质DOCG

definition.en: Historic hill-zone Prosecco DOCG between Conegliano and Valdobbiadene.
definition.zh: Prosecco 高质量核心山区之一，需与 broader Prosecco DOC 区分。

sources.title: Consorzio Conegliano Valdobbiadene · Prosecco Superiore DOCG

definition.en: To establish that a detail or arrangement is correct and settled.
definition.zh: 核实信息或确认安排，例如预订、时间、人数与订单；确认后应复述关键细节。

examples.en: May I confirm your booking?
examples.zh: 我可以确认一下您的预订吗？

definition.en: For meat, a method of gently cooking cured food in fat at a low temperature.
definition.zh: 肉类语境中通常指先盐渍再以油脂低温慢煮，常见于鸭腿；菜单其他食材使用此词时应结合配方。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to Make Duck Confit Sous Vide

examples.en: Confit means the duck is slowly cooked in fat until tender.
examples.zh: 这里的油封是指鸭肉在油脂中慢慢煮至软嫩。

definition.en: A later flight taken as another part of the same journey.
definition.zh: 旅程中转机后继续搭乘的航班；需留意转机时间、登机口与行李安排。

examples.en: I may miss my connecting flight.
examples.zh: 我可能赶不上转机航班。

definition.en: Sparkling production using continuous pressurised fermentation systems.
definition.zh: 在保持压力的连续系统中，让酒液持续通过一系列发酵罐，并供给糖和酵母以形成 CO₂。区别于一般按一批批装罐发酵的罐式法。

definition.en: Chicken or rooster braised in wine with aromatic vegetables, often accompanied by bacon and mushrooms.
definition.zh: 鸡肉以葡萄酒和芳香蔬菜慢炖，常配烟肉与蘑菇；经典红酒版之外也有地方白酒版本，不应固定为同一种酒。

examples.en: The coq au vin is slowly braised chicken in a rich wine sauce.
examples.zh: 这道葡萄酒炖鸡经过慢炖，配以浓郁酒汁。

definition.en: Scallops coated in a creamy sauce, often with mushrooms, then briefly browned in shells or small baking dishes.
definition.zh: 扇贝配奶油酱汁与蘑菇，放在贝壳或小烤皿中焗至表面上色。有的版本以土豆泥围边；gratinées 提示上层烤出金黄色泽，介绍时可同时说明扇贝的嫩度与酱汁的浓润口感。

sources.title: Chef Michel Dumas — Coquilles Saint-Jacques gratinées

examples.en: The scallops are baked with mushrooms in a creamy sauce until the top is golden.
examples.zh: 扇贝与蘑菇、奶油酱汁一起焗烤，表面呈金黄色。

definition.en: A vine-training system with permanent horizontal arms.
definition.zh: 葡萄藤保留永久性水平枝臂，并常配合短梢修剪形成规则结果点。

sources.title: Penn State Extension — Dormant cane and spur pruning

definition.en: A restaurant fee for serving wine or other permitted drinks brought in by guests.
definition.zh: 餐厅为客人自带且获准饮用的酒提供服务所收取的费用；是否允许自带、计费方式和包含服务须提前说明。

examples.en: Let me confirm our corkage policy before you bring the wine.
examples.zh: 您带酒来之前，我先为您确认一下我们的开瓶费政策。

definition.en: Chopped corned beef, potatoes and onion browned together in a frying pan.
definition.zh: 把熟的腌咸牛肉与土豆、洋葱切小块，在平底锅中煎炒并压出焦香表面，常作为早餐或早午餐，也可加煎蛋。Hash 在这里指切碎混合煎制的菜；corned beef 是腌咸牛肉，不是玉米牛肉。

sources.title: Christine Gallary / The Kitchn — Corned Beef Hash

examples.en: The corned beef hash has diced potatoes and beef with a crisp, browned edge.
examples.zh: 这道咸牛肉土豆杂烩有牛肉丁和土豆丁，煎出的边缘焦香。

definition.en: A folded pastry parcel filled with beef, potato, swede and onion, then baked.
definition.zh: 把牛肉、土豆、瑞典芜菁和洋葱包入折合的面皮，沿边捏出封口后烘烤的咸馅饼。馅料在面皮内一起烤熟，肉汁留在内部。这里的 swede 是黄肉瑞典芜菁，在北美也叫 rutabaga。

sources.title: Cornish Pasty Association — Make Your Own Genuine Cornish Pasty

examples.en: The Cornish pasty is filled with beef, potato, swede and onion.
examples.zh: 这款康沃尔馅饼包着牛肉、土豆、瑞典芜菁和洋葱。

definition.en: Independent collective mark for high-quality sparkling wines from the Penedès area.
definition.zh: Penedès 地区优质起泡酒的独立集体商标，不是 Cava 的等级。标准强调有机葡萄、手工采收、酒庄内酿造及较长酒泥熟成；estate vinification 不等于所有葡萄都必须来自自有葡萄园。

sources.title: Corpinnat · Standards and 2026 Cata Mayor award

definition.en: Burgundy subregion south of Côte d'Or with several village appellations.
definition.zh: 重要 value 区域，涵盖 Bouzeron、Rully、Mercurey、Givry、Montagny。

definition.en: The central Burgundy winegrowing strip comprising Côte de Nuits and Côte de Beaune.
definition.zh: 在葡萄酒地理语境中，Côte d’Or 指由 Côte de Nuits 与 Côte de Beaune 组成的核心产区带；不要与范围更大的 Côte-d’Or 行政省或 Bourgogne Côte d’Or 地理名称混为一谈。

sources.title: BIVB — Côte de Nuits and Hautes Côtes de Nuits

definition.en: Southern half of the Côte d'Or, producing both important red and white wines.
definition.zh: 以 Meursault、Puligny、Chassagne 等白酒中心及 Pommard、Volnay 等红酒村庄为核心。

definition.en: Beaujolais Cru located on the slopes of Mont Brouilly.
definition.zh: 独立 cru，需与更大的 Brouilly 区分；火山/变质岩相关土壤是学习重点之一。

definition.en: Northern half of the Côte d'Or, especially renowned for Pinot Noir and red Grand Crus.
definition.zh: 夜丘从 Dijon 一带向南延伸至 Corgoloin，包含 Marsannay、Gevrey-Chambertin、Vosne-Romanée、Nuits-Saint-Georges 等重要村庄，是 Pinot Noir 与红葡萄酒 Grand Cru 的核心区域。

sources.title: BIVB — Côte de Nuits and Hautes Côtes de Nuits

definition.en: Southern Champagne subregion in the Aube, dominated by Pinot Noir.
definition.zh: 位于 Champagne 南部，Pinot Noir 主导，土壤中 clay/marl 影响更明显；Les Riceys、Urville 等为重要节点。

sources.title: Comité Champagne · Champagne and its soil

definition.en: Champagne subregion strongly associated with Chardonnay and chalk.
definition.zh: Champagne 以 Chardonnay 和白垩地质著名的重要子区，位于 Épernay 以南；是学习 blanc de blancs 的核心地区之一。

sources.title: Comité Champagne · Champagne and its soil

definition.en: Still-wine appellation within the Champagne region.
definition.zh: Champagne 地区的静态葡萄酒 AOP，可生产红、白、桃红酒。它不是起泡香槟，也不能把所有香槟二次发酵前的基酒都自动称为 Coteaux Champenois。

definition.en: Sweet Chenin Blanc appellation along the Layon tributary.
definition.zh: 晚采与 botrytis/overripeness 形成甜酒，high acidity 平衡 residual sugar。

sources.title: InterLoire · Vins blancs moelleux et liquoreux

definition.en: Umbrella appellation grouping several Bordeaux Côtes sectors.
definition.zh: 帮助学生理解 Bordeaux 不只有左右岸名庄，还包括多组 hillside appellations 与现代 value wines。

definition.en: A veal cutlet coated in egg and breadcrumbs, then fried in butter until golden.
definition.zh: 小牛排裹蛋液和面包屑后用黄油煎至金黄，经典可保留肋骨，外层酥脆；厚度和配菜有不同呈现。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — Veal Milanesa by Giancarlo Morelli

examples.en: The Milanese veal cutlet has a golden breadcrumb crust and tender meat inside.
examples.zh: 这道米兰式小牛排外层是金黄色面包屑，内部肉质柔嫩。

definition.en: Beef in gravy baked beneath a layer of mashed potato.
definition.zh: 牛肉与蔬菜煮成带肉汁的馅料，上覆土豆泥再烤至表面金黄；通常使用牛肉末，也有慢炖牛肉版本。这里的 pie 不一定有酥皮，须与通常用羊肉的 shepherd’s pie 区分。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Shepherd’s Pie and Cottage Pie

examples.en: Our cottage pie has a beef filling under a golden mashed-potato topping.
examples.zh: 我们的牛肉土豆泥派是在牛肉馅上铺土豆泥，再烤至金黄。

zh: 我可以核对一下您的点单吗？

definition.en: A polite way to introduce an order check.
definition.zh: 记录点单后，用这句话引出复述和核对；随后说明菜品、数量及特别要求，让客人有机会纠正。这里的 could 表示礼貌请求，不表示过去。

sources.title: British Council · How to be polite in English

examples.en: Could I confirm your order? That is one fish main course and two vegetable side dishes.
examples.zh: 我可以核对一下您的点单吗？是一份鱼类主菜和两份蔬菜配菜。

en: Could we have the bill, please?

definition.en: A polite request for the restaurant bill.
definition.zh: 客人在结账时请求账单。英国英语常说 bill，美国餐厅也常说 check；这是付款前的消费账单，不等同于付款后的 receipt。

examples.en: Could we have the bill, please? We would like to check it before paying.
examples.zh: 麻烦给我们账单。我们想在付款前核对一下。

en: Could we move to another table?
zh: 我们可以换一张桌子吗？

definition.en: A polite request to change tables.
definition.zh: 客人希望换桌时使用。another table 指另一张桌子；服务员应确认可用桌位、预订及客人需求后安排。

sources.title: British Council · How to be polite in English

examples.en: Could we move to another table farther from the door?
examples.zh: 我们可以换到离门远一点的桌子吗？

en: Could we serve the starters first?

definition.en: A request to arrange the order in which courses are served.
definition.zh: 用于与厨房或领班协调先上前菜，再上后续菜品。serve 在这里是供应、上菜；first 表示顺序，不是要求某桌抢先。

sources.title: British Council · English for the World of Work: Tourism / Catering Services

examples.en: Could we serve the starters first and bring the main courses when the guests are ready?
examples.zh: 我们可以先上前菜，等客人准备好再上主菜吗？

en: Could you bring out the dishes together?

definition.en: A request to coordinate dishes so they reach the table together.
definition.zh: 要求同事协调送菜，让相关菜品同时到桌。bring out 在这里是从厨房送到用餐区；可补充桌号和菜品，避免指代不清。

sources.title: British Council · How to be polite in English
British Council · English for the World of Work: Tourism / Catering Services

examples.en: Could you bring out the dishes for table six together? They would like to eat at the same time.
examples.zh: 能把六桌的菜一起上吗？他们想同时开始用餐。

en: Could you check the preparation time?
zh: 能确认一下制作需要多久吗？

definition.en: A request for an updated estimate of how long preparation will take.
definition.zh: 服务人员向厨房或同事确认一道菜预计还需多久。preparation time 是备制时间；向客人报告时还应考虑装盘和送餐所需时间。

sources.title: British Council · How to be polite in English
British Council · English for the World of Work: Tourism / Catering Services

examples.en: Could you check the preparation time for table twelve’s main courses?
examples.zh: 能确认一下十二桌主菜的制作时间吗？

en: Could you hold the main courses?

definition.en: A request to pause the main-course service.
definition.zh: 在与厨房沟通时，hold 表示暂缓某项动作。应说明是在暂缓开始制作还是暂缓出餐，以及何时再确认；不要把这句话当作取消订单。

sources.title: British Council · How to be polite in English

examples.en: Could you hold the main courses for table four? They are still enjoying their starters.
examples.zh: 能暂缓上四桌的主菜吗？他们还在吃前菜。

en: Could you leave out the onions?

definition.en: A request to omit onions from a dish.
definition.zh: 客人请求制作时不加入洋葱。leave out 表示省略或不包含；这只是改配料请求，不等于过敏原排除保证，也不表示能从已做好的酱汁中去除洋葱。

examples.en: Could you leave out the onions, if the dish is prepared to order?
examples.zh: 如果这道菜是现点现做，可以不放洋葱吗？

zh: 能推荐一个替代选择吗？

definition.en: A request for another suitable option.
definition.zh: 原选择缺货、不合口味或不能满足要求时，请服务员推荐其他选项。alternative 只是替代选项，是否符合饮食限制、预算和口味仍需核实。

sources.title: British Council · English for the World of Work: Tourism / Catering Services

examples.en: Could you recommend an alternative with a similar flavour and price?
examples.zh: 能推荐一道风味和价格相近的替代选择吗？

en: Could you tell me what is in this dish?
zh: 能告诉我这道菜有哪些食材吗？

definition.en: A polite request for a dish’s ingredients.
definition.zh: 客人询问食材组成。tell me 后面的间接问句用 what is in this dish；服务员回答应以当前配方和厨房确认的信息为准。

sources.title: Food Standards Scotland · Online allergen training: staff communication

examples.en: Could you tell me what is in this dish, including the sauce?
examples.zh: 能告诉我这道菜有哪些食材吗？也请包括酱汁的配料。

en: Could you tell me what went wrong?
zh: 能告诉我哪里出了问题吗？

definition.en: A calm question inviting a guest to explain a problem.
definition.zh: 处理投诉时，请客人说明发生了什么，以便找准问题。what went wrong 是间接问句；先听完整说明，再确认自己理解是否正确。

sources.title: British Council · A response to a complaint

examples.en: Could you tell me what went wrong with your order so I can help?
examples.zh: 能告诉我您的点单哪里出了问题吗？这样我可以帮您处理。

en: Could you tell me what you need to avoid?
zh: 能告诉我您需要避开什么吗？

definition.en: A polite question to clarify a guest’s food restrictions.
definition.zh: 在饮食需求已经提出后，进一步确认需要避开的具体食物或成分。客人若说明过敏或不耐受，应准确传达给相关同事，并核实制作信息。

sources.title: Food Standards Scotland · Online allergen training: staff communication

examples.en: Could you tell me what you need to avoid? I will pass the details to the kitchen.
examples.zh: 能告诉我您需要避开什么吗？我会把具体情况转达给厨房。

definition.en: Tiny monopole Chenin Blanc appellation within Savennières.
definition.zh: 独立 AOP + monopole，是 vineyard ownership、biodynamics 与 Chenin 深度学习的重要节点。

definition.en: Poor fruit set caused by flowers failing to develop into berries.
definition.zh: 开花至坐果期间花朵、子房或幼果异常脱落，导致坐果不足、果穗稀疏和潜在减产；可由天气、碳水化合物供应、品种及其他因素引起。

sources.title: INRAE — Grapevine abiotic disorders of stalk and bunch

definition.en: The British English name for zucchini, a summer squash with tender edible skin.
definition.zh: 英式英语中对西葫芦的称呼，美式英语通常说 zucchini；常见绿色嫩果可切片煎炒或烧烤。

examples.en: The grilled courgette is one of our vegetable sides.
examples.zh: 烤西葫芦是我们的一道蔬菜配菜。

definition.en: Licensed wine broker mediating between producers and merchants in Bordeaux.
definition.zh: 连接 château 与 négociant 的经纪角色，是波尔多交易体系的重要中介。

definition.en: Smooth and rich like cream, or containing cream.
definition.zh: 可指含奶油，也可只描述奶油般的绵滑口感。不能仅凭 creamy 判断是否含乳制品，需核对配方。

examples.en: It comes with a creamy sauce.
examples.zh: 它配有绵滑的酱汁。

zh: 加泰罗尼亚焦糖奶蛋甜点

definition.en: A chilled Catalan custard made with milk, egg yolks and starch, commonly flavoured with cinnamon and lemon peel, then topped with a thin caramelised sugar crust.
definition.zh: 加泰罗尼亚奶蛋甜点，以牛奶、蛋黄和淀粉在炉上煮至浓稠，常用肉桂和柠檬皮调香。冷却后通常在表面撒糖并烧成薄脆焦糖层。

examples.en: This chilled custard has lemon and cinnamon aromas beneath a crisp sugar topping.
examples.zh: 这款冷藏奶蛋甜点带有柠檬与肉桂香气，表层是薄脆焦糖。

definition.en: Traditional-method sparkling designation used by several European regional appellations.
definition.zh: Crémant 不是单一产区名称；法国多个区域 AOP 使用它，卢森堡及德国某些规定产区也可使用。各产区有自己的葡萄品种与酿造规则，核心是受规范的传统法起泡酒。

sources.title: Vins et Crémants de Luxembourg · Crémant

definition.en: Alsace traditional-method sparkling appellation.
definition.zh: Alsace 的 traditional-method sparkling AOP，品种组合与当地静态酒体系相关。

definition.en: Burgundy traditional-method sparkling appellation.
definition.zh: Bourgogne 的 traditional-method sparkling AOP，可使用当地主要葡萄，风格与 producer 差异明显。

definition.en: Traditional-method sparkling appellation from Limoux in southern France.
definition.zh: Limoux 重要 traditional-method category，需与 Blanquette de Limoux 及 ancestral styles 区分。

definition.en: Loire Valley traditional-method sparkling appellation.
definition.zh: 在 Loire 中部 Anjou、Saumur、Touraine、Cheverny 等规定地域生产的传统法白或桃红起泡酒 AOP；与 Saumur、Vouvray 自身的起泡酒产区名称分开理解。

definition.en: A baked egg-and-cream custard topped with a thin layer of caramelised sugar.
definition.zh: 以蛋和奶油等制成的烘烤蛋奶甜点，表面覆一层薄脆焦糖；常见香草味，也有其他风味版本。

sources.title: Le Cordon Bleu — Crème Brûlée with Rose

examples.en: The crème brûlée has a crisp caramel top and a smooth custard underneath.
examples.zh: 这道烤布蕾表层是脆焦糖，下面是细滑蛋奶布丁。

definition.en: A baked milk-and-egg custard turned out of its mould so the liquid caramel coats the top and pools around it.
definition.zh: 把牛奶、鸡蛋和糖调成布丁液，倒入底部铺有焦糖的模具，隔水烘烤凝固后冷藏。脱模倒扣时，焦糖成为流动酱汁；这与表面有脆糖壳、通常连烤皿上桌的 crème brûlée 不同。

sources.title: Chef Philippe / Meilleur du Chef — Classic crème caramel

examples.en: The crème caramel is a smooth vanilla custard with a light caramel sauce.
examples.zh: 这款焦糖布丁是顺滑的香草蛋奶布丁，配一层流动的焦糖酱。

definition.en: Thin crêpes warmed in an orange-butter sauce, usually flavoured with orange liqueur.
definition.zh: 薄可丽饼在橙香黄油酱中加热，常加入橙味利口酒；部分做法会点火焰烧，是否桌边完成须按餐厅说明。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Crêpes Suzette by the Galvin Brothers

examples.en: The crêpes Suzette are thin pancakes served warm in an orange-and-butter sauce.
examples.zh: 苏泽特可丽饼是薄饼，在橙香黄油酱中温热供应。

definition.en: Having a firm surface that breaks with a light crunch when bitten.
definition.zh: 咬下时有轻脆感，常用于描述炸物、烤皮等的口感；不代表唯一的烹调方式。

examples.en: The skin is crispy.
examples.zh: 外皮是酥脆的。

zh: 煎蛋火腿奶酪烤三明治

definition.en: A hot ham-and-cheese sandwich topped with a fried egg, often enriched with béchamel and browned under the grill.
definition.zh: 在热火腿奶酪三明治上加一枚煎蛋，常搭配贝夏梅尔白酱，再把表面奶酪烤至金黄。与 croque-monsieur 相比，煎蛋是最容易向客人说明的区别，常作为早午餐或简餐。

sources.title: Great British Chefs / Nancy Anne Harbord — Croque madame

examples.en: The croque-madame is a toasted ham-and-cheese sandwich with béchamel and a fried egg on top.
examples.zh: 这道煎蛋火腿奶酪烤三明治配贝夏梅尔白酱，顶部加一枚煎蛋。

zh: 法式火腿奶酪热三明治

definition.en: A hot ham-and-cheese sandwich, often enriched with béchamel and grilled or baked until golden.
definition.zh: 面包夹火腿与奶酪后煎烤或焗烤的热三明治，常加入白酱并使表面奶酪融化；与加煎蛋的版本区分。

examples.en: The croque-monsieur is a hot ham-and-cheese sandwich with a golden, melted-cheese topping.
examples.zh: 这道克罗克先生是火腿奶酪热三明治，上面有金黄融化奶酪。

definition.en: Spanish croquettes with chopped cured ham in a thick béchamel filling, coated in breadcrumbs and fried until the outside is crisp and the centre creamy.
definition.zh: 将切碎的风干火腿拌入浓稠的贝夏梅尔白酱，冷却成形后裹上面包糠油炸。外层酥脆、内馅柔滑；这里介绍的是西班牙白酱内馅版本。

sources.title: Basco Fine Foods — Spanish croquetas and their preparation
Basco Fine Foods — Serrano Ham Croquetas

examples.en: These ham croquettes have a crisp coating and a smooth, savoury filling.
examples.zh: 这些火腿可乐饼外层酥脆，内馅细滑咸香。

zh: 比利时北海灰虾可乐饼

definition.en: Belgian shrimp croquettes with a creamy filling, a breadcrumb crust and a deep-fried finish.
definition.zh: 将北海灰虾拌入浓稠的白酱类馅心，冷却定形后裹面包屑炸制。外壳酥脆，内馅柔润且有虾的鲜味，常配柠檬角和炸欧芹；这是比利时酒馆常见的前菜。

sources.title: Visit Brussels — Brussels culinary specialities: shrimp croquettes

examples.en: The shrimp croquettes have a crisp coating and a creamy shrimp filling.
examples.zh: 这款虾可乐饼外皮酥脆，内馅柔润，有鲜明的虾味。

definition.en: The unintended transfer of a food allergen from one food or surface to another.
definition.zh: 食物过敏原经器具、台面或其他食物意外转移的情况；即使菜谱未加入该原料，也需要核对厨房处理。

sources.title: Food Allergy Research & Education — Avoiding Cross-Contact

examples.en: I will ask the kitchen about ingredients and possible allergen cross-contact.
examples.zh: 我会向厨房确认原料，以及是否可能发生过敏原交叉接触。

definition.en: Médoc classification for artisan winegrowers closely involved in production and sales.
definition.zh: 官方 Bordeaux 页面显示当前 2022–2026 五年份名单含 33 estates；名单定期修订。

definition.en: Médoc quality classification distinct from the 1855 Classification.
definition.zh: 属于 Médoc 独立分级体系，制度会更新；不能把 Cru Bourgeois 与 1855 classified growth 当作同一套层级。

sources.title: Alliance des Crus Bourgeois du Médoc — 2025 classification

zh: 慕斯卡岱村庄级精选产区

definition.en: Recognized Muscadet Sèvre-et-Maine communal crus with stricter terroir and ageing requirements.
definition.zh: Muscadet Sèvre-et-Maine 中以获认可村镇地理名称标识的风土酒，需满足更严格的种植和较长酒泥熟成要求；不是普通 sur lie 标识的同义词。

sources.title: Fédération des Vins de Nantes · Crus communaux

definition.en: Breaking easily into small crumbs or fragments, as shortbread, some pastry and certain cheeses do.
definition.zh: 轻碰或咬下便容易散成小碎屑，常形容酥饼、部分饼皮或奶酪。crumbly 强调容易散碎；flaky 强调薄层分离，crunchy 则更突出咬碎时的脆响。

examples.en: The shortbread is crumbly, so we serve it beside the lemon cream.
examples.zh: 这款酥饼松酥易碎，因此我们把它放在柠檬奶油旁边。

definition.en: Firm enough to make a noticeable crunch when bitten, as with raw vegetables, toasted nuts or a crisp topping.
definition.zh: 咬下时有明显脆响和一定咀嚼阻力，常形容生蔬菜、烘烤坚果或脆粒配料。与 crispy 用法有重叠；crunchy 更突出咬碎时的脆响和嚼感，不能一律理解为油炸。

examples.en: The toasted almonds add a crunchy contrast to the soft pear.
examples.zh: 烘烤杏仁增加了爽脆口感，与软嫩的梨形成对比。

definition.en: Breaking grape skins to release juice and pulp.
definition.zh: 通过机械或其他方式使葡萄破裂以释放汁液并促进后续处理；是否破碎、破碎程度取决于酒型与工艺。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

en: cuisses de grenouilles à la persillade
aliases: frogs’ legs with garlic and parsley
frogs' legs with garlic and parsley

definition.en: Frogs’ legs cooked in butter with finely chopped garlic and parsley, commonly served with lemon.
definition.zh: 蛙腿轻裹粉后用黄油煎炒，再加入细切蒜和欧芹增香，常配柠檬角。Persillade 提示蒜与欧芹的组合；蛙腿肉质细嫩，介绍时可直接说明主料和调味。

sources.title: Académie du Goût — Cuisses de grenouilles en persillade
Bourg-en-Bresse tourism — Cuisses de grenouilles en persillade

examples.en: The frogs’ legs are cooked in butter with garlic and parsley, with lemon on the side.
examples.zh: 蛙腿用黄油、蒜和欧芹烹制，旁边配柠檬。

definition.en: A Scottish soup of smoked haddock, potato and onion, usually enriched with milk.
definition.zh: 苏格兰经典浓汤，用烟熏黑线鳕、土豆和洋葱熬煮，通常加入牛奶，部分做法再加奶油。既有烟熏鲜味也有土豆带来的稠度；鱼肉、汤底和装饰做法会因餐厅而异。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to Make Cullen Skink

examples.en: Cullen skink is a warming smoked-haddock soup with potatoes and onions.
examples.zh: 卡伦熏鱼汤是一道温热的烟熏黑线鳕浓汤，里面有土豆和洋葱。

definition.en: To treat food for preservation and flavour, commonly with salt and sometimes sugar, drying or smoking; curing need not involve heat-cooking.
definition.zh: 通过盐腌等处理改变食物风味、质地并用于保藏，具体做法可能涉及糖、风干或烟熏。菜单上的 cured 不保证经过加热，也不同于单纯用调味汁短时间腌味的 marinated。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — cured salmon recipes

examples.en: Our salmon is cured with salt, sugar and dill, then thinly sliced.
examples.zh: 我们的三文鱼用盐、糖和莳萝腌制，然后切成薄片。

definition.en: A cooked sausage, often sliced, topped with a tomato-based curry sauce or tomato sauce and curry powder. This German street-food dish is frequently served with chips.
definition.zh: 将煎或烤熟的香肠切段，浇上番茄咖喱酱，或番茄酱加咖喱粉，常配薯条供应的德国街头小吃。香肠种类及辣度因店而异。

examples.en: The sausage is served with a tomato-and-curry sauce and a portion of chips.
examples.zh: 香肠搭配番茄咖喱酱和一份薯条供应。

definition.en: The first pressing fraction in Champagne.
definition.zh: 香槟压榨中的第一段汁，与 taille 分开；通常具有更高酸度与更精细的结构。

definition.en: Beef slowly braised with wine, aromatics and vegetables until tender, with ingredients varying by region and cook.
definition.zh: 适合慢炖的牛肉与葡萄酒、香味蔬菜等长时间焖煮，常呈现浓郁肉汁与软嫩质地。有些配方加入橙、香草或腌肉；daube 是一类炖法与菜品，不能直接当成勃艮第炖牛肉的别名。

sources.title: Eric Chavot / Great British Chefs — Daube de boeuf

examples.en: Our beef daube is slowly braised in red wine with vegetables and a touch of orange.
examples.zh: 我们的炖牛肉以红酒、蔬菜和少许橙慢慢焖煮。

definition.en: To pour wine into another vessel, often to separate sediment or expose it to air.
definition.zh: 把酒倒入另一容器，常用于分离沉淀或增加空气接触。是否需要及操作方式取决于具体酒况。

examples.en: Would you like me to decant the wine?
examples.zh: 需要我为您换瓶醒酒吗？

definition.en: To add liquid to a hot pan and loosen browned cooking deposits into a sauce.
definition.zh: 向煎过食材的锅中加入酒、高汤或水，将锅底褐色焦香物溶出用于酱汁；不是把烧焦苦味刮入菜中。

examples.en: The chef deglazes the pan with stock to make the sauce.
examples.zh: 厨师加入高汤，溶解锅底焦香物来制作酱汁。

definition.en: Removal of yeast sediment collected at the bottle neck after riddling.
definition.zh: 在转瓶后去除瓶颈沉淀，随后通常进入 dosage 和 final closure。

definition.en: Happening later than the planned or expected time.
definition.zh: 比原定时间更晚。航班、订单、交通等可用 be delayed。

examples.en: My flight is delayed.
examples.zh: 我的航班延误了。

definition.en: Rack-and-return extraction technique during red fermentation.
