definition.zh: 先将发酵酒液完全或大部分排出，再回淋酒帽的红酒提取技术，可改变氧接触与萃取动力学。

definition.en: Pleasantly subtle rather than forceful in flavour or aroma; useful for gently flavoured fish, broths and vegetables.
definition.zh: 形容香气或味道细致、轻柔、不浓烈，常用于清汤、鱼类或蔬菜。它是对精细风味的正面表达，不等于 bland 的寡淡，也不说明口感软硬。

examples.en: The sole has a delicate flavour, so we serve the lemon sauce on the side.
examples.zh: 这款鳎鱼风味清雅，所以我们把柠檬酱放在旁边。

definition.en: A concentrated brown sauce, classically made by reducing brown stock together with espagnole sauce.
definition.zh: 经典做法将褐色高汤与西班牙酱共同浓缩，形成浓郁酱汁；现代厨房配方可能不同，应确认原料。

examples.en: The beef is finished with a spoonful of demi-glace.
examples.zh: 这道牛肉最后淋上少量半浓缩褐色酱汁。

definition.en: Sparkling-wine sweetness term for sugar content from 32 to 50 g/L.
definition.zh: Demi-Sec 是起泡酒甜度术语，含糖量 32–50 g/L，明显带甜；法文名称虽有“半干”之意，不能套用静态酒的半干标准。

definition.en: The act or scheduled time of leaving a place.
definition.zh: 出发或离开的时间；机场语境常指航班出发。departure time 与 boarding time（登机时间）不同。

examples.en: What time is departure?
examples.zh: 几点出发？

definition.en: Removing grape stems before or during processing.
definition.zh: 将果梗与浆果分离；保留或去除果梗会影响结构、香气、单宁和发酵动力学。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: Sekt produced in Germany entirely from German-grown grapes.
definition.zh: 德国酿造、葡萄全部来自德国的 Sekt；比泛称 Sekt 多了明确的德国原料与生产来源要求，不等于自动采用传统法。

definition.en: A need to include or avoid particular foods for health, religious, ethical, or other reasons.
definition.zh: 客人需要选择或避免某些食物的要求，可能涉及过敏、宗教或饮食习惯；需追问具体内容并准确传达厨房。

examples.en: Do you have any dietary requirements or food allergies we should know about?
examples.zh: 请问您有需要我们了解的饮食要求或食物过敏吗？

definition.en: An alcoholic drink served after a meal, such as a spirit or liqueur.
definition.zh: 用餐后饮用的酒，常见选择包括烈酒或利口酒；介绍的是饮用时机与风格，不应承诺它有助消化。

examples.en: Would you like to see our digestif selection after dessert?
examples.zh: 甜点之后，您想看看我们的餐后酒选择吗？

definition.en: A tender culinary herb widely used in northern and eastern European cooking. Its leaves flavour cured salmon, potato salads, pickles and yoghurt-based sauces or dips.
definition.zh: 叶片柔嫩的烹饪香草，在北欧及东欧菜肴中十分常见，常用于腌三文鱼、土豆沙拉、腌菜和酸奶酱。服务时可说明它是调味香草，细叶外观相近也不代表与茴香是同一种食材。

examples.en: Our cured salmon is flavoured with dill, which adds a fresh herbal note.
examples.zh: 我们的腌三文鱼用莳萝调味，带来清新的草本香气。

definition.en: Date on which a Champagne bottle was disgorged.
definition.zh: 一瓶香槟实施除渣的日期，通常为自愿标注。它反映酒泥接触结束的时间点，有助比较同一酒款不同除渣批次以及除渣后的瓶中发展。

sources.title: Comité Champagne · Understanding the Champagne label

en: Does this come with a side dish?

definition.en: A question about accompaniments supplied with a dish.
definition.zh: come with 在菜单语境中表示随主菜一起提供。客人用它确认是否有配菜；如果费用不明确，应再核对配菜是否包含在标价内。

sources.title: British Council · English for the World of Work: Tourism / Catering Services

examples.en: Does this come with a side dish, or should I order one separately?
examples.zh: 这道菜配有配菜吗，还是我需要另外点一份？

definition.en: Grape leaves wrapped around a filling, commonly rice, onions and herbs, then gently simmered with olive oil and lemon. Meat-filled versions also exist.
definition.zh: 将葡萄叶包成小卷，常见内馅是米、洋葱和香草，再加橄榄油及柠檬汁轻柔焖煮至米熟、叶片软嫩。也有含肉馅的版本。

examples.en: These tender grape leaves are rolled around rice and herbs, with a fresh lemon note.
examples.zh: 这些软嫩的葡萄叶包裹着米饭和香草，带有清新的柠檬风味。

definition.en: Estate-based Burgundy producer farming and bottling wines from owned or controlled vineyards.
definition.zh: 在勃艮第常指拥有/经营葡萄园并自行酿装的生产者，但 domaine bottling 不自动等于质量更高。

definition.en: Major river defining much of Bordeaux's Right Bank geography.
definition.zh: 右岸 Saint-Émilion、Pomerol 等产区理解的核心地理参照。

sources.title: CIVB — Bordeaux wine regions and appellations
Bordeaux Tourism and Convention Bureau — Bordeaux Métropole, Garonne/Dordogne confluence

definition.en: French for golden. In Aligoté Doré it describes a type within Aligoté, particularly associated with Bouzeron, rather than a separate grape variety.
definition.zh: 法语意为“金色的”。Aligoté Doré 指 Aligoté 内部的一种类型，尤其与 Bouzeron 相关，并非独立葡萄品种。

definition.en: Final sweetness adjustment after disgorgement using expedition liqueur.
definition.zh: 除渣后通过 liqueur d’expédition 调整最终甜度与风格的工序。Brut Nature、Extra Brut、Brut 等依最终含糖量及适用条件标示；dosage 量本身不等于最终含糖量。

definition.en: A vine disease caused by the oomycete Plasmopara viticola. Warm, wet conditions favour infection of green tissues, including leaves and young fruit.
definition.zh: 由卵菌 Plasmopara viticola 引起的葡萄病害。温暖潮湿条件有利于其侵染叶片及幼果等绿色组织。

sources.title: UC IPM · Downy Mildew of Grape

definition.en: The capacity of soil and site to remove excess water.
definition.zh: 决定根区是否容易积水与缺氧，也影响根系分布、长势和水分供应稳定性。

sources.title: Penn State Extension — Wine Grape Production
Oregon State University Extension — Soil-plant-water relationships

definition.en: Wine with low residual sugar relative to its style and applicable definition.
definition.zh: 通常因发酵消耗大部分可发酵糖而呈低残糖；具体“干型”阈值依法规和类别而异。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

examples.en: This wine is dry, not sweet.
examples.zh: 这款酒是干型的，不甜。

definition.en: Duck, commonly the leg, cured and slowly cooked in fat, often crisped before serving.
definition.zh: 鸭肉通常先盐渍再于油脂中缓慢烹调，常选鸭腿，上桌前可再使皮变脆；与直接烤鸭的做法不同。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Duck Confit with Red Cabbage

examples.en: The duck confit is tender inside, with crisp skin.
examples.zh: 这道油封鸭内部软嫩，外皮酥脆。

definition.en: Suggesting soil or woodland in aroma and flavour; a familiar positive descriptor for mushrooms and some root vegetables.
definition.zh: 香气或味道让人联想到泥土、林地，介绍菌菇时经常是正面描述。它不是说菜里带泥，也不等于苦味；服务时最好点明产生这种气息的食材，帮助客人理解。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — how to cook mushrooms

examples.en: The mushrooms give the risotto an earthy depth of flavour.
examples.zh: 菌菇让这款烩饭有了带林地气息的深厚风味。

definition.en: An elongated choux pastry filled with chocolate pastry cream and finished with a chocolate-flavoured glaze.
definition.zh: 长条形泡芙外壳烤出空心后，填入巧克力卡仕达酱，表面覆上巧克力风味糖霜或淋面。Éclair 强调长条形泡芙的形态，au chocolat 则说明馅料和表层的巧克力风味。

sources.title: Chef Philippe / Meilleur du Chef — Éclair au chocolat

examples.en: The chocolate éclair is filled with chocolate pastry cream and topped with a glossy glaze.
examples.zh: 这款巧克力闪电泡芙内填巧克力卡仕达酱，表面覆有亮泽淋面。

definition.en: Poached eggs on English muffins with ham or bacon and hollandaise sauce.
definition.zh: 常见早午餐菜：英式松饼上放火腿或培根、水波蛋，再淋荷兰酱。以菠菜或烟熏三文鱼替换肉类的近似菜式有自己的名称，服务介绍应说清实际配料。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Eggs Florentine: Benedict and Royale Variants

examples.en: Our eggs Benedict come on English muffins with ham, poached eggs and hollandaise.
examples.zh: 我们的班尼迪克蛋配英式松饼、火腿、水波蛋和荷兰酱。

definition.en: Poached eggs and spinach on toasted English muffins, topped with hollandaise.
definition.zh: 在烤过的英式松饼上铺熟菠菜和水波蛋，再淋荷兰酱的早午餐做法。它与 Eggs Benedict 的常见区别是用菠菜替代火腿；Florentine 在这类菜单语境中提示菠菜元素。荷兰酱带黄油香和轻微酸味。

sources.title: Sally Abé / Great British Chefs — Eggs Florentine

examples.en: Eggs Florentine comes with spinach, poached eggs and hollandaise on an English muffin.
examples.zh: 这道菠菜水波蛋以英式松饼垫底，配菠菜、水波蛋和荷兰酱。

definition.en: The cellar maturation of wine, including choices of vessel and lees contact. The term does not imply oak ageing: élevage can take place in inert vessels.
definition.zh: 葡萄酒在酒窖中的熟成，涉及容器选择、酒泥接触等操作。该词不必然指橡木桶熟成，也可在惰性容器中进行。

sources.title: WSET · Level 3 Award in Wines specification
WSET · Why do we age wine?

definition.en: A covered Galician savoury pie with a filling such as fish or shellfish and cooked vegetables.
definition.zh: 西班牙加利西亚的咸馅烤派：两层面皮包住炒制的馅料，封边后烤熟，通常切块上桌。馅料选择很多，沿海常见鱼或贝类搭配洋葱、甜椒等；介绍时应说清当天使用的馅料。

sources.title: Turismo de Vigo — Empanada de zamburiñas

examples.en: This is a slice of Galician savoury pie; today’s filling is scallops and vegetables.
examples.zh: 这是一块加利西亚咸馅派，今天的馅料是扇贝和蔬菜。

definition.en: To disperse one liquid through another that normally separates from it, forming a combined mixture.
definition.zh: 使原本不易相混的液体细密分散在一起，常见于油和水的混合；可用于解释蛋黄酱或黄油酱的质地。

examples.en: The butter is gradually emulsified into the sauce.
examples.zh: 黄油逐步拌入并乳化到酱汁中。

definition.en: Bordeaux futures system in which wines are sold while still ageing before physical delivery.
definition.zh: 通常基于桶样进行 campaign，随后通过 Bordeaux trade 分配并在未来交付成酒。

sources.title: Union des Grands Crus de Bordeaux — Understanding en primeur

definition.en: Cooked white chicory wrapped in ham, covered with a white or cheese sauce and browned on top.
definition.zh: 将煮软或焖软的白菊苣包入火腿，淋白酱或奶酪白酱，再烤至表面金黄。白菊苣带轻微苦味，火腿与乳酪带咸鲜；该菜也常见于比利时，分类不代表专属起源。

sources.title: Chef Henry Harris / Nigella guest recipes — Endive Au Gratin
Bruno Albouze — Endives With Ham Gratin

examples.en: The chicory is wrapped in ham, covered with cheese sauce and browned under the grill.
examples.zh: 白菊苣用火腿包裹，淋上奶酪酱，再烤至表面金黄。

definition.en: English PDO quality sparkling wine made by the traditional method.
definition.zh: 英格兰 PDO 品质起泡酒，采用传统法；Chardonnay、Pinot Noir 与 Meunier 是重要品种。English 指英格兰，不能泛指英国各地的所有起泡酒，也不应与 Welsh PDO 混为一谈。

sources.title: UK Government · Quality wine schemes: sparkling wines, 2025
UK Government · English wine PDO specification

zh: 西班牙式俄式土豆沙拉

definition.en: A chilled potato salad with mayonnaise and diced vegetables, often including tuna and boiled eggs.
definition.zh: 煮熟土豆与胡萝卜、豌豆等切小块后拌蛋黄酱冷食，西班牙常见版本还加金枪鱼和水煮蛋。虽名为沙拉，并不自动代表素食；这里收录西班牙菜单中的常见版本。

sources.title: Real Academia de Gastronomía — Ensaladilla rusa

examples.en: Our ensaladilla rusa is a chilled potato salad with tuna, egg and mayonnaise.
examples.zh: 我们的俄式土豆沙拉冷食，配有金枪鱼、鸡蛋和蛋黄酱。

definition.en: Bordeaux region between the Garonne and Dordogne; its AOP covers dry whites and, since 2023, reds.
definition.zh: 地理上位于 Garonne 与 Dordogne 两河之间，长期以 Sauvignon Blanc、Sémillon 等混酿干白著称；Entre-Deux-Mers AOP 自 2023 年起也包括红葡萄酒。地理区域与具体 AOP 的边界和产品规则应分别理解。

sources.title: CIVB — Entre-Deux-Mers, dry whites and reds since 2023

zh: 主菜〔美式〕／前菜〔法语菜单〕

definition.en: In American English, the main course; in French menu usage, a starter before the main course.
definition.zh: 美式英语菜单通常指主菜，法语及部分其他餐饮语境可指前菜；服务时应结合菜单地区与课程顺序解释。

examples.en: On this menu, entrée means the main course.
examples.zh: 在这份菜单上，entrée 指的是主菜。

definition.en: A Catalan dish of vegetables, especially aubergines and red peppers, roasted until tender, peeled and cut into strips, then dressed with olive oil and often garlic.
definition.zh: 加泰罗尼亚风味蔬菜菜肴，常用茄子和红甜椒，先炭烤或烤箱烤软，再去皮切条，以橄榄油、盐及常见的蒜末调味。

examples.en: Escalivada is a dish of soft roasted aubergines and peppers dressed with olive oil.
examples.zh: 这道烤蔬菜以软嫩的茄子和甜椒为主，淋橄榄油调味。

definition.en: Cooked snails reheated with garlic-and-parsley butter, often baked and served in their shells.
definition.zh: 煮熟蜗牛配蒜、欧芹和黄油再入炉加热，常装回壳中供应；名称描述做法，不保证蜗牛的实际养殖产地。

examples.en: The snails are baked with garlic and parsley butter and served hot.
examples.zh: 这些蜗牛配蒜香欧芹黄油烤热后供应。

definition.en: A Catalan boiled dinner in which the broth is commonly served as soup before the meats and vegetables.
definition.zh: 由多种肉类、香肠、鹰嘴豆和蔬菜久煮成的汤锅，可能包含肉丸。传统上先用肉汤煮面作汤，随后上肉与蔬菜；食材组合和面条形状并不固定。

examples.en: We serve the noodle soup first, followed by the meats, chickpeas and vegetables.
examples.zh: 我们先上汤面，再上肉类、鹰嘴豆和蔬菜。

definition.en: A broad class of compounds contributing many fruity fermentation aromas.
definition.zh: 许多酯由酵母发酵生成，常带香蕉、梨、草莓、桃等果香；不少酯在陈年中会逐渐下降。

sources.title: UC Davis — Fermentation off-characters and ester formation

zh: 伊顿草莓蛋白霜奶油甜点

definition.en: A dessert combining fruit, broken meringue and whipped cream.
definition.zh: 经典版本把草莓、掰碎的蛋白霜饼和打发奶油拌合，形成松散而非整齐分层的甜点。也有其他莓果或季节水果版本；mess 在此是菜名的一部分，并非服务差错。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Weathering the Summer with Eton Mess

examples.en: Our Eton mess brings together strawberries, whipped cream and crisp pieces of meringue.
examples.zh: 我们的伊顿甜点把草莓、打发奶油和酥脆蛋白霜碎组合在一起。

definition.en: In work and planning, the process of putting a plan into practice.
definition.zh: 工作语境指把计划落实为行动的过程，常用 execution of a plan。该词也有其他含义，划词时应结合语境。

examples.en: The plan is clear; execution matters now.
examples.zh: 计划已经明确，现在关键是落实。

definition.en: Sparkling-wine sweetness term for sugar content from 0 to 6 g/L.
definition.zh: Extra Brut 是起泡酒甜度术语，欧盟标准含糖量为 0–6 g/L，包括 6 g/L；不要写成低于 6 g/L。它也不等于 Brut Nature，因为后者另有二次发酵后不得加糖的条件。

definition.en: Sparkling-wine sweetness term for sugar content from 12 to 17 g/L.
definition.zh: Extra-Dry / Extra Sec 是起泡酒甜度术语，含糖量 12–17 g/L；名称容易误导，实际通常比 Brut 更甜。

zh: 阿斯图里亚斯白豆炖肉

definition.en: An Asturian stew of large white beans slowly cooked with pork and cured meats, commonly chorizo, morcilla and bacon or pork shoulder.
definition.zh: 阿斯图里亚斯的白豆炖菜，以大颗白豆配猪肉及腌制肉类慢炖。常见配料包括红椒香肠、血肠，以及猪肩肉或培根，炖至豆子软糯。

sources.title: Spain Tourism — Fabada, Asturian bean stew

examples.en: Fabada is a hearty white-bean stew with pork and cured sausages.
examples.zh: 法巴达是一道浓厚的白豆炖菜，配有猪肉和腌制香肠。

zh: 威尼斯式洋葱炒小牛肝

definition.en: Calf’s liver cooked with softened onions, a classic Venetian combination.
definition.zh: 以小牛肝和炒软的洋葱为主的威尼斯菜，洋葱甜味与肝脏的浓郁风味相配；常用黄油、油及欧芹，有的版本以酒或醋调味，并配玉米糊。Fegato 指肝脏，需要清楚告知客人这是一道内脏菜。

sources.title: Ristorante Marciana Venice — Fegato alla Veneziana
Chef Gian Petro Ferro — Fegato alla Veneziana, La Cucina Italiana

examples.en: The fegato alla Veneziana is calf’s liver with softened onions, served here with polenta.
examples.zh: 这道威尼斯式小牛肝搭配炒软的洋葱，我们这里配玉米糊供应。

definition.en: An aromatic plant used for its crisp bulb, feathery leaves or seeds. Its anise-like flavour works in salads, roasted vegetables, fish dishes and sausage seasoning.
definition.zh: 带有类似茴香酒香气的植物，菜单中的 fennel 可能指脆嫩的球状基部、细叶或籽。球茴香可切薄片做沙拉，也可烤制或焖煮；向客人介绍时，应说明本菜使用哪个部位。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook fennel

examples.en: The fish comes with shaved fennel, which adds a crisp texture and a gentle anise flavour.
examples.zh: 这道鱼配茴香薄片，口感脆爽，带有淡淡的茴香香气。

definition.en: Conversion of fermentable sugar by microorganisms, principally yeast.
definition.zh: 葡萄酒语境中通常指酵母把糖转化为酒精、CO₂及其他代谢产物的酒精发酵。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: In grape-variety descriptions, the ability to form fruit-bearing shoots and inflorescences. Bud fruitfulness is often expressed as clusters per shoot and differs from fruit set; soil fertility is a different use of fertility.
definition.zh: 葡萄品种描述中的结实能力，指形成带果新梢与花序的能力。芽眼结实能力常以每梢花序或果穗数表示，与开花后的坐果率不同；soil fertility 则指土壤肥力。

sources.title: Cornell CALS · Bud Fruitfulness and Yield

definition.en: A Valencian noodle dish cooked in a wide pan with fish stock and seafood, commonly prawns, cuttlefish and fish. The noodles absorb the seasoned cooking liquid.
definition.zh: 瓦伦西亚风味面食，以短面条替代米饭，在宽锅中与鱼高汤、虾、墨鱼及鱼肉等海鲜一起烹煮，让面条吸收汤汁。具体海鲜组合可变化。

examples.en: Fideuà is a seafood noodle dish cooked in fish stock in a wide pan.
examples.zh: 这是一道在宽锅中以鱼高汤烹煮的海鲜面。

definition.en: To cut flesh away from fish or meat bones; the noun also names the resulting boneless piece.
definition.zh: 作动词指沿骨骼把鱼肉或肉切下、整理成肉片；作名词指这样的去骨肉块。菜单上的 filleted 描述处理方式，不宜据此向客人承诺绝无细小残刺。

examples.en: The chef fillets the sea bass before pan-frying it.
examples.zh: 主厨先把海鲈鱼去骨取片，再下锅香煎。

definition.en: Extremely thin sheets of pastry layered with fat before baking. They create a delicate, crackly crust in sweet and savoury dishes such as baklava and spanakopita.
definition.zh: 薄如纸张的面皮，通常逐张刷油脂并铺叠后烘烤，形成细薄而脆的外层。可用于甜味的巴克拉瓦，也用于菠菜奶酪派；它依靠叠放薄片形成层次，口感与起酥面皮不同。

sources.title: Institute of Culinary Education — Four types of pastry dough

examples.en: The spinach filling is wrapped in layers of filo pastry for a light, crisp finish.
examples.zh: 菠菜馅包在多层菲罗薄面皮中，烤后轻薄酥脆。

definition.en: Removal of particles and/or microorganisms by passing wine through a filter medium.
definition.zh: 通过过滤介质去除颗粒和/或微生物，目的取决于介质和孔径；并非所有过滤都能除菌，名义过滤与绝对过滤的截留保证也不同。

sources.title: AWRI — Filtration, physical removal of microorganisms

definition.en: Small French cakes made with ground almonds, egg whites and browned butter, traditionally baked in rectangular moulds.
definition.zh: 以杏仁粉、蛋白和焦化黄油为主要特色的小蛋糕，质地湿润，常带坚果与黄油香。传统长方形像小金条，但也有圆形及水果版本；不要因为颜色或形状相近就把它当作玛德琳。

examples.en: The financiers are small almond cakes with a nutty flavour from browned butter.
examples.zh: 费南雪是杏仁小蛋糕，焦化黄油带来类似坚果的香气。

definition.en: Addition of a fining agent to bind and remove selected wine components.
definition.zh: 加入特定澄清剂以吸附或沉淀蛋白、酚类、苦涩/涩感或其他目标物质；不同澄清剂作用对象不同。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: Squash or courgette flowers filled with a savoury mixture, then fried or baked.
definition.zh: 将可食用的瓜花填入咸味馅料后炸或烤，常见奶酪、凤尾鱼组合，也有其他版本。Ripieni 只表示填馅，不能由菜名推断一定没有鱼或肉；服务时应说明馅料和烹调方式。

examples.en: The courgette flowers are stuffed with ricotta and anchovy, then fried until crisp.
examples.zh: 这些西葫芦花填入瑞可塔和凤尾鱼后炸至酥脆。

definition.en: Highest red-wine tier in the 1855 Classification.
definition.zh: 当前学习节点包括 Lafite Rothschild、Latour、Margaux、Haut-Brion、Mouton Rothschild；1973 Mouton 晋升是关键历史点。

definition.en: White-fish fillets coated in batter and deep-fried, served with fried potato chips. The fish, batter and sides vary; mushy peas are a familiar accompaniment.
definition.zh: 白肉鱼排裹面糊油炸，搭配炸薯条的英式菜肴。鱼种、面糊及配菜会因餐厅而异，常见搭配包括豌豆泥；这里的 chips 指薯条。

sources.title: Jamie Oliver — Homemade fish and chips

examples.en: The fish has a crisp batter coating and comes with chunky fried potatoes.
examples.zh: 鱼排外裹酥脆面糊，配有粗切炸薯条。

definition.en: Fish in a creamy sauce baked under a mashed-potato topping.
definition.zh: 将鱼肉放入奶香白酱，上面铺土豆泥后入炉烤至金黄的英式主菜。可组合白肉鱼、三文鱼及贝类，重点是柔嫩鱼肉、浓滑酱汁和土豆泥顶层。此处 pie 的典型版本用土豆泥作顶，而不是完整的酥皮外壳。

sources.title: Tom Aikens / Great British Chefs — Fish Pie

examples.en: Our fish pie has a creamy sauce and a golden mashed-potato topping.
examples.zh: 我们的鱼肉派配奶香浓酱，上覆烤至金黄的土豆泥。

definition.en: Separating readily into thin pieces or layers; useful for describing baked pastry and the texture of cooked fish.
definition.zh: 轻轻掰开便分成薄片或薄层的口感，常用于酥皮和熟鱼肉。介绍酥皮时强调层次，介绍鱼肉时强调分片的质地；它描述结构，并不单独说明是否多汁。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — how to cook cod

examples.en: The tart has a flaky pastry base with a warm apple filling.
examples.zh: 这款挞的酥皮底层次分明，里面是温热的苹果馅。

definition.en: One of the 10 Beaujolais Crus.
definition.zh: 常作为较芳香、花香型的 cru 学习 anchor；具体风格仍需结合 lieu-dit 与 producer。

definition.en: The stage when grapevine flowers open and pollination/fertilization occur.
definition.zh: 决定后续坐果的重要阶段；低温、降雨等不良条件可增加坐果问题。

sources.title: New Mexico State University — Grapevine Growth and Phenology

definition.en: An Italian flatbread, commonly a dimpled, yeast-raised loaf baked with olive oil and salt.
definition.zh: 意式扁面包，常见款以发酵面团压出凹点、淋橄榄油烤制，内里松软；厚薄、顶部配料和地区做法各异。

examples.en: The focaccia is an olive-oil bread with a soft centre and a lightly crisp surface.
examples.zh: 这款佛卡夏是橄榄油面包，内里松软、表面略脆。

definition.en: To take further action or make contact after an earlier action.
definition.zh: 在先前沟通或处理后继续跟进。常用 follow up with someone、follow up on something。

examples.en: I’ll follow up with the supplier.
examples.zh: 我会跟供应商跟进。

definition.en: Wine whose alcoholic strength is increased by addition of spirit.
definition.zh: 在生产过程中加入烈酒以提高酒精度的葡萄酒类别；加烈发生时机决定其对残糖与风格的影响。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: A large wooden wine vessel, commonly oak, used for vinification or maturation. Capacity varies; the word does not specify one standard volume.
definition.zh: 用于酿造或熟成的大型木制容器，常为橡木。容量不一，该词不对应唯一标准容积。

zh: 波尔图肉馅芝士三明治

definition.en: A substantial Porto sandwich filled with meats, covered in melted cheese and a rich sauce.
definition.zh: 两片面包之间夹牛排、火腿和香肠等肉类，外覆融化芝士并浇浓酱汁。通常盛盘食用，肉类组合、酱汁配方及是否加煎蛋因店而异。

sources.title: Visit Porto — Eat at the local tasco

examples.en: The francesinha is a filling meat sandwich covered with melted cheese and our house sauce.
examples.zh: Francesinha 是一份饱足的肉馅三明治，外面覆有融化芝士和本店酱汁。

definition.en: Traditional-method sparkling appellation in Lombardia.
definition.zh: 意大利 Lombardia 的传统法起泡酒产区，Chardonnay 与 Pinot Nero 是重要品种；不同酒款类别分别受品种、熟成及风格规则约束。

definition.en: White Franciacorta style with lower bottle pressure and Brut dosage.
definition.zh: 以 Chardonnay 为主，可含受限比例 Pinot Bianco；maximum 5 atm，minimum 24 months lees，风格更柔滑。

definition.en: Grape liquid drained without pressing; called free-run juice before fermentation and free-run wine after fermentation.
definition.zh: 在不施加压榨压力的情况下排出的葡萄液体；未发酵时称自流汁，发酵后称自流酒。通常与压榨部分分别处理或评估，二者不是仅按“强压/轻压”区分。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: Bread soaked in an egg-and-milk mixture, then pan-fried until golden.
definition.zh: 将较厚的面包片吸足鸡蛋与牛奶混合液，再用黄油煎至表面金黄、内部柔软。美式早午餐常做成甜味，配枫糖浆或莓果；学菜名时重点记住它是浸蛋奶液后煎成的面包。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to Make French Toast

examples.en: Our French toast is golden outside and soft in the centre.
examples.zh: 我们的法式吐司外面金黄，中心柔软。

definition.en: An assortment of seafood lightly coated with flour or semolina and fried until crisp.
definition.zh: 将鱼、鱿鱼、虾等海鲜薄裹粉或粗粒小麦粉后炸脆，通常拼盘上桌；具体海鲜组合随供应变化。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — Fritto Misto by Pasquale Torrente

examples.en: The seafood fritto misto is a crisp mixed platter; I can explain today's selection.
examples.zh: 这道意式混合炸海鲜口感酥脆，我可以介绍今天拼盘里的种类。

definition.en: Italian term for lightly sparkling wine at lower pressure than spumante.
definition.zh: 低压力起泡类别，可见于 Prosecco、Lambrusco、Moscato d’Asti 等不同语境。

sources.title: Consorzio Prosecco DOC · Types of Prosecco

definition.en: The stage after flowering when flowers develop into young grape berries.
definition.zh: 花后形成幼果的阶段，受授粉、受精、品种、生长和环境条件影响，对最终穗重和产量重要；并非每朵花都会坐果，也不能把所有幼果限定为有籽果。

sources.title: New Mexico State University — Grapevine Growth and Phenology

definition.en: A cooked breakfast plate with eggs, bacon, sausages, toast and a selection of hot accompaniments.
definition.zh: 把鸡蛋、培根、香肠和吐司，与番茄、茄汁焗豆、蘑菇等热食组合成一盘的早餐。鸡蛋可煎、炒或水波煮，部分版本还配黑布丁血肠。服务时可先介绍本店包含哪些项目，再询问客人喜欢的鸡蛋做法。

sources.title: Good Food — What Is a Full English Breakfast?
Galton Blackiston / James Martin — Full English Breakfast for One

examples.en: How would you like the eggs with your full English breakfast?
examples.zh: 您的全套英式早餐，鸡蛋想要什么做法？

definition.en: A Greek phyllo pastry filled with semolina custard and finished with syrup.
definition.zh: 薄酥皮 phyllo 中夹入以牛奶、鸡蛋和细粒粗麦粉煮成的奶馅，烤好后浇糖浆。外层酥皮与柔软奶馅形成层次，常有柠檬或香草香气；它不同于以坚果为主要夹馅的 baklava。

examples.en: Galaktoboureko has a soft semolina custard inside crisp layers of phyllo.
examples.zh: Galaktoboureko 的酥皮层内是柔软的粗麦粉奶馅。

definition.en: Principal red grape of Beaujolais.
definition.zh: Beaujolais 核心红葡萄，可从轻盈果味型到结构强、可陈年的 Cru Beaujolais；与 granite soils、semi-carbonic vinification 常形成经典连接。

definition.en: A hot tapa of prawns quickly sautéed in olive oil with sliced garlic and usually a little dried chilli. Some versions finish with parsley or a splash of brandy.
definition.zh: 常见的热塔帕斯：虾与蒜片在橄榄油中快速煎炒，通常用少量干辣椒提味。有些版本还加入欧芹或少许白兰地。

sources.title: Louisiana Seafood — Gambas al Ajillo by José Andrés

examples.en: The prawns are quickly cooked with garlic, olive oil and a touch of chilli.
examples.zh: 这道虾用蒜、橄榄油和少许辣椒快速烹制。

definition.en: Major river flowing through Bordeaux and joining the Dordogne to form the Gironde.
definition.zh: 构成波尔多地理与甜酒区气候理解的重要河流；Graves、Sauternes 等位于其左岸体系。

sources.title: CIVB — Bordeaux wine regions and appellations
Bordeaux Tourism and Convention Bureau — Bordeaux Métropole, Garonne/Dordogne confluence

definition.en: A round cake with a buttery, short-textured outer dough enclosing pastry cream or black-cherry jam.
definition.zh: 以带黄油香、近似酥饼口感的面团包住馅料烘烤成圆形蛋糕，常见馅料为卡仕达酱或黑樱桃果酱。它与常说的焦黑表面巴斯克芝士蛋糕不同；菜单介绍宜明确说明所用馅料。

sources.title: Chef Philippe / Meilleur du Chef — Gâteau basque
Chef Philippe / Meilleur du Chef — Gâteau basque à l’ancienne

examples.en: Our gâteau basque has a buttery crust and a vanilla pastry-cream filling.
examples.zh: 我们的巴斯克夹馅蛋糕外层带黄油香，内馅是香草卡仕达酱。

definition.en: A chilled Spanish soup usually blending tomatoes and other vegetables with olive oil and vinegar.
definition.zh: 通常以番茄、其他蔬菜、橄榄油和醋打制的西班牙冷汤；部分配方加入面包，因此不能直接说成无麸质。

examples.en: The gazpacho is served chilled; I will check whether our recipe contains bread.
examples.zh: 这道西班牙番茄冷汤冷食供应，我会确认本店配方是否含面包。

definition.en: Vegetables such as tomatoes and peppers filled with rice and herbs, then baked.
definition.zh: 把番茄、甜椒等挖空，填入带香草和蔬菜的米馅，再一同烤至软熟。米粒吸收蔬菜汁液，常能吃到薄荷或欧芹的清香；也存在加肉的版本，不能只凭菜名判断是否含肉。

sources.title: Akis Petretzikis — Greek stuffed vegetables with rice and ground meat

examples.en: Our gemista are tomatoes and peppers filled with rice and fresh herbs.
examples.zh: 我们的 gemista 是填入米饭和新鲜香草后烤制的番茄与甜椒。

definition.en: Major Côte de Nuits village appellation renowned for Pinot Noir.
definition.zh: Côte de Nuits 核心村之一，连接 Chambertin、Clos de Bèze 等多个 Grand Crus。

definition.en: A Basque pintxo of anchovy, pickled green pepper and green olive on a small skewer.
definition.zh: 将腌青椒 piparra、鳀鱼和绿橄榄穿在小签上的巴斯克开胃小吃。重点是橄榄与鳀鱼的咸鲜，以及腌椒的酸味；是小份冷食，不需要面包作底。

sources.title: Lasala Plaza Hotel — Pintxos in San Sebastian: Gilda

examples.en: Each Gilda has an anchovy, pickled green pepper and a green olive.
examples.zh: 每串吉尔达都有鳀鱼、腌青椒和绿橄榄。

definition.en: A Greek meat-and-pasta casserole, commonly made with beef or lamb, tomato and orzo.
definition.zh: 将牛肉或羊肉与番茄炖软，再与米粒面 orzo 一起烤制或焖熟，面粒吸收肉汁和酱汁。虽然外形像米饭，orzo 实际是意大利面的一种；上桌时可撒硬质奶酪碎。

sources.title: Argiro Barbarigou — Lamb giouvetsi baked in the oven
Akis Petretzikis — Greek beef and orzo casserole

examples.en: The lamb giouvetsi comes with orzo pasta cooked in the tomato and meat juices.
examples.zh: 这道羊肉 giouvetsi 配米粒面，面粒吸收了番茄和羊肉的汁液。

definition.en: The estuary formed by the confluence of the Garonne and Dordogne rivers.
definition.zh: 波尔多最重要的地理骨架之一；其西侧为 Médoc，水体对局地气候具有调节作用。

sources.title: CIVB — Bordeaux wine regions and appellations
Bordeaux Tourism and Convention Bureau — Bordeaux Métropole, Garonne/Dordogne confluence

definition.en: To coat food with a layer that gives it shine, using ingredients such as syrup, egg wash or a reduced sauce.
definition.zh: 在食物表面形成有光泽的薄层，可用糖浆、蛋液或浓缩酱汁，既用于甜点，也用于肉类和蔬菜。glazed 不一定是甜味，更不等于所有浇在盘中的酱汁。

examples.en: The carrots are glazed with a little honey and butter.
examples.zh: 这份胡萝卜裹上了少量蜂蜜和黄油形成的亮面薄汁。

definition.en: Principal grape of Prosecco.
definition.zh: Prosecco 核心白葡萄，适合以 tank method 保留其花香、梨、苹果等 primary aromas。

zh: 罗马式焗粗粒小麦圆饼

definition.en: Semolina cooked with milk, cooled and cut into discs, then baked with butter and cheese.
definition.zh: 粗粒小麦粉与牛奶煮稠，冷却后切成圆片，再加黄油和奶酪焗烤。它虽叫 gnocchi，却不是常见的土豆面团小丸子；圆片的表面可烤成金黄，配菜由餐厅决定。

sources.title: Chef Giovanni Rota — Gnocchi alla Romana, La Cucina Italiana cooking school

examples.en: These Roman-style gnocchi are baked semolina discs with butter and cheese.
examples.zh: 这款罗马式 gnocchi 是用粗粒小麦粉做的圆片，加黄油和奶酪焗烤。

zh: 索伦托番茄乳酪焗团子

definition.en: Potato gnocchi combined with tomato sauce, mozzarella, and basil, then baked until the cheese melts.
definition.zh: 土豆团子与番茄酱、马苏里拉及罗勒混合后焗烤，奶酪融化并连起酱汁，口感柔软而浓润。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — Gnocchi alla Sorrentina by Valeria Necchio

examples.en: The gnocchi are baked with tomato sauce, mozzarella, and basil.
examples.zh: 这些意式团子与番茄酱、马苏里拉乳酪和罗勒一起焗烤。

definition.en: Soft ricotta-based dumplings, sometimes with leafy greens, cooked without an enclosing pasta sheet.
definition.zh: 以瑞可塔奶酪为基础的柔软团子，可加入菠菜等绿叶菜，通常水煮后配黄油或其他酱汁。常被形容为没有外层面皮的意式饺馅；即使没有面皮，配方仍可能有面粉、面包屑或粗粒小麦粉。

examples.en: The gnudi are delicate ricotta dumplings, served with sage butter.
examples.zh: 这道 gnudi 是柔软的瑞可塔奶酪团子，配鼠尾草黄油。

definition.en: Soft and sticky, sometimes flowing slightly; often an appealing description of melted cheese, caramel or a dessert centre.
definition.zh: 质地软黏，有时会轻微流动，常用于融化的奶酪、焦糖或甜品夹心。这个词可以是诱人的正面描述，并不等于食物没有煮熟，也不保证一定能拉丝。

examples.en: The warm brownie has a gooey chocolate centre.
examples.zh: 这款温热的布朗尼有软黏浓厚的巧克力内心。

definition.en: Small savoury choux-pastry puffs with grated cheese mixed into the dough.
definition.zh: 在泡芙面糊中加入磨碎奶酪，烤成蓬松的咸味小点，常作为开胃小食。它与夹奶油的甜泡芙不同；奶酪种类会变，且常见版本本身没有夹馅。

sources.title: Simon Hulstone / Great British Chefs — Gougères
Galton Blackiston / Great British Chefs — Gruyère gougères

examples.en: The gougères are warm, savoury cheese puffs with a light, airy centre.
examples.zh: 这些奶酪泡芙温热供应，带咸香奶酪味，内部轻盈蓬松。

definition.en: Joining a scion to a rootstock so they grow as one vine.
definition.zh: 将目标葡萄品种的接穗连接到砧木上，使两者愈合并共同生长；现代葡萄栽培中常用于获得抗根瘤蚜等根系优势，同时保留 Vitis vinifera 的果实特征。

sources.title: Oregon State University — Grape phylloxera biology and management
Penn State Extension — Backyard grape growing

definition.en: Highest tier in Burgundy's appellation hierarchy.
definition.zh: 在勃艮第，Grand Cru 是最高产区等级，每个 Grand Cru 本身为独立 AOC，分布于 Côte d’Or 与 Chablis；不能把这个定义直接套用于所有法国地区。

definition.en: An estate's principal wine, especially in Bordeaux château usage.
definition.zh: 通常指 château 的主力/最高定位 cuvée，但不是统一法定 classification。

sources.title: Château Margaux — Pavillon Rouge, estate selection

definition.en: In the OIV product definition, a spirit distilled from fresh fermented grapes, distinct from wine spirit and grape-marc spirit.
definition.zh: 按 OIV 产品定义，grape spirit 是由新鲜葡萄发酵后蒸馏、保留原料风味的烈酒；须与 wine spirit（葡萄酒蒸馏酒）、grape-marc spirit（葡萄渣烈酒）和中性葡萄来源酒精区分。加强酒语境中的“葡萄来源酒精”是更宽的说法。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: Thinly sliced potatoes slowly baked in cream and milk with garlic until tender and golden.
definition.zh: 薄切土豆与奶油、牛奶和蒜等慢烤至软嫩、表面上色的焗菜；传统式不靠奶酪增味，现代版本可能添加。

examples.en: The dauphinoise potatoes are thinly sliced and slowly baked in a creamy garlic mixture.
examples.zh: 这道多菲内土豆切成薄片，在带蒜香的奶油液中慢慢烤软。

definition.en: Coarse stone fragments common in Médoc and Graves soils, often associated with good drainage.
definition.zh: 砾石是粗颗粒石块，在 Médoc 与 Graves 的土壤中很典型；砾石层常有利排水，其热量与水分作用仍取决于土层、细土比例和底层。常与 Cabernet Sauvignon 联系，但不能仅凭砾石判断酒质。

definition.en: Historic Left Bank region south of Bordeaux city, named for its gravel soils.
definition.zh: 红白酒皆重要；Pessac-Léognan 从其北部核心区域独立成为更具体 appellation。

definition.en: Classification of selected Graves estates whose classified sites are now all within Pessac-Léognan.
definition.zh: 部分 château 的 red 和/or white wine 获 classified status；与 1855 Classification 分开记忆。

definition.en: Salmon cured with salt, sugar and dill, then served in thin slices.
definition.zh: 用盐、糖和莳萝腌渍三文鱼，再切薄片作为冷菜，常配芥末酱。cured 表示腌渍处理，不等同于 smoked（烟熏）或 cooked（加热煮熟）。

sources.title: Visit Sweden — Cured Salmon: Gravad Lax

examples.en: The gravlax is dill-cured salmon, served cold in thin slices.
examples.zh: 这道莳萝盐渍三文鱼经过腌渍，切成薄片冷食。

definition.en: Destructive bunch rot caused by Botrytis cinerea. The same fungus can produce noble rot under different conditions; grey rot is not a synonym for noble rot.
definition.zh: 由 Botrytis cinerea 引起的破坏性果穗腐烂。相同真菌在不同条件下可形成贵腐；灰霉病不等于贵腐。

sources.title: UC IPM · Botrytis Bunch Rot of Grapes

definition.en: Cooked using direct heat, often over a grill or under an overhead heat source.
definition.zh: 以直接热源烤制；英式语境也常指放在上方热源下烤。它与用烤箱热空气烘烤的 roasted 不完全相同，介绍菜品时应按厨房实际做法说明。

examples.en: We serve grilled vegetables.
examples.zh: 我们供应烤蔬菜。

definition.en: Cured pork jowl used in Roman cooking, particularly carbonara and amatriciana. Its rich fat and pronounced cured flavour form an important part of the pasta sauce.
definition.zh: 以猪颊、下颌附近肉腌制熟成的意式肉制品，油脂丰富、腌肉风味鲜明。常用于卡邦尼和阿马特里恰纳等罗马传统意面；与猪腹肉制成的 pancetta 是不同部位。

examples.en: Our carbonara uses guanciale, a cured pork jowl with a rich, savoury flavour.
examples.zh: 我们的卡邦尼使用意式腌猪颊肉，风味浓郁咸鲜。

definition.en: A cane-pruned vine training system using one or two fruiting canes.
definition.zh: 经典长梢修剪体系，可为单居由或双居由；常与 VSP 等架式结合。

sources.title: Penn State Extension — Dormant cane and spur pruning
University of Minnesota Extension — Trellises for grapes

definition.en: Automated equipment for riddling bottles of traditional-method sparkling wine.
definition.zh: 自动转瓶设备，可批量旋转、倾斜酒瓶，把沉淀集中到瓶颈；既用于 Champagne，也用于其他传统法起泡酒。

sources.title: DO Cava · Glossary: Pupitre and gyropalette

definition.en: Chopped or minced cooked meat covered with mashed potatoes and baked until the top is golden.
definition.zh: 碎肉或切碎熟肉铺底，上覆土豆泥并烘烤至表面金黄的法式家常菜；常用牛肉，也有鸭肉等变化版。

examples.en: The hachis Parmentier has a savoury meat filling beneath a golden layer of mashed potatoes.
examples.zh: 这道帕尔芒捷焗肉在咸鲜肉馅上覆盖土豆泥，烤出金黄表层。

definition.en: Picking grapes from the vineyard.
definition.zh: 可手工或机械、白天或夜间进行；采收时机是酸度、糖分、风味、酚类成熟与健康状态之间的决策。

sources.title: New Mexico State University — Grapevine Growth and Phenology

definition.en: Left Bank appellation containing and surrounding several famous communal appellations.
definition.zh: 位于 Médoc 南部核心地带，与 gravel terroirs、Cabernet-led reds 关系密切。

definition.en: A warm sauce made by emulsifying egg yolks and butter with an acidic ingredient.
definition.zh: 由蛋黄、黄油及柠檬汁等酸味原料乳化而成的温热酱汁，常配水波蛋或芦笋，含蛋与乳制品。

sources.title: Escoffier — How to Make the 5 Mother Sauces

examples.en: Would you like the hollandaise served on the side?
examples.zh: 您希望荷兰酱另外盛放吗？

definition.en: A chunky salad of tomatoes, cucumber, onion, olives and feta, dressed with olive oil and herbs.
definition.zh: 以番茄、黄瓜、洋葱、橄榄和菲达芝士等组合，淋橄榄油并加牛至；也可见甜椒、水瓜柳等。经典乡村式通常不用生菜，但配菜与调味仍有变化。

sources.title: Chef Akis Petretzikis — Authentic Greek salad, Horiatiki

examples.en: The village salad has tomatoes, cucumber, olives and feta with an oregano dressing.
examples.zh: 这道乡村沙拉有番茄、黄瓜、橄榄和菲达芝士，以牛至调味。

definition.en: A question about the strength of a dish’s chilli heat.
definition.zh: 询问辣度而不是泛指香料是否丰富。服务员可说明辣味来自哪里、是否可调整，避免把个人觉得“不辣”当成每位客人的感受。

sources.title: British Council · English for the World of Work: Tourism / Catering Services
British Council · Requests, offers and invitations

examples.en: How spicy is this dish? I would prefer something with only a little chilli.
examples.zh: 这道菜有多辣？我想吃只有一点辣椒的。

en: How would you like your steak cooked?

definition.en: A question about the guest’s preferred steak doneness.
definition.zh: 点牛排时询问客人希望的熟度。How 在这里问烹调结果，熟度用英语名称确认更清楚；不要把各语言的“几分熟”机械当成完全相同标准。

sources.title: Cambridge Dictionary · Would: requests and offers
British Council · English for the World of Work: Tourism / Catering Services

examples.en: How would you like your steak cooked? Medium or medium-rare?
examples.zh: 您的牛排想要几分熟？Medium 还是 medium-rare？

definition.en: A linking word introducing a contrast or qualification.
definition.zh: 用于引出转折或补充限制，意思是“然而”。句首使用时通常后接逗号。

examples.en: However, we need more evidence.
examples.zh: 然而，我们还需要更多证据。

definition.en: Fried eggs served over fried potatoes, with the yolks broken into the dish and often additional toppings.
definition.zh: 将煎蛋放在炸土豆上，切开蛋黄，让蛋液裹住其他食材。常见加火腿，也有虾或其他香肠版本；不能仅从菜名认定只有鸡蛋和土豆。

examples.en: The fried eggs sit over potatoes and ham; breaking the yolks brings the dish together.
examples.zh: 煎蛋放在土豆和火腿上，切开蛋黄后可拌着一起享用。

en: I'm afraid that is not available today.

definition.en: A courteous way to explain that an item cannot be offered today.
definition.zh: I’m afraid 在这里用于委婉告知不如人愿的消息，不表示害怕。说明今天无法供应后，可接着介绍已经确认的替代选择。

sources.title: British Council · Ordering in a café

examples.en: I'm afraid that is not available today. Would you like to hear about another option?
examples.zh: 很抱歉，今天没有这个。您想听听其他选择吗？

definition.en: An apology for a mistake or confusion in arrangements.
definition.zh: mix-up 是名词，指弄混或安排上的差错，例如送错桌、记错点单。先说明已确认的错误，再提出实际能做到的处理方式。

examples.en: I'm sorry about the mix-up. I brought the wrong side dish, and I will correct it.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，刚才弄错了。我送错了配菜，会为您更正。

definition.en: 3-isobutyl-2-methoxypyrazine, associated with bell-pepper aroma.
definition.zh: 一种甲氧基吡嗪，典型感官联想为青椒/绿色植物气息，在部分 Bordeaux varieties 中具有重要意义。

sources.title: UC Davis Waterhouse Lab — Pyrazines and methoxypyrazines

definition.en: Soft cooked meringue served on a pool of custard sauce, often finished with caramel.
definition.zh: 轻柔熟蛋白霜置于蛋奶酱上，形成漂浮小岛般的甜点，常淋焦糖；蛋白霜可水波煮或蒸制，装饰随版本变化。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Floating Island by Graham Hornigold

examples.en: The floating island is soft meringue resting on a smooth custard sauce.
examples.zh: 这道漂浮岛甜点以柔软蛋白霜置于细滑蛋奶酱上。

definition.en: Used before restating an idea in a clearer or different way.
definition.zh: 引出换一种说法的解释，帮助客人或同事理解同一意思。

examples.en: In other words, it tastes fresh.
examples.zh: 换句话说，它喝起来很清新。

definition.en: Provided as part of a price, package or arrangement.
definition.zh: 已包含在某项价格或安排之内。常见搭配 included in the price。

examples.en: Is breakfast included?
examples.zh: 包含早餐吗？

definition.en: Yeasts naturally present in the grapes or winery environment that can conduct fermentation without a selected commercial yeast inoculation.
definition.zh: 存在于葡萄或酒庄环境中的酵母，可在未接种筛选商业酵母的情况下参与发酵。

definition.en: One of the foods or substances used to prepare a dish.
definition.zh: 组成菜品的某种食材或原料，复数为 ingredients。介绍菜品时应同时说明主要食材和相关配料。

examples.en: What is the main ingredient?
examples.zh: 主要食材是什么？

definition.en: Used to introduce a replacement for another thing or action.
definition.zh: 以某物或某动作替代另一个；后面接名词、代词或动词 -ing 形式。

examples.en: Could I have tea instead of coffee?
examples.zh: 可以把咖啡换成茶吗？

definition.en: A grape with ancestry from more than one Vitis species. This differs from a cross between two varieties of Vitis vinifera.
definition.zh: 亲缘来源涉及多个 Vitis 物种的葡萄，与两个 Vitis vinifera 品种之间的种内杂交不同。

definition.en: The controlled application of water to vines.
definition.zh: 葡萄园对水分供应进行人工管理的方式；其必要性、合法性和形式取决于气候、土壤、法规与酒农目标，并影响长势、产量和果实成熟。

sources.title: Penn State Extension — Wine Grape Production
Oregon State University Extension — Soil-plant-water relationships

en: It should be ready in about ten minutes.
zh: 预计大约十分钟后就好。

definition.en: An estimated completion time, rather than an absolute promise.
definition.zh: should 在这里表示合理预计，in about ten minutes 表示大约十分钟后。实际使用时用厨房刚确认的时间替换 ten minutes，情况变化后再更新。

examples.en: It should be ready in about ten minutes, according to the kitchen’s latest estimate.
examples.zh: 按照厨房刚给的预估，大约十分钟后就好。

definition.en: A seasoned one-pot rice dish cooked with vegetables and a combination of meat, sausage or seafood.
definition.zh: 让大米与高汤、洋葱、芹菜、青椒及肉类或海鲜在同一锅中焖熟，米粒吸收调味汁。鸡肉、烟熏香肠、猪肉或虾可组成不同版本。与通常把汤浇在饭上的 gumbo 相比，jambalaya 的米饭直接参与整锅烹调。

sources.title: Explore Louisiana — Louisiana’s Most Famous Dishes
Patrick Mould / Explore Louisiana — Cajun Jambalaya

examples.en: In jambalaya, the rice cooks in the same pot as the meat and vegetables.
examples.zh: Jambalaya 的米饭是和肉、蔬菜在同一锅里焖熟的。

definition.en: A Swedish casserole of sliced potatoes, onions, spiced sprats and cream.
definition.zh: 把细切土豆、洋葱、香料腌渍的小鱼和奶油分层焗烤，常以面包屑形成表层。传统用鱼在瑞典称 ansjovis，通常是 sprat，并不是地中海菜常见的 anchovy；奶油土豆吸收腌鱼的咸鲜。

examples.en: Jansson’s temptation is a creamy potato bake with onions and spiced sprats.
examples.zh: Jansson’s temptation 是加入洋葱和香料腌小鱼的奶油土豆焗烤。

definition.en: Holding plenty of enjoyable juice or moisture when eaten; used for both fruit and cooked meat.
definition.zh: 咬下时能感到充足汁液，常用来介绍成熟水果或保有肉汁的肉类。它强调水分与汁液，和 tender 的软嫩程度不同；多汁的食物未必同样容易咀嚼。

examples.en: The roast chicken is juicy, with crisp skin and a lemon-herb sauce.
examples.zh: 这份烤鸡肉质多汁，表皮香脆，配柠檬香草酱。

definition.en: To cut vegetables or other food into slender, even strips resembling matchsticks; also used to describe that cut.
definition.zh: 把蔬菜等食材切成细长而较均匀的丝条，常用于沙拉、配菜或装饰。julienned carrots 指切成细丝的胡萝卜；它说明刀工形状，并不说明生熟或调味。

examples.en: The salad includes julienned carrots and cucumber with a light dressing.
examples.zh: 这款沙拉有胡萝卜丝和黄瓜丝，配清淡的沙拉汁。

definition.en: A relatively thin sauce based on meat juices, sometimes enriched with stock or other ingredients.
definition.zh: 菜单中通常指以肉类烹调汁液为基础的酱汁，质地相对流动；是否加高汤、酒或增稠原料须看配方。

examples.en: The lamb is served with its own jus.
examples.zh: 这道羊肉配以自身烹调汁液制成的原汁酱。

definition.en: A fluffy sweet pancake made with eggs, milk and flour, cooked in butter and torn into pieces. It is dusted with sugar and often served with fruit compote; raisins are common.
definition.zh: 以鸡蛋、牛奶和面粉制成蓬松甜煎饼，用黄油煎烤后撕成小块，撒上糖粉供应。常含葡萄干，并搭配炖水果或水果酱。

examples.en: This fluffy sweet pancake is torn into pieces and finished with icing sugar.
examples.zh: 这款蓬松甜煎饼被撕成小块，最后撒上糖粉。

definition.en: Small, soft flour-and-egg dumplings boiled in water, then layered or tossed with grated cheese until it melts, commonly with cooked onions. Cheese choices vary by region.
definition.zh: 将面粉和鸡蛋制成的小面疙瘩煮熟，再与奶酪和炒熟的洋葱分层加热或拌合，直到奶酪融化。常见于德国南部，奶酪种类有地区差异。

sources.title: Bavaria Tourism — Allgäu cheese spaetzle by Silvia Beyer

examples.en: These soft egg dumplings are mixed with melted cheese and cooked onions.
examples.zh: 这些柔软的鸡蛋面疙瘩拌有融化奶酪和炒熟的洋葱。

definition.en: Spiced rice combined with smoked fish and cooked eggs.
definition.zh: 以米饭、熏鱼和煮鸡蛋组成的英印风味菜；常见鱼种是烟熏黑线鳕，咖喱香料带来温暖香气。可见于早餐、早午餐或正餐，香料和配菜随配方变化。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Nathan Outlaw’s Kedgeree

examples.en: The kedgeree combines smoked haddock, rice and egg with gentle curry spices.
examples.zh: 这份英印熏鱼饭将烟熏黑线鳕、米饭和鸡蛋配上温和咖喱香料。

definition.en: To continue giving someone the latest information.
definition.zh: 持续向对方告知最新情况，常用 keep you updated on + 事项。

examples.en: I’ll keep you updated on your order.
examples.zh: 我会及时告诉您订单的进展。

definition.en: A tart lime-and-condensed-milk pie, commonly made with egg yolks and a crumb crust.
definition.zh: 以青柠汁、炼乳和蛋黄做成酸甜顺滑内馅，常用饼干碎派底。传统名称指 Key lime 风味，但实际可能用其他青柠汁；奶油或蛋白霜装饰取决于配方。

sources.title: King Arthur Baking — Classic Key Lime Pie

examples.en: The Key lime pie has a bright citrus filling on a crisp crumb base.
examples.zh: 青柠派有清鲜酸甜的柑橘内馅，底部是酥脆饼干碎派底。

definition.en: A Late Jurassic geological age associated in Chablis with fossil-bearing marl and limestone.
definition.zh: Kimmeridgian 指晚侏罗世的一个地质年代，而不是一种独立土壤。夏布利常用它描述该年代形成、含海洋化石的泥灰岩与石灰岩地层；不能简单等同于“贝壳土”。

sources.title: Chablis and Chablis Premier Cru - Bourgogne wines

zh: 柯尼斯堡酸豆白汁肉丸

definition.en: Poached meatballs served in a pale, tangy caper sauce.
definition.zh: 德国经典肉丸菜，肉馅可用小牛肉或混合肉，常拌入面包、洋葱及少量鳀鱼，再轻煮成丸。搭配带酸豆和柠檬酸香的浅色浓汁，通常配土豆；关键不是煎焦外层，而是嫩肉丸与酸香酱汁。

sources.title: Martina Meuth and Bernd Neuner-Duttenhofer / WDR — Königsberger Klopse

examples.en: These meatballs come in a creamy caper sauce with a little lemon.
examples.zh: 这些肉丸配柔润的酸豆酱，带一点柠檬酸香。

definition.en: Lamb slow-roasted in a sealed parcel, commonly with potatoes, garlic, lemon and herbs.
definition.zh: 羊肉与土豆、蒜、柠檬和香草等密封包裹后慢烤，让肉汁保留在包内。部分版本还加芝士或黄油；kleftiko 这种做法也有其他肉类版本。

sources.title: Chef Akis Petretzikis — Greek lamb kleftiko

examples.en: The lamb is slow-roasted in a sealed parcel with potatoes, garlic and lemon.
examples.zh: 羊肉与土豆、蒜和柠檬密封包裹后慢烤。

definition.en: Family of red grape varieties and sparkling wine styles from Emilia-Romagna and neighboring areas.
definition.zh: 既指一组相关的红葡萄品种，也用于描述以它们酿制的酒。核心在 Emilia-Romagna，也延伸至邻近地区；有轻度或充分起泡、干型或甜型等不同表达，不是单一葡萄或固定甜度。

definition.en: Rabbit cooked until tender and served with a mustard sauce, often enriched with cream.
definition.zh: 兔肉先煎上色，再用酒、高汤等炖煮，配以芥末为主调、常含奶油的酱汁。有些版本另加培根；moutarde 是芥末调味，不等同于辣椒辣味，也不能据菜名判断是否只含兔肉。

sources.title: Chef Alex Jackson / Taste France — Lapin à la Moutarde

examples.en: The rabbit is braised and finished with a creamy mustard sauce; this version includes bacon.
examples.zh: 兔肉经焖炖后配奶油芥末酱汁，这个版本也加入培根。

definition.en: Layers of pasta and filling baked together, often with meat ragù, béchamel, and cheese.
definition.zh: 将面片与馅料、酱汁分层后入炉烘烤的意面，常见肉酱、白酱和奶酪组合；也有蔬菜等不同版本。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — How to Make Lasagne

examples.en: The lasagne is baked in layers, with a browned top and a soft filling.
examples.zh: 这道千层面分层烘烤，表面上色，内馅柔软。

definition.en: Milk-fed lamb roasted until tender, a speciality associated with Castile and León.
definition.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚－莱昂地区的经典烤乳羊。常将带骨羊肉分成较大的块，放在陶盘中烤至肉质柔嫩、表面金黄；lechazo 指乳羊，服务时可用 roast suckling lamb 解释，不宜笼统说成羊排。

sources.title: Castilla y León Tourism — Lechazo asado

examples.en: Lechazo asado is roast suckling lamb, served on the bone.
examples.zh: Lechazo asado 是带骨上桌的烤乳羊。

definition.en: A layered allium vegetable with a white stalk and green leaves. Cooking softens its onion-like flavour into a gentle sweetness, useful in soups, pies and side dishes.
definition.zh: 葱属蔬菜，白色与浅绿色部分层层包裹，带有较温和的葱香；煮熟后更柔软、甜润。常用于浓汤、咸派或蔬菜配菜，深绿色较韧的部分也可用于熬汤底。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook leeks

examples.en: The soup is made with leeks and potatoes, so it has a mild onion flavour.
examples.zh: 这款汤用西洋韭葱和土豆制作，因此带有温和的葱香。

definition.en: Sediment remaining after fermentation, including yeast cells, tartrate salts and grape solids. Continued contact with lees can affect wine composition and texture.
definition.zh: 发酵后留下的沉淀，包括酵母细胞、酒石酸盐及葡萄固形物。持续接触酒泥可影响酒的组成与质地。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: Bordeaux shorthand for the areas west/south of the Gironde-Garonne system, especially Médoc and Graves.
definition.zh: 学习上通常指 Médoc 与 Graves 体系，常与 gravel、Cabernet Sauvignon、1855 Classification 建立关联。

definition.en: Bairrada-style roast suckling pig seasoned with garlic, black pepper and pork fat.
definition.zh: 葡萄牙拜拉达的烤乳猪，以蒜、黑胡椒、盐和猪油调味，传统上在柴火炉中烤制。皮与肉的口感对比鲜明，常配橙片、土豆及沙拉；带蒜与胡椒的调味是介绍这款地区菜的重要信息。

sources.title: Restaurante Rei dos Leitões / Turismo de Portugal — Leitão à Bairrada, p. 27

examples.en: The Bairrada suckling pig is roasted with garlic and black pepper.
examples.zh: 这道拜拉达乳猪以蒜和黑胡椒调味后烤制。

definition.en: A chilled, softly set cream dessert flavoured with lemon and sweetened with sugar.
definition.zh: 以浓奶油、糖和柠檬为主要风味，加热调匀后冷藏成柔软凝固状的甜点。口感浓滑，柠檬的酸香很突出，常装在小杯或小碗中，配酥饼或莓果。介绍时可用 creamy and tangy 描述其奶香与酸爽。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Lemon Posset Recipes
Matthew Tomkinson / Great British Chefs — Lemon Posset with Raspberries and Shortbread

examples.en: The lemon posset is chilled and creamy, with a bright citrus flavour.
examples.zh: 这款柠檬奶油凝露冷藏上桌，口感浓滑，柠檬风味鲜明。

en: Let me check with the kitchen.

definition.en: An offer to verify information with the kitchen team.
definition.zh: 遇到配料、做法或出餐时间不确定时，先向厨房核实再答复。check with someone 表示找有关人员确认；不是已经承诺厨房能够满足要求。

sources.title: British Council · How to be polite in English
Food Standards Scotland · Online allergen training: staff communication

examples.en: Let me check with the kitchen before I confirm whether the sauce can be changed.
examples.zh: 让我先向厨房确认，再答复您酱汁是否可以更换。

en: Let me speak to the manager.

definition.en: An offer to involve the manager when further help is needed.
definition.zh: 需要主管授权或更多协助时，说明自己将找经理沟通。let me 后直接接动词原形；不是让客人自己去找经理，也不预设经理一定批准某项补偿。

sources.title: British Council · How to be polite in English
British Council · A response to a complaint

examples.en: Let me speak to the manager about your request, and I will come back with an answer.
examples.zh: 让我就您的要求跟经理沟通一下，然后回来答复您。

definition.en: A rich yeast-dough waffle with pearl sugar that caramelises during cooking.
definition.zh: 列日华夫饼将珍珠糖拌进较浓厚的发酵面团，在烤盘中加热时形成焦糖香和局部脆甜口感。通常较小、边缘不规则或圆润，直接原味食用也很常见；与轻盈的布鲁塞尔华夫饼可作对照学习。

sources.title: Liège Tourism — The Authentic Liège Waffle

examples.en: The Liège waffle has pearl sugar baked into the dough, so it is sweet on its own.
examples.zh: 列日华夫饼的面团中烤入了珍珠糖，所以原味就有甜味。

definition.en: A cadastral or historical place-name identifying a small area of land.
definition.zh: 与 Climat 常重叠但不严格同义；一个 Climat 可能包含多个 lieux-dits，反之亦可能只覆盖其一部分。

definition.en: Having a relatively light sense of weight and fullness in the mouth.
definition.zh: 酒液在口中的重量感与丰满度较轻；不是颜色浅或酒精低的必然同义词。

examples.en: It’s a light-bodied red.
examples.zh: 这是一款轻酒体红葡萄酒。

definition.en: A sedimentary rock composed mainly of calcium carbonate, which can form the parent material of calcareous soils.
definition.zh: 石灰岩是以碳酸钙为主的沉积岩，不等同于“石灰质土壤”。在 Saint-Émilion 等地，它是重要母岩或底层地质；对葡萄藤的影响要结合裂隙、土层厚度、水分与栽培管理判断，不能直接保证某种酸度或风味。

sources.title: USGS — Limestone, a sedimentary carbonate rock

definition.en: Linguine served with clawed lobster in a seafood sauce, commonly made with tomatoes, garlic, white wine and parsley.
definition.zh: 扁长面配螯龙虾，常以小番茄、蒜、白葡萄酒和欧芹煮成海鲜酱汁，再将面条与酱汁拌匀。Astice 指有大螯的龙虾，与意大利语 aragosta 所指的无螯刺龙虾有别。

sources.title: Chef Michele Ghedini / Cookist — Linguine all’astice

examples.en: The lobster linguine has a light tomato sauce with garlic and parsley.
examples.zh: 这道龙虾扁意面配清爽的番茄酱汁，并加入蒜和欧芹。

definition.en: Liquid added after disgorgement, often wine plus sugar depending on desired dosage.
definition.zh: 除渣后加入的补液，通常由葡萄酒与糖组成，用于按目标风格完成 dosage；补液可不加糖，所以加入补液不一定等于增加甜度。

definition.en: Mixture added before bottle fermentation, typically including sugar and yeast.
definition.zh: 加入调配后基酒中以启动瓶中二次发酵，是 traditional method 的关键步骤。

definition.en: Finnish salmon soup with potatoes, a little cream and fresh dill.
definition.zh: 芬兰常见的三文鱼汤，以三文鱼块、土豆和少量奶油构成主体，常加入韭葱、胡萝卜等蔬菜，最后用莳萝提香。汤里保留鱼肉和蔬菜块，整体柔和鲜美，既可作为午餐汤，也常见于传统餐馆。

sources.title: Visit Finland — What to eat in Finland: Lohikeitto

examples.en: The salmon soup comes with potatoes and fresh dill in a lightly creamy broth.
examples.zh: 这道三文鱼汤配有土豆和新鲜莳萝，汤底带淡淡奶油香。

definition.en: Large French wine region following the Loire River from the Atlantic inland.
definition.zh: 法国沿卢瓦尔河分布的大型葡萄酒区域，核心学习轴为 Pays Nantais、Anjou-Saumur、Touraine、Centre-Loire。

definition.en: To try to find a person, object or place.
definition.zh: 尝试寻找人、物或地点；look for 表示寻找过程，find 表示找到。

examples.en: I’m looking for the station.
examples.zh: 我在找车站。

definition.en: The bags and cases carried when travelling.
definition.zh: 旅行携带的行李，通常作不可数名词；一件行李可说 a piece of luggage。

examples.en: Where can I collect my luggage?
examples.zh: 我在哪里领取行李？

definition.en: Marque d'Acheteur producer category.
definition.zh: Champagne 标签注册代码，Marque d’Acheteur：品牌属于买方，例如零售商或其他客户，酒由香槟生产经营者提供；它本身不是栽培或酿造方式的保证。

sources.title: Comité Champagne · Understanding the Champagne label
Union des Maisons de Champagne · Etiquetage

definition.en: Traditional white grape used in Cava.
definition.zh: Cava 三大经典传统白品种之一，常贡献较中性果味、花香和结构。

sources.title: DO Cava · Types and varieties of Cava grapes

definition.en: Cooked macaroni coated in cheese sauce, sometimes baked with a crisp topping.
definition.zh: 短管状意面拌入奶酪酱，可直接上桌，也可铺面包糠再焗烤。美式菜单常简称 mac and cheese；奶酪种类、是否加肉以及是否烤制要看餐厅版本。

sources.title: James Beard Foundation — Macaroni and Cheese

examples.en: Our macaroni and cheese is baked with a crisp breadcrumb topping.
examples.zh: 我们的奶酪通心粉铺面包糠焗烤，表面酥脆。

definition.en: Contact between juice/wine and grape solids for extraction.
definition.zh: 葡萄汁或葡萄酒与果皮、籽、梗等固体接触的过程，用于提取色素、单宁、香气和其他可溶物。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: Southern Burgundy region strongly associated with Chardonnay.
definition.zh: 以 Mâcon 系列及 Pouilly-Fuissé、Saint-Véran、Viré-Clessé 等白酒 appellations 为核心。

definition.en: Small buttery cakes baked in shell-shaped moulds, with a light crumb and often a gentle citrus or vanilla flavour.
definition.zh: 用鸡蛋、糖、面粉和黄油制成的小蛋糕，在贝壳形模具中烘烤，一面有贝壳纹路，另一面常鼓起小圆丘。口感轻柔、带黄油香，可加入柠檬皮屑或香草，适合作为咖啡或茶的配点。

sources.title: Chef Philippe / Meilleur du Chef — Madeleines
Tom Aikens / Great British Chefs — Madeleines

examples.en: We can serve warm madeleines with your tea; they are small, buttery shell-shaped cakes.
examples.zh: 我们可以为您的茶配温热的玛德琳，那是带黄油香的贝壳形小蛋糕。

definition.en: A split bread roll filled with chilled lobster meat dressed with mayonnaise.
definition.zh: 以切开的长面包夹冷龙虾肉沙拉，龙虾常拌蛋黄酱，可加西芹和柠檬；面包本身可以抹黄油烤暖。本词条特指冷龙虾沙拉版本，不把所有 lobster roll 都视作相同做法。

examples.en: Our Maine lobster roll has chilled lobster salad inside a warm, buttered roll.
examples.zh: 我们的缅因式龙虾包是在温热黄油面包里夹入冷龙虾沙拉。

definition.en: Lactic acid bacteria convert malic acid into lactic acid and carbon dioxide. This reduces acidity and can modify aroma and texture; it is separate from alcoholic fermentation by yeast.
definition.zh: 乳酸菌将苹果酸转化为乳酸与二氧化碳，降低酸度，并可能改变香气及质地；不同于酵母进行的酒精发酵。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: To succeed in doing something, often despite a difficulty.
definition.zh: 设法成功做到某事，常带有克服困难的意味。用 manage to + 动词原形；过去式 managed to。

examples.en: We managed to finish before service.
examples.zh: 我们设法在开餐前完成了工作。

definition.en: Traditional Champagne press-load unit, commonly 4,000 kg of grapes.
definition.zh: 在 Champagne 压榨语境中，marc 指一批压榨量，经典标准为 4,000 kg 整串葡萄。这个词在更广泛的葡萄酒语境还可指葡萄皮籽等压榨残渣，或由其蒸馏的烈酒，须结合上下文。

definition.en: Southern major communal appellation of the Haut-Médoc.
definition.zh: Médoc 经典 commune 之一，需连接 Château Margaux、Palmer、gravel 与 1855 classification。

definition.en: Apricots enclosed in soft dough, gently boiled and rolled in buttery breadcrumbs.
definition.zh: 把杏子包进柔软面团中，轻煮后裹上用黄油炒香的面包屑，通常撒糖粉。面团常用夸克奶酪，也有土豆面团版本；切开可见整颗或大块杏子，是奥地利常见甜点，也可作为甜味主食。

examples.en: These soft dumplings have an apricot centre and a buttery breadcrumb coating.
examples.zh: 这些柔软的甜团包着杏子，外层裹有黄油炒香的面包屑。

definition.en: To leave food in a seasoned mixture to develop flavour before further preparation; the mixture is called a marinade.
definition.zh: 让肉、鱼或蔬菜在调味混合物中放置一段时间以增加风味；配方可能含油、酸味液体、香草或香料。marinade 通常指腌料本身，marinate 指腌味动作。

examples.en: We marinate the chicken in yogurt, lemon and spices before grilling.
examples.zh: 烧烤之前，我们先用酸奶、柠檬和香料给鸡肉腌味。

zh: 巴斯克金枪鱼土豆炖锅

definition.en: A northern Spanish stew of tuna or bonito with potatoes, peppers and onions.
definition.zh: 西班牙北部的鱼肉炖锅，以 bonito 或金枪鱼类鱼肉、土豆、甜椒和洋葱等煮成。土豆增添稠度，鱼肉通常较后加入；鱼种和番茄等配料随做法变化。

examples.en: Marmitako is a warming stew with tuna, potatoes and sweet peppers.
examples.zh: Marmitako 是一锅暖胃的金枪鱼、土豆与甜椒炖菜。

definition.en: Seasoned crab meat shaped into cakes with a small amount of binder and cooked until golden.
definition.zh: 以蟹肉块为主，加入适量面包糠、鸡蛋或蛋黄酱等帮助定形，调味后制成饼。不同餐厅会煎、炸或烤制；crab cake 是咸味蟹肉菜，不是甜蛋糕。

sources.title: Visit Maryland — Real Maryland Crab Cakes
Phillips Seafood — Shirley’s Original Crab Cakes

examples.en: The Maryland crab cakes have a golden exterior and a tender crab-meat centre.
examples.zh: 马里兰蟹肉饼外层金黄，中心是柔嫩蟹肉。

definition.en: A rich Italian dairy ingredient made by thickening cream. Its smooth, mild character suits tiramisu and other desserts, while it can also enrich risotto or savoury sauces.
definition.zh: 由奶油凝聚制成的浓稠意式乳制品，通常称马斯卡彭奶酪，质地顺滑、奶味柔和。既是提拉米苏的重要原料，也能用于咸味酱汁或烩饭，增加浓润口感。

examples.en: The tiramisu has a smooth mascarpone cream between the coffee-soaked biscuit layers.
examples.zh: 这款提拉米苏的咖啡浸饼干层之间，夹着顺滑的马斯卡彭奶油馅。

definition.en: Maturation in contact with yeast lees.
definition.zh: 让酒与酵母酒泥接触熟成；在 Champagne 语境中通常是瓶中二次发酵后的酒泥熟成。酵母自溶与缓慢氧化共同影响成熟香气和质地；其他葡萄酒也可以在罐或桶中进行酒泥熟成。

definition.en: Large Swabian pasta parcels commonly filled with minced meat, bread, onions and herbs.
definition.zh: 德国施瓦本地区的有馅面食，用较大的面皮包住肉末、泡软的面包、洋葱和香草等，部分馅料还含菠菜。可放在清汤里上桌，也可配炒洋葱，或切片煎炒；菜单需要结合上桌方式解释。

examples.en: Would you prefer the Maultaschen in broth or with sautéed onions?
examples.zh: 您更喜欢汤里的面饺，还是配炒洋葱的做法？

definition.en: Cooked so that the centre remains pink to red, between rare and medium.
definition.zh: 介于 rare 与 medium 之间的肉类熟度，中心仍呈粉红至红色。点单时直接确认 medium-rare，避免用不统一的“几成熟”机械对应。

examples.en: I’d like my steak medium-rare.
examples.zh: 我的牛排想要 medium-rare 熟度。

definition.en: Left Bank Bordeaux appellation for red wines and, under the 2025 specification, white wines.
definition.zh: 波尔多左岸的 Médoc AOP，以红葡萄酒著称；2025 年 7 月 31 日核准的新章程纳入白葡萄酒。它与 Haut-Médoc 及六个著名 communal appellations 仍须分层理解，不能再定义为仅限红酒。

sources.title: INAO — Le Médoc s’ouvre aux vins blancs, August 2025
Ministère de l’Agriculture — Médoc specification approved 31 July 2025

definition.en: Principal grape of Muscadet.
definition.zh: Muscadet 的核心白葡萄，也称 Melon de Bourgogne。常酿成清新、较轻盈的干白，酒泥接触可以增加口感层次。

sources.title: Fédération des Vins de Nantes · Muscadet and Melon de Bourgogne
Fédération des Vins de Nantes · Muscadet sur lie

definition.en: Centre-Loire appellation for Sauvignon Blanc and Pinot Noir.
definition.zh: 与 Sancerre 同属 Centre-Loire，但拥有自己的 villages、terroirs 和 producer identity。

definition.en: Major Côte Chalonnaise appellation producing mainly Pinot Noir.
definition.zh: Côte Chalonnaise 重要红酒 village AOC，拥有多个 Premier Cru climats。

definition.en: Early-ripening black grape and Bordeaux's most widely planted major red variety.
definition.zh: 成熟较早、质地更丰满柔和；在 Right Bank 与 clay-rich sites 尤其重要，也是全波尔多关键混酿品种。

sources.title: CIVB — The Art of the Blend

definition.en: Hake gently cooked in a light garlic-and-parsley sauce. Basque-style versions may also include clams and asparagus.
definition.zh: 将无须鳕在蒜和欧芹调成的清淡绿汁中轻柔煮熟。巴斯克风味版本也常加入蛤蜊和芦笋；绿色主要来自欧芹。

sources.title: Spain Tourism — Merluza en salsa verde

examples.en: This hake comes in a light parsley sauce with a gentle garlic flavour.
examples.zh: 这道无须鳕配清淡的欧芹酱汁，带有柔和蒜香。

definition.en: Protected term for the traditional bottle-fermentation method used within Champagne.
definition.zh: 核心流程为瓶中二次发酵、酒泥熟成、转瓶、除渣与 dosage；产区外通常称 méthode traditionnelle。

definition.en: One of Champagne's three dominant grape varieties, known for later budbreak and fruit-forward character.
definition.zh: 香槟三大主力品种之一，较晚萌芽使其对春霜风险相对更有适应性，Vallée de la Marne 尤为重要。

definition.en: Côte de Beaune village famous for Chardonnay.
definition.zh: 以村庄与 Premier Cru 白葡萄酒著名；没有 Grand Cru，风格差异高度依赖 climat 与 producer。

definition.en: A layered pastry dessert combining crisp puff pastry with cream or pastry cream, sometimes with fruit.
definition.zh: 把烤脆的起酥面皮与奶油或卡仕达类馅料交叠组合，形成酥脆与柔滑对比的甜点。有些版本加水果；mille-feuille 的“千层”是形容层次，并非要求实际有一千层，也不同于薄煎饼千层蛋糕。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to make mille-feuille

examples.en: The mille-feuille has crisp pastry layers with a light cream filling.
examples.zh: 这款千层酥由酥脆面皮层夹着轻盈奶油馅组成。

definition.en: Uneven berry development within a bunch, with small berries alongside normally developed ones; berry size and maturity may differ markedly.
definition.zh: 同一果穗内出现发育不均的小果粒与正常果粒，果粒大小及成熟程度可能明显不同。

sources.title: INRAE — Grapevine abiotic disorders of stalk and bunch

definition.en: A substantial Italian vegetable soup, often containing beans and small pasta, with many regional variations.
definition.zh: 以多种蔬菜煮成的意式汤品，常加入豆类或小型意面，食材随季节和地区变化；高汤不一定为蔬菜高汤。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — Minestrone di Verdure by Antonio Carluccio

examples.en: The minestrone is a chunky vegetable soup; I will confirm today's vegetables and stock.
examples.zh: 这道杂菜汤保留蔬菜块，我为您确认今天使用的蔬菜和高汤。

definition.en: A product made by adding spirit to unfermented or minimally fermented must.
definition.zh: 在显著发酵前向葡萄汁/葡萄醪加入烈酒形成的制品，与发酵途中加烈止酵不同。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: A vineyard or climat under single ownership.
definition.zh: Monopole 是 ownership 概念，不是 appellation 等级；意味着某地块由单一 owner 控制。

definition.en: A family of aroma compounds important in highly aromatic grape varieties.
definition.zh: 在 Muscat、Gewürztraminer、Viognier 等芳香型品种中常较突出，可表现花香、柑橘和香料等特征。

sources.title: AWRI — Identification and control of volatile compounds, Viognier monoterpenes

definition.en: Champagne subregion south of Reims, between the Vesle and Marne rivers.
definition.zh: 位于 Reims 以南、Vesle 与 Marne 河之间的重要 Champagne 子区，Pinot Noir 具有突出地位；不是笼统“环绕 Reims”的地区。

definition.en: Chenin Blanc appellation opposite Vouvray on the south bank of the Loire.
definition.zh: 与 Vouvray 形成经典对比，同样可生产 dry / sweet / sparkling Chenin。

definition.en: Grand Cru Chardonnay vineyard spanning Puligny-Montrachet and Chassagne-Montrachet.
definition.zh: 勃艮第最重要白酒 Grand Cru 之一，是理解 Climat 跨 commune 与多 owner 的经典案例。

definition.en: A mushroom with a distinctive honeycomb-like cap and rich, earthy, nutty flavour. Cooked morels are used in sauces, with poultry or alongside spring vegetables.
definition.zh: 菌盖有蜂窝般凹凸纹理的食用菌，风味浓郁，带泥土、坚果与鲜香。餐厅常将其充分烹熟后加入酱汁、搭配禽肉或春季蔬菜；也有干燥后泡发使用的形式。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook morels

examples.en: The chicken is served with a morel sauce, which adds a rich mushroom flavour.
examples.zh: 这道鸡肉配羊肚菌酱，带来浓郁的菌菇鲜香。

definition.en: One of the 10 Beaujolais Crus.
definition.zh: 结构与陈年潜力较强的经典 cru；Côte du Py 是重要 lieu-dit / terroir node。

zh: 阿斯蒂莫斯卡托微起泡

definition.en: Lightly sparkling, sweet aromatic wine from Piemonte.
definition.zh: 低酒精、低压力、甜型、强烈 Muscat 香气；与 fuller sparkling Asti 区分。

definition.en: Mussels cooked under a lid with white wine, onion or shallot, and herbs in their juices.
definition.zh: 贻贝与白葡萄酒、洋葱或红葱头及香草加盖烹调，原汁作为汤汁供应；部分版本加入奶油，应按配方说明。

examples.en: The mussels are cooked in white wine with onion and herbs, then served with their juices.
examples.zh: 这些贻贝用白葡萄酒、洋葱和香草煮制，连同原汁一起供应。

definition.en: Mussels cooked in a pot with an aromatic broth and served with chips. Common preparations use onion and celery; white wine, garlic or cream versions are also found.
definition.zh: 将贻贝放在锅中，与洋葱、西芹等调成的汤汁一起烹煮，搭配炸薯条供应。常见变化包括白葡萄酒、蒜味或奶油版本。

sources.title: The Beer's Garden Brussels — Mussels preparations

examples.en: The mussels come in their cooking broth, with crisp fries served alongside.
examples.zh: 贻贝连同烹煮汤汁上桌，旁边配有酥脆薯条。

definition.en: One of the 10 Beaujolais Crus, often among the most structured.
definition.zh: 花岗岩与锰等 terroir 讨论常见，是结构感与陈年潜力重要的 cru 节点。

definition.en: A Greek-style baked dish layering aubergine with a tomato-based minced-meat sauce and a béchamel topping. Many versions also include a layer of potatoes.
definition.zh: 这里指常见希腊版本：茄子与番茄肉末酱分层铺放，顶部覆盖贝夏梅尔白酱后烘烤，许多版本底部还铺有土豆。其他地区同名菜的做法可能不同。

sources.title: Greek National Tourism Organisation — Moussaka recipe

examples.en: Moussaka has layers of aubergine and meat sauce beneath a baked béchamel topping.
examples.zh: 穆萨卡在茄子与肉酱的层次之上覆盖白酱，再一起焗烤。

definition.en: A chilled chocolate dessert with an airy texture created by folding in whipped egg whites or cream.
definition.zh: 将巧克力与打发蛋白或奶油等结合，冷却后形成轻盈蓬松的甜点。Mousse 指充气后的细软质地，不是固态巧克力蛋糕；不同做法的蛋、乳制品组成不同，应按配方说明。

sources.title: Alain Ducasse / Académie du Goût — Mousse au chocolat
Great British Chefs — How to make chocolate mousse

examples.en: The chocolate mousse has an airy texture and an intense dark-chocolate flavour.
examples.zh: 这款巧克力慕斯质地轻盈，黑巧克力风味浓郁。

definition.en: An Italian stretched-curd cheese made from cow or buffalo milk. Fresh versions are soft and milky, served in salads or used in cooked dishes such as pizza.
definition.zh: 通过拉伸凝乳制成的意式奶酪，可使用牛奶或水牛奶。新鲜版本柔软、带奶香，常用于卡普雷塞沙拉，也广泛用于披萨等热菜；介绍时应说明本店所用品种，而不能默认全是水牛奶。

examples.en: Our Caprese uses fresh cow-milk mozzarella with tomatoes and basil.
examples.zh: 我们的卡普雷塞沙拉使用新鲜牛奶马苏里拉奶酪，搭配番茄和罗勒。

definition.en: Aromatic white Bordeaux grape usually used in small proportions.
definition.zh: 通常少量加入白波尔多，以花香和芳香性补充 Sauvignon Blanc / Sémillon。

definition.en: Dry white Loire appellation family based on Melon B.
definition.zh: 法国西部 Loire、Nantes 一带以 Melon B 为核心的干白葡萄酒名称；既指 Muscadet AOP，也常泛指包括 Muscadet Sèvre-et-Maine 等产区的酒系。不要与芳香型 Muscat 葡萄混淆。

sources.title: Fédération des Vins de Nantes · Muscadet sur lie
Fédération des Vins de Nantes · Muscadet and Melon de Bourgogne

definition.en: Major Muscadet appellation around the Sèvre and Maine rivers.
definition.zh: 位于 Sèvre Nantaise 与 Maine 河一带的 Muscadet 核心 AOP，地质多样，并包含附加村镇地理名称的 Crus Communaux。

sources.title: Fédération des Vins de Nantes · Crus communaux
InterLoire · Climate and geology of Loire wines

definition.en: A bivalve shellfish often cooked and served in its shell. Steaming releases flavourful juices that become part of a broth or sauce, as in moules marinières.
definition.zh: 又常称青口的双壳贝类，西餐经常带壳蒸煮并连同汤汁上桌。烹调释放的贝汁可成为汤或酱汁的一部分，也能去壳加入意面；mussels 为菜单上常见的复数形式。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook mussels

examples.en: The mussels are steamed in white wine and served in their cooking broth.
examples.zh: 这道贻贝用白葡萄酒蒸煮，并连同烹煮汤汁一起上桌。

definition.en: Unfermented grape juice obtained from fresh grapes, sometimes accompanied by skins, seeds and other solids.
definition.zh: 新鲜葡萄获得、尚未发酵的葡萄汁，工艺语境中也可包含皮、籽等固体；已开始发酵时应进一步说明为 fermenting must。取汁不一定先经过破碎，整串压榨也能得到 must。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: Stopping or suppressing fermentation by adding spirit.
definition.zh: 在发酵进行中加入烈酒，使酵母活动受抑制并保留部分葡萄原生糖分，是多类甜型加强酒的重要机制。

sources.title: INAO — Muscat de Frontignan, vin doux naturel and mutage

definition.en: A cross arising through natural pollination rather than a planned breeding programme. In Aligoté, Pinot × Gouais Blanc is within Vitis vinifera; “natural” alone does not specify whether parents belong to one or more species.
definition.zh: 由自然授粉形成、而非人工设计育种组合的杂交。Aligoté 的 Pinot × Gouais Blanc 属于 Vitis vinifera 种内杂交；“自然”本身并不表示亲本一定同种。

definition.en: A slow-cooked lamb stew with vegetables such as turnips and carrots, often associated with spring menus.
definition.zh: 羊肉先煎上色，再与高汤和蔬菜缓慢炖煮，常见配菜包括芜菁、胡萝卜等，也常以春季蔬菜版本出现。羊肉炖得柔软是特点；酒、鱼类调味料或豆类等配方差异应向厨房核实。

sources.title: Richard Corrigan / Great British Chefs — Lamb navarin

examples.en: The lamb is slowly braised until tender and served with turnips and carrots.
examples.zh: 羊肉缓慢焖炖至软嫩，再与芜菁和胡萝卜一起供应。

definition.en: Négociant Distributeur producer category.
definition.zh: Champagne 标签注册代码，Négociant Distributeur：购入已完成的香槟并以自己的名称或品牌销售的商家，不代表其完成了酿造。

sources.title: Comité Champagne · Understanding the Champagne label
Union des Maisons de Champagne · Etiquetage

definition.en: Merchant intermediary central to the Bordeaux wine trade.
definition.zh: 传统上负责采购、储存、分销和销售葡萄酒，是 Place de Bordeaux 的关键角色之一。

definition.en: Merchant-producer purchasing grapes, must or wine and raising/bottling wines.
definition.zh: 勃艮第传统重要商业模式；现代许多大 maison 同时拥有自有 vineyards 与采购来源。

zh: 新英格兰奶油蛤蜊浓汤

definition.en: A creamy clam soup with potatoes and onions, often flavoured with bacon or salt pork.
definition.zh: 蛤蜊与土豆、洋葱煮成的乳白色浓汤，通常加入牛奶或奶油，部分配方用培根或咸猪肉增香。New England 指此菜的风格，不能把所有 clam chowder 都直接解释成奶油版本。

sources.title: James Beard Foundation — New England Clam Chowder

examples.en: The New England clam chowder is creamy, with clams, potatoes and a little bacon.
examples.zh: 新英格兰蛤蜊浓汤口感柔滑，里面有蛤蜊、土豆和少量培根。

definition.en: A baked cream-cheese cake with a dense, smooth filling, usually on a crust.
definition.zh: 用奶油奶酪和鸡蛋烤制的浓厚型芝士蛋糕，质地细密顺滑，部分配方加入酸奶油和柠檬。饼底及水果浇头会变化，与免烤或轻盈舒芙蕾型芝士蛋糕口感不同。

examples.en: The New York cheesecake is rich and smooth, with a slight tang from the filling.
examples.zh: 纽约芝士蛋糕口感浓厚顺滑，内馅带一点清爽酸味。

definition.en: Négociant-Manipulant producer category.
definition.zh: Champagne 标签注册代码，Négociant-Manipulant：购入葡萄、葡萄汁或基酒并完成香槟生产和销售的经营者，也可能拥有自己的葡萄园。

sources.title: Comité Champagne · Understanding the Champagne label
Union des Maisons de Champagne · Etiquetage

definition.en: Beneficial form of Botrytis infection that concentrates grapes and creates complex sweet-wine aromas.
definition.zh: 在合适的湿润与干燥交替条件下，Botrytis cinerea 感染使浆果失水、糖分浓缩，并通过真菌与葡萄的代谢改变酸和香气组成。酸的净变化并非全部一起浓缩；这是 Sauternes/Barsac 等甜酒的重要机制。

sources.title: UC Davis — Developmental and Metabolic Plasticity during Noble Rot

definition.en: Champagne blended without a declared single vintage, often using reserve wines.
definition.zh: 不标示单一收成年份的香槟，常以多个年份和储备酒调配来维持酒庄风格；上市前最低熟成为 15 个月。Non-vintage 是标签状态，不能仅凭 NV 就推断具体混入多少年份。

definition.en: Southern Côte de Nuits village appellation known for Pinot Noir.
definition.zh: 重要村庄级 AOC，拥有大量 Premier Crus 但无 Grand Cru。

definition.en: A spice grated or ground from a hard seed. Small amounts add aromatic depth to creamy potato dishes, pasta fillings, milk-based sauces and baked desserts.
definition.zh: 由坚硬种仁磨粉或刨碎后使用的香料，常少量加入奶香酱汁、土豆焗菜、意面馅料或烘焙甜点。介绍时可强调它带来的是香料气息；本条采用烹饪词义，不指足球中的穿裆动作。

examples.en: There is a little nutmeg in the potato gratin to give the cream a subtle spice note.
examples.zh: 这款奶油焗土豆加了少量肉豆蔻，为奶香增添细微的香料气息。

definition.en: Containing nuts or showing a flavour reminiscent of them; a tasting description alone does not establish the ingredients.
definition.zh: 可指含有坚果，也可指风味让人联想到坚果。用于描述奶酪、谷物等时，并不自动表示加入了坚果；客人询问用料时，需要把风味描述与实际配方分开说明。

examples.en: This cheese has a nutty flavour and a firm texture.
examples.zh: 这款奶酪带坚果风味，质地比较紧实。

definition.en: Eggs gently baked in small individual dishes, often with cream and optional cheese or other additions.
definition.zh: 将鸡蛋打入小烤盅，常加入奶油，再以温和方式焗至凝固；许多做法会隔水烘烤。奶酪、火腿、菠菜等属于可变配料，cocotte 在这里强调盛装与烹调方式，不是固定的一套配方。

sources.title: Richard Bainbridge / Great British Chefs — Eggs en cocotte

examples.en: The eggs are baked in individual ramekins with cream and cheese, with toast served alongside.
examples.zh: 鸡蛋与奶油、奶酪放在独立小烤盅中焗制，旁边配烤面包。

aliases: poached eggs in red wine sauce

definition.en: Poached eggs served with a reduced wine sauce, classically red wine with bacon and shallots.
definition.zh: 勃艮第经典蛋料理，水波蛋配收浓的葡萄酒酱汁；常见红酒版本带有培根丁、红葱头，有时加入蘑菇，并配烤面包。Meurette 指酱汁风格，不能把菜名直接等同于所有水波蛋。

examples.en: The eggs are poached and served with a red wine sauce containing bacon and shallots.
examples.zh: 鸡蛋以水波方式烹调，配含培根和红葱头的红酒酱汁。

definition.en: Hard-boiled eggs, usually halved, topped with mayonnaise and served as a simple cold starter.
definition.zh: 将煮熟、去壳的鸡蛋切半，表面淋上或挤上蛋黄酱，作为冷前菜上桌。蛋黄酱常以蛋黄、芥末和油乳化制成；这道菜的重点是完整蛋块与顺滑酱汁的搭配。

examples.en: Our eggs mayonnaise starter is served cold, with halved boiled eggs and mustard mayonnaise.
examples.zh: 我们的蛋黄酱水煮蛋前菜是冷盘，用切半的水煮蛋搭配芥末蛋黄酱。

definition.en: Served separately from the main food on the plate.
definition.zh: 餐饮语境中指把酱汁或配料另放，可放在小碟或独立容器中；不要直接淋在主食物上。

examples.en: Could I have the sauce on the side?
examples.zh: 酱汁可以另外放吗？

definition.en: Travelling towards a destination, or occurring along the route.
definition.zh: 正在去某地的途中；常接 to + 地点，也可说 on my way to。

examples.en: I’m on the way to the hotel.
examples.zh: 我正在去酒店的路上。

definition.en: Ear-shaped pasta tossed with broccoli rabe, garlic and olive oil, with chilli and other seasonings varying by recipe.
definition.zh: 普利亚常见的耳朵形意面与 cime di rapa 绿叶菜同煮或拌炒，搭配蒜、橄榄油及辣椒。英语菜单常把该菜写成 broccoli rabe 或 rapini，不是普通西兰花花球；某些版本还用凤尾鱼或奶酪。

sources.title: Eataly — Orecchiette con Cime di Rapa
Great British Chefs — How to Make Orecchiette Pasta

examples.en: The orecchiette are tossed with broccoli rabe, garlic and olive oil.
examples.zh: 这道猫耳朵面拌有芜菁嫩叶、蒜和橄榄油。

definition.en: Cross-cut veal shanks braised until tender, often finished with a lemon, parsley, and garlic gremolata.
definition.zh: 带骨横切小牛胫经慢焖至软嫩，骨髓是特色，常用柠檬皮、欧芹和蒜的碎料收尾；酱汁配方有变化。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — Ossobuco alla Milanese

examples.en: The ossobuco is slowly braised veal shank, finished with a fresh lemon-and-herb garnish.
examples.zh: 这道奥索布科是慢焖小牛胫，最后点缀清新的柠檬皮与香草碎。

zh: 西班牙大锅饭／帕埃亚饭

definition.en: A Spanish rice dish cooked in a wide, shallow pan, with ingredients varying by regional style.
definition.zh: 用宽浅锅烹制的西班牙米饭，配料因地区与版本不同；瓦伦西亚经典版可用鸡、兔和豆类，不等于海鲜饭。

examples.en: Today’s paella contains chicken and vegetables; it is not a seafood version.
examples.zh: 今天的帕埃亚饭使用鸡肉和蔬菜，不是海鲜版本。

definition.en: A light food or drink served between courses to refresh the mouth before the next dish.
definition.zh: 两道菜之间供应的小份清口食物或饮品，帮助转换口中风味，雪葩是常见形式；不一定属于正式甜点。

examples.en: This sorbet is a palate cleanser before your next course.
examples.zh: 这份雪葩用于下一道菜之前清口。

definition.en: Bread rubbed with ripe tomato and dressed with olive oil and salt.
definition.zh: 加泰罗尼亚常见的番茄面包，又称 pa amb tomàquet。将熟番茄的果肉和汁擦在面包上，再加橄榄油及盐；面包也可先烘烤。可单独作配餐，也常与火腿、奶酪等一起上桌。

examples.en: Would you like some pan con tomate with your starters?
examples.zh: 您想配一份番茄面包和前菜一起享用吗？

definition.en: Cooked in a frying pan using a relatively small amount of fat.
definition.zh: 用平底锅和较少油脂煎制，不等于浸在大量油中的 deep-fried。

examples.en: The fish is pan-fried.
examples.zh: 这道鱼是平底锅煎的。

definition.en: Italian cured pork belly, seasoned and matured before use. Its fat and savoury flavour enrich sauces, fillings and pasta dishes; it comes from a different cut than guanciale.
definition.zh: 以猪腹部肉腌制并熟成的意式肉制品，肥瘦相间，常为酱汁、馅料和意面提供油脂与咸鲜味。它与取自猪颊或下颌部的 guanciale 部位不同，服务时应明确它属于猪肉。

examples.en: This pasta contains pancetta, which is cured pork belly and adds a savoury richness.
examples.zh: 这款意面含有意式腌猪腹肉，能增加咸鲜与浓润口感。

definition.en: A tall, star-shaped Italian sweet bread with a soft, buttery crumb, usually dusted with icing sugar.
definition.zh: 用富含黄油与鸡蛋的发酵面团烤成高耸的星形甜面包，表面常撒糖粉，内部柔软、色泽金黄并带香草气息。经典潘多洛以面包本身的黄油香为主，与常含葡萄干及糖渍果皮的潘妮托妮形成鲜明区别。

examples.en: Pandoro is our soft, buttery sweet bread, served with a light dusting of icing sugar.
examples.zh: 潘多洛是一款柔软、黄油香浓的甜面包，上桌前会薄薄撒上糖粉。

definition.en: A tall, domed Italian festive sweet bread made from enriched, slowly fermented dough, traditionally studded with raisins and candied citrus peel.
definition.zh: 高耸圆顶状的意式节庆甜面包，以加入黄油和蛋黄的面团经较长时间发酵制成，组织轻盈而有拉丝感。经典版本加入葡萄干和糖渍柑橘皮，切片后可作早餐、茶点或甜点。

sources.title: Andrea Tortora / Great Italian Chefs — Panettone

examples.en: Would you like a slice of panettone with your coffee? It contains raisins and candied orange peel.
examples.zh: 您想配咖啡来一片潘妮托妮吗？里面有葡萄干和糖渍橙皮。

definition.en: A chilled dessert made from sweetened cream, commonly set with gelatine and served with a topping.
definition.zh: 甜奶油液经加热调味后冷藏凝固的意式甜点，常用吉利丁，也可能加入牛奶；应确认凝固剂及搭配酱汁。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — How to Make Panna Cotta

examples.en: The panna cotta is a softly set cream dessert with a smooth texture.
examples.zh: 这道意式奶冻以奶油为基础，凝固柔软、口感细滑。

definition.en: Ligurian filled pasta with greens and cheese, served with a walnut sauce.
definition.zh: 利古里亚的饱满馅面，常见三角形，内馅由绿叶菜、香草和奶酪组成，配核桃酱。野菜组合和替代用的菠菜、莙荙菜会因配方而异；菜名中的 salsa di noci 明确指出核桃酱。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — pansotti con salsa di noci

examples.en: The pansotti are filled with greens and cheese, and the sauce is made with walnuts.
examples.zh: 这道馅面的内馅是绿叶菜和奶酪，酱汁由核桃制成。

definition.en: A Tuscan bread salad with tomatoes, onion, basil and an oil-and-vinegar dressing.
definition.zh: 以面包吸收番茄汁、油醋汁，搭配番茄、洋葱和罗勒的沙拉，常见于托斯卡纳。传统会把稍干的面包浸软后挤干，现代版本也可烤脆；黄瓜等配料随配方变化。

examples.en: The panzanella combines tomatoes, basil and bread that absorbs the dressing.
examples.zh: 这道面包沙拉有番茄和罗勒，面包会吸收调味汁。

definition.en: Baked aubergine halves filled with minced meat and topped with béchamel.
definition.zh: 将茄子纵向切半，烤软后填入肉末酱，覆上白酱再烤至表面上色。茄子本身保留作承托馅料的外壳；与层叠的 moussaka 相比，摆盘更像一只只茄子小船。

examples.en: Papoutsakia are baked aubergine halves with a meat filling and a béchamel topping.
examples.zh: Papoutsakia 是填入肉馅、覆上白酱再焗烤的半只茄子。

zh: 托斯卡纳番茄面包浓汤

definition.en: A thick Tuscan soup of tomatoes and bread, flavoured with basil, garlic and olive oil.
definition.zh: 托斯卡纳以面包、番茄、罗勒、蒜和橄榄油煮成的浓汤；面包在汤中吸汁并煮散，所以质地很稠。它可以温热或放凉后供应，服务时应说明本店温度，不能只译成普通番茄汤。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — pappa al pomodoro

examples.en: The pappa al pomodoro is thickened with bread and finished with basil and olive oil.
examples.zh: 这道番茄浓汤用面包增加稠度，最后加入罗勒和橄榄油。

definition.en: Traditional white grape used in Cava, often grown in higher sites.
definition.zh: Macabeo、Xarel·lo 与 Parellada 构成经典 Cava 白葡萄组合；Parellada 常用于提供较轻盈的口感和细致香气。

definition.en: A ring-shaped choux pastry filled with praline-flavoured cream, often finished with almonds.
definition.zh: 经典形态为环状泡芙，切开后夹入带焦糖坚果风味的 praline 奶油，常以杏仁装饰。它不是面包圈；坚果种类和奶油组成可因配方变化，介绍时应说清具体馅料。

sources.title: Merlin Labron-Johnson / Great British Chefs — Classic Paris-Brest
Chef Philippe / Meilleur du Chef — Paris-Brest

examples.en: The Paris-Brest is a choux pastry ring filled with praline cream.
examples.zh: 巴黎布雷斯特是环状泡芙，内夹焦糖坚果奶油。

definition.en: Layers of cooked aubergine, tomato sauce and cheese baked together.
definition.zh: 将茄子片与番茄酱、奶酪层叠焗烤，常用马苏里拉和帕尔马干酪。茄子通常先炸，也有烤制版本；它不含意面层，不能因为外观层叠就称为 lasagne。

sources.title: The Italian Chef — Parmigiana di Melanzane

examples.en: The parmigiana is layered aubergine baked with tomato sauce and cheese.
examples.zh: 这道焗茄子是把茄子、番茄酱和奶酪分层铺好后烤制。

definition.en: A root vegetable valued for its earthy sweetness. It becomes particularly sweet when roasted and can also be mashed, puréed or blended into a warming soup.
definition.zh: 西餐常用的根类蔬菜，带有根茎的泥土气息与自然甜味。烤制能突出甜润口感，也常用于蔬菜泥、浓汤或冬季配菜；介绍时可强调它与土豆不同的甜香。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook parsnips

examples.en: The roasted parsnips are naturally sweet and have lightly caramelised edges.
examples.zh: 烤欧洲防风草根本身带甜味，边缘有轻微焦糖化的香气。

definition.en: Pasta coated with rendered guanciale fat, Pecorino Romano, black pepper and a little pasta water to form a glossy sauce.
definition.zh: 以腌制猪颊肉 guanciale、佩科里诺罗马羊奶酪和黑胡椒拌成的意面，借助面汤把油脂与奶酪融合成光亮酱汁。它与 carbonara 的重要区别是经典 gricia 不用鸡蛋；面型可为粗管面或长意面。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — Pasta alla gricia

examples.en: The gricia is made with cured pork cheek, Pecorino Romano and black pepper.
examples.zh: 这道 gricia 意面用腌制猪颊肉、佩科里诺罗马羊奶酪和黑胡椒制作。

definition.en: Pasta with tomato sauce and fried aubergine, traditionally finished with grated ricotta salata.
definition.zh: 以番茄酱和炸茄子拌面的西西里风味意面，经典常撒咸味熟成瑞可塔；并非用新鲜瑞可塔做奶油酱。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — Pasta alla Norma

examples.en: Pasta alla Norma pairs aubergine and tomato with a finish of salty ricotta salata.
examples.zh: 诺尔玛意面将茄子、番茄与最后撒上的咸味瑞可塔相结合。

definition.en: An Italian soup combining beans and pasta in a broth that may be thick or soupy.
definition.zh: 将豆类与意面一同煮成的意式汤菜，可浓稠也可较多汤汁，豆种、面形与是否加入腌肉均有地区差异。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — Pasta e Fagioli by Valeria Necchio

examples.en: Pasta e fagioli combines tender beans and small pasta in a hearty broth.
examples.zh: 这道豆类面汤将软熟豆子和小型意面放在浓郁汤汁中。

definition.en: Fried cakes made from flaked salt cod, mashed potato, eggs and herbs.
definition.zh: 脱盐鳕鱼煮熟拆碎，与土豆泥、鸡蛋、洋葱及欧芹混合塑形后油炸。通常外层酥香、内里柔软；名称中的 pastéis 在这里指咸味炸点，并非甜挞。

sources.title: Visit Portugal / Lisbon Tourism and Hospitality School — Codfish Cakes

examples.en: These cod cakes have a crisp outside and a soft filling of salt cod and potato.
examples.zh: 这些鳕鱼炸丸外层酥脆，内里是柔软的鳕鱼与土豆馅。

definition.en: A small puff-pastry tart filled with egg custard and baked until the top is browned.
definition.zh: 酥皮小挞内盛以蛋黄、奶和糖为主的卡仕达馅，高温烤出焦褐色表面。复数是 pastéis de nata；不是所有葡式蛋挞都应称为 Pastéis de Belém。

sources.title: Visit Portugal / Lisbon Tourism and Hospitality School — Pastéis de Nata

examples.en: The pastel de nata has a crisp pastry shell and a soft egg-custard centre.
examples.zh: 这枚葡式蛋挞外皮酥脆，内馅是柔软的蛋奶卡仕达。

zh: 那不勒斯麦粒瑞可塔甜派

definition.en: A Neapolitan pastry tart filled with ricotta, cooked wheat, candied citrus and orange-blossom flavouring.
definition.zh: 那不勒斯传统甜派，用酥皮包裹瑞可塔奶酪、煮熟麦粒、蜜饯柑橘皮和橙花香气的馅料，常见于复活节。麦粒带来细碎颗粒感；也存在替换谷物的版本，不能只把它介绍成普通芝士蛋糕。

examples.en: The pastiera has a ricotta and wheat filling with a delicate orange-blossom aroma.
examples.zh: 这道甜派里面是瑞可塔奶酪和麦粒馅，带柔和的橙花香。

zh: 希腊肉酱白汁焗通心粉

definition.en: A Greek baked pasta dish layered with meat sauce and topped with béchamel.
definition.zh: 通心粉与肉酱分层，表面铺 béchamel 白汁后烤至定形。常用粗管状意面，肉酱可带香料；其构造与用茄子为主的 moussaka 不同。

sources.title: Visit Greece — Local flavours of Greek cuisine

examples.en: Pastitsio has layers of pasta and meat sauce beneath a creamy béchamel topping.
examples.zh: Pastitsio 的意面和肉酱分层，上面覆盖奶香白汁。

zh: 里奥哈风味香肠炖土豆

definition.en: A Rioja-style potato stew with chorizo, onion, garlic and paprika, simmered until the potatoes soften and flavour the broth.
definition.zh: 里奥哈风味炖菜，将土豆、西班牙红椒香肠、洋葱、蒜和红椒粉一起慢炖，使土豆变软，并让香肠风味融入汤汁。

examples.en: This is a warming potato stew with chorizo and paprika.
examples.zh: 这是一道加入西班牙红椒香肠和红椒粉的暖胃土豆炖菜。

definition.en: Spanish fried potatoes served with bravas sauce, with accompaniments varying by region and kitchen.
definition.zh: 炸土豆配布拉瓦斯酱的西班牙小食，酱汁通常带辣味，部分版本另配蒜酱；辣度与配方须按本店解释。

examples.en: The patatas bravas come with the spicy sauce on the side.
examples.zh: 这道西班牙炸土豆的辣酱会另外盛放。

definition.en: A seasoned meat filling baked inside a pastry case, then cooled and sliced for serving.
definition.zh: 将调味肉馅包在面皮中烘烤，冷却后切片供应，是法式熟肉冷盘的经典品项。肉类可用猪肉、禽肉等组合，常有肉冻；en croûte 表示包裹在面皮中，不代表馅料只能用肝。

sources.title: Matt Ryle / Great British Chefs — Pâté en croûte

examples.en: This pâté is baked in pastry and served in slices; I can explain the meats in today’s filling.
examples.zh: 这款肉酱派在面皮中烘烤后切片供应；我可以为您介绍今天肉馅的组成。

definition.en: Major communal appellation of the Haut-Médoc, home to several First Growths.
definition.zh: Cabernet Sauvignon、gravel、1855 classified growths 的核心产区节点。

definition.en: Atlantic-influenced western Loire subregion centered on Muscadet.
definition.zh: 卢瓦尔最西部、海洋影响最强的子区，以 Melon B 与 Muscadet 为核心。

sources.title: Fédération des Vins de Nantes · Muscadet sur lie
InterLoire · Climate and geology of Loire wines

definition.en: A pastry pie filled with pecans in a sweet, softly set egg-and-syrup mixture.
definition.zh: 在派皮中填入碧根果、鸡蛋、黄油和糖浆调成的甜馅，烘烤后切片上桌。上层坚果带烘烤香，下面的馅柔软浓甜，常配奶油或香草冰淇淋。Pecan 指碧根果，也称美洲山核桃。

sources.title: Susan Reid / King Arthur Baking — Pecan Pie

examples.en: The pecan pie has a nutty top and a soft, sweet filling.
examples.zh: 碧根果派上层有坚果香，内馅柔软香甜。

definition.en: A family of Italian sheep-milk cheeses, including regional styles such as Romano and Sardo. Aged versions can be firm and savoury, suitable for grating over pasta.
definition.zh: 意大利绵羊奶酪的一类名称，包含 Romano、Sardo 等地区品种，并非单指一种固定奶酪。熟成后的品种可较硬、咸鲜，常刨碎搭配意面；介绍时应尽量说清具体品种。

sources.title: Eataly — The milk behind the cheese
