examples.en: We finish this pasta with Pecorino Romano, a savoury sheep-milk cheese.
examples.zh: 这款意面最后撒上佩科里诺罗马诺奶酪，是一种咸鲜的绵羊奶酪。

definition.en: Penne coated in a tomato sauce whose heat comes from chilli, with garlic and olive oil.
definition.zh: 斜管面搭配以番茄、蒜、橄榄油和辣椒为基础的辣酱。Arrabbiata 指这类辣番茄做法，实际辣度取决于厨师用量；不同餐厅也可能改变配面或撒上的奶酪。

examples.en: The penne all’arrabbiata has a spicy tomato sauce; I can check how hot today’s batch is.
examples.zh: 这道通心粉用的是辣番茄酱；我可以确认一下今天这批酱的辣度。

definition.en: Continuously refreshed reserve-wine system containing multiple vintages.
definition.zh: 持续补充式储备酒体系，形成多年份累积；概念类似动态 reserve，但不应简单等同于 Sherry solera。

sources.title: Champagne Philipponnat · Réserve perpétuelle and réserve essentielle

definition.en: Prestigious appellation within the Graves area producing red and dry white wines.
definition.zh: 顶级红白波尔多的重要产区，连接 Graves Classification、Haut-Brion、Domaine de Chevalier 等。

definition.en: A sauce traditionally blending basil, garlic, pine nuts, hard cheeses, olive oil, and salt.
definition.zh: 经典热那亚青酱以罗勒、松子、蒜、硬质奶酪和橄榄油制成；现代青酱有变体，需核对实际原料。

examples.en: Our basil pesto contains pine nuts and cheese.
examples.zh: 我们这款罗勒青酱含有松子和奶酪。

definition.en: Informal term for sparkling wines made by ancestral-style bottle fermentation.
definition.zh: 通常指 méthode ancestrale 风格：一次发酵在瓶中完成，可能保留沉淀并呈较低压力。

sources.title: WSET · A guide to sparkling wine production methods and regional styles

definition.en: Chardonnay appellation in the Chablis area, often on plateaux and higher slopes.
definition.zh: 夏布利地区的独立 Chardonnay AOC，常分布于台地和较高坡位。它与 Chablis、Chablis Premier Cru、Chablis Grand Cru 有不同的划界与规则；“Petit”不是对单瓶品质的保证或否定。

definition.en: Rare authorised Champagne variety.
definition.zh: Champagne 允许的少量传统白葡萄品种之一，可用于学习 Chardonnay、Pinot Noir 与 Meunier 之外的香槟组成。

zh: 法式盐渍猪肉炖小扁豆

definition.en: Lightly salt-cured pork, such as hock or belly, slowly cooked and served with lentils and aromatic vegetables.
definition.zh: 先把盐渍猪肘、猪五花等适当浸泡脱盐，再慢煮至软嫩，搭配小扁豆和芳香蔬菜。Petit salé 指轻度盐渍的猪肉，而 lentilles 在这里是小扁豆，不是中国菜里常见的鲜扁豆荚。

sources.title: Chef Philippe / Meilleur du Chef — Petit salé aux lentilles

examples.en: This dish combines slow-cooked salt-cured pork with tender lentils.
examples.zh: 这道菜把慢煮盐渍猪肉与软嫩的小扁豆搭配在一起。

definition.en: Late-ripening Bordeaux black grape used mainly in small proportions.
definition.zh: 晚熟、颜色深、结构与辛香感强，传统上多见于 Left Bank blend 的小比例补充。

sources.title: CIVB — The Art of the Blend

definition.en: The timing and sequence of recurring vine-development stages, including budburst, flowering, fruit set and ripening, in relation to environmental conditions.
definition.zh: 葡萄藤周期性发育阶段的时序及其与环境条件的关系，包括萌芽、开花、坐果与成熟。

definition.en: A long roll filled with thinly sliced or chopped hot beef and melted cheese.
definition.zh: 把薄切或切碎的牛肉在铁板上煎熟，拌上融化的奶酪，装入长形面包。常见奶酪选择有奶酪酱、美式奶酪或普罗沃洛内奶酪，炒洋葱可选。Cheesesteak 在这里是一种热三明治的名称。

sources.title: Visit Philadelphia — A Guide to the Best Cheesesteaks in Philadelphia

examples.en: Would you like sautéed onions with your Philly cheesesteak?
examples.zh: 您的费城牛肉奶酪长包要加炒洋葱吗？

definition.en: A grapevine pest that attacks roots and/or leaves, historically devastating Vitis vinifera vineyards.
definition.zh: 葡萄根瘤蚜危机推动欧洲葡萄园广泛采用抗性美洲种砧木嫁接 Vitis vinifera；它是理解现代砧木体系的核心历史与栽培概念。

sources.title: Oregon State University — Grape phylloxera biology and management
Penn State Extension — Backyard grape growing

definition.en: Small green Padrón peppers fried in olive oil and finished with coarse salt. They are served whole as a tapa, and some peppers can be hot.
definition.zh: 将帕德龙小青椒整只放入橄榄油中煎炸，出锅后撒粗盐，常作为塔帕斯供应。不同青椒的辣度不一致，其中有些会辣。

sources.title: Spain Tourism — Preparation of Padrón peppers

examples.en: These little peppers are fried and salted; some may have a spicy kick.
examples.zh: 这些小青椒经过油煎后撒盐调味，其中有些可能会辣。

definition.en: Principal red grape of Burgundy.
definition.zh: 勃艮第核心红葡萄，极易体现 site、vintage、yield、clonal material 与 producer choices 的差异。

definition.en: A savoury bread-dough tart topped with slowly cooked onions, anchovies, and black olives.
definition.zh: 面团铺上慢煮洋葱、鳀鱼和黑橄榄后烤制的尼斯咸饼，突出洋葱甜味与鱼的咸鲜，可温食或放凉供应。

sources.title: Nice Côte d’Azur Tourist Office — La Pissaladière

examples.en: The pissaladière is topped with soft onions, anchovies, and black olives.
examples.zh: 这道尼斯咸饼上铺有软煮洋葱、鳀鱼和黑橄榄。

definition.en: Vegetables such as tomatoes, peppers, courgettes and onions slowly cooked in olive oil until soft. It is often served with an egg, while some versions include ham.
definition.zh: 将番茄、甜椒、西葫芦和洋葱等蔬菜用橄榄油慢煮至软的拉曼恰风味菜。常搭配煎蛋或焗蛋，也有加入火腿的版本。

sources.title: Spain Tourism — Pisto manchego con huevos

examples.en: The vegetables are slowly cooked until soft, with tomato tying the flavours together.
examples.zh: 蔬菜慢慢煮至软嫩，番茄将各种风味融合起来。

definition.en: A baked pizza topped with tomato, mozzarella, basil, and olive oil.
definition.zh: 以面团为底，铺番茄、马苏里拉、罗勒和橄榄油后烤制的经典披萨；饼底风格、奶酪类型依餐厅而异。

sources.title: Associazione Verace Pizza Napoletana — Pizza Margherita

examples.en: The Margherita is topped with tomato, mozzarella, fresh basil, and olive oil.
examples.zh: 这款玛格丽特披萨配番茄、马苏里拉、新鲜罗勒和橄榄油。

zh: 番茄蒜香玛丽娜拉披萨

definition.en: A pizza topped with tomato, garlic, oregano and olive oil, with a simple, fragrant topping.
definition.zh: 以番茄、蒜、牛至和橄榄油为主要配料的披萨。经典做法不放奶酪或海鲜，因此介绍 marinara 时可直接说清番茄与蒜香的组合，避免客人把名称理解成海鲜披萨。

examples.en: The marinara is topped with tomato, garlic, oregano and olive oil.
examples.zh: 这款玛丽娜拉披萨的配料是番茄、蒜、牛至和橄榄油。

definition.en: A pizza topped with four cheeses, combining different melting qualities and flavours; the cheese selection depends on the recipe.
definition.zh: Quattro formaggi 意为四种奶酪，指以四款奶酪组合成配料的披萨。常见选择包括马苏里拉、戈贡佐拉、普罗沃洛内及塔莱吉奥；不同餐厅可更换组合，介绍时列出本店实际使用的奶酪最有帮助。

sources.title: Gozney / Feng Chen — Pizza quattro formaggi

examples.en: Our four-cheese pizza includes Gorgonzola, which adds a distinctive blue-cheese flavour.
examples.zh: 我们的四种奶酪披萨包含戈贡佐拉，带有明显的蓝纹奶酪风味。

zh: 瓦尔泰利纳奶酪荞麦面

definition.en: Buckwheat pasta cooked with potatoes and greens, then layered with cheese and dressed with garlic butter.
definition.zh: 北意瓦尔泰利纳的短条荞麦面，与土豆和卷心菜等绿叶菜同煮，再与当地奶酪、蒜香黄油组合。传统面团也含普通小麦粉，因此不能仅因名称有荞麦就承诺无麸质；绿叶菜会按季节替换。

sources.title: Accademia del Pizzocchero di Teglio — La ricetta originale

examples.en: The pizzoccheri combine buckwheat pasta, potatoes, cabbage and melted cheese.
examples.zh: 这道瓦尔泰利纳荞麦面有土豆、卷心菜和融化的奶酪。

definition.en: The commercial ecosystem linking châteaux, courtiers, négociants and global buyers.
definition.zh: 并非单一物理市场，而是由生产者、经纪人与酒商共同构成的分销与交易网络。

definition.en: A word added to a request to make it more polite.
definition.zh: 用于礼貌请求的表达；配合 could you、may I 等句型，语气也应友好。

examples.en: Could you repeat that, please?
examples.zh: 请你再说一遍，好吗？

definition.en: A cold lunch centred on cheese, crusty bread and pickles.
definition.zh: 以大块奶酪、外皮酥脆的面包和腌洋葱等酸味配料组成的冷食午餐。奶酪的浓香与腌菜的酸爽形成对比，可以把面包与奶酪、腌菜搭着吃。菜名中的 ploughman 原指犁田的人，点餐时指的是这类冷盘组合。

sources.title: James Beard Foundation / Rosemary Howe — Stilton Ploughman’s Lunch

examples.en: Our ploughman’s lunch is a cold plate of cheese, crusty bread and pickled onions.
examples.zh: 我们的英式奶酪面包冷盘配奶酪、脆皮面包和腌洋葱。

definition.en: To cook food gently in liquid kept below a full boil.
definition.zh: 把食材放入未剧烈沸腾的液体中温和煮熟，常见于鸡蛋、鱼或水果；液体可为水、高汤或糖浆。

sources.title: Iowa State University — Glossary of Cooking Terms

examples.en: The pear is poached in a lightly spiced syrup.
examples.zh: 这只梨在带少量香料的糖浆中温和煮制。

definition.en: Soft polenta enriched with melted cheese and butter; the Aosta Valley version commonly uses Fontina.
definition.zh: 煮好的玉米糊拌入奶酪和黄油，质地柔滑浓郁，可作配菜或较饱腹的主食。奥斯塔谷常用 Fontina，其他地方可能选不同奶酪；这不是所有 polenta 都必有的配方。

examples.en: Our polenta concia is soft and creamy, with melted Fontina and butter.
examples.zh: 我们的奶酪玉米糊质地柔滑，加入了融化的芳提娜奶酪和黄油。

definition.en: Chicken pieces browned and then stewed with vegetables, herbs, and wine, often in a tomato sauce.
definition.zh: 鸡块先煎上色，再与蔬菜、香草和葡萄酒慢炖，常见番茄酱汁版本；各地配料和红白酒选择有所不同。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — Pollo alla Cacciatora by Filippo Trapella

examples.en: The chicken cacciatore is gently stewed with tomato, herbs, and wine.
examples.zh: 这道猎人炖鸡以番茄、香草和葡萄酒温和慢炖。

definition.en: Italian meatballs finished in tomato sauce, with a meat mixture that may include softened bread, egg, herbs and grated cheese.
definition.zh: 将调味肉馅拌入泡软的面包、鸡蛋、香草或磨碎的奶酪，做成肉丸，再与番茄酱汁一起烹煮。肉馅可以是猪肉或其他组合；上菜时重点介绍柔嫩的肉丸与番茄酱，而不是默认它一定配意面。

sources.title: Chef Antonia Klugmann / La Cucina Italiana — Polpette al sugo e fritte

examples.en: These pork meatballs are gently cooked in tomato sauce.
examples.zh: 这些猪肉丸用番茄酱汁慢慢煮至入味。

definition.en: Tender cooked octopus finished in the oven with garlic, olive oil and potatoes.
definition.zh: 章鱼先煮至柔软，再与蒜、充足橄榄油及土豆入炉。常配轻压裂的带皮小土豆 batatas a murro；这里是章鱼菜，à lagareiro 这种做法也可用于鳕鱼。

sources.title: Chef Marco Gomes / RTP — Polvo à Lagareiro

examples.en: The octopus is tender inside and finished with garlic olive oil and lightly crushed potatoes.
examples.zh: 章鱼内部柔软，配蒜香橄榄油和轻压裂的小土豆。

definition.en: Small prestigious Right Bank appellation dominated by Merlot-based red wines.
definition.zh: 无类似 1855 的官方 château ranking；clay/gravel mosaic 与 Merlot 是核心理解点。

definition.en: Côte de Beaune village appellation focused on Pinot Noir.
definition.zh: 伯恩丘重要红酒村，常作为较有结构感的 Pinot Noir 学习 anchor。

definition.en: Thin potato slices layered with butter and cooked into a cake with browned edges and a tender centre.
definition.zh: 把土豆薄片与黄油层层叠放，煎烤成有层次的圆饼或块状配菜，边缘焦香、内部柔软。这里的 pommes 指 pommes de terre（土豆），不是苹果；与奶油焗土豆并非同一道菜。

sources.title: Institute of Culinary Education — Pommes Anna

examples.en: The pommes Anna are layered potatoes cooked with butter until crisp around the edges.
examples.zh: 安娜土豆饼把土豆与黄油层层叠放，烹调至边缘酥脆。

definition.en: Boneless pork seasoned with herbs and garlic, rolled or prepared as a whole roast, then roasted and sliced.
definition.zh: 去骨猪肉以蒜和香草调味后烤制，常见有猪皮的卷状大块，切片供应或夹入面包。茴香、迷迭香及所用部位因地区和餐厅而异；它是烤肉，不能与风干火腿 prosciutto 混同。

examples.en: The porchetta is sliced roast pork with a crisp skin and fragrant herbs.
examples.zh: 这道意式烤猪肉会切片上桌，带脆皮和香草风味。

zh: 牛肝菌〔常指美味牛肝菌类〕

definition.en: Edible wild mushrooms prized for their deep, earthy flavour, used fresh or dried.
definition.zh: 意大利菜单中常见的食用牛肝菌名称，风味浓郁，可鲜用或干制，用于烩饭、意面和酱汁。

examples.en: The risotto is made with porcini mushrooms.
examples.zh: 这道意式烩饭使用了牛肝菌。

definition.en: A Basque soup or light stew centred on leeks and potatoes.
definition.zh: 以韭葱和土豆为主的巴斯克汤菜，蔬菜煮软后形成清淡、带自然甜味的汤汁。有些版本加入南瓜等蔬菜，也有加鳕鱼的做法；核心识别点是韭葱与土豆。

examples.en: Porrusalda is a warming leek and potato soup.
examples.zh: Porrusalda 是一道暖胃的韭葱土豆汤。

definition.en: Beef and vegetables gently simmered in water to produce tender meat and a clear, savoury broth.
definition.zh: 牛肉、骨头与根茎等蔬菜在水中缓慢煮成清鲜汤汁，肉与蔬菜可分开或同汤供应，区别于红酒浓汁炖肉。

sources.title: Le Cordon Bleu — French Cooking Techniques

examples.en: The pot-au-feu features gently simmered beef and vegetables with a clear broth.
examples.zh: 这道清汤炖牛肉以慢煮牛肉和蔬菜搭配清鲜汤汁。

definition.en: Small brown shrimps packed with spiced butter, usually offered with toast.
definition.zh: 把熟的小棕虾与带肉豆蔻衣、辣椒等香料的黄油装入小罐或小盅中，常配烤面包。黄油带来浓香，小虾保留颗粒与海鲜鲜味；可做冷藏凝固的黄油封虾，也有厨师温热装盅的版本。

sources.title: Josh Eggleton / Great British Chefs — Potted Shrimp with Mace Butter

examples.en: The potted shrimps come with toast for the spiced shrimp butter.
examples.zh: 这份黄油封小虾配烤面包，可以搭着香料虾黄油一起吃。

definition.en: Mâconnais Chardonnay appellation with recognized Premier Cru climats.
definition.zh: Mâconnais 旗舰白酒 AOC；现代法规下已有 Premier Cru climats，旧教材“无一级园”信息应视为过时。

definition.en: Centre-Loire Sauvignon Blanc appellation on the right bank of the Loire.
definition.zh: 100% Sauvignon Blanc；官方地质包含 caillottes、terres blanches、silex 等。

definition.en: Small Centre-Loire appellation based on Chasselas.
definition.zh: 与 Pouilly-Fumé 必须区分：这里核心葡萄是 Chasselas，不是 Sauvignon Blanc。

definition.en: Chicken cooked with peppers, tomatoes, onion and garlic in a Basque-style sauce.
definition.zh: 鸡肉与彩椒、番茄、洋葱、蒜等一起烹煮的巴斯克风味料理，常加入埃斯佩莱特辣椒或其他香料。它的重点是蔬菜酱汁与鸡肉结合；辣度、配米饭或其他主食，需要按具体菜单确认。

sources.title: Stevan Paul / Taste France — Poulet Basquaise

examples.en: The chicken is cooked with tomatoes, sweet peppers and a little Espelette pepper.
examples.zh: 鸡肉与番茄、甜椒和少量埃斯佩莱特辣椒一起烹煮。

definition.en: Chicken pieces cooked with a sauce of mushrooms, shallots, white wine and tomato, often finished with herbs.
definition.zh: 先将鸡块煎上色，再搭配蘑菇、红葱头、白葡萄酒与番茄制成的酱汁烹调，常以龙蒿、欧芹等香草收尾。Chasseur 是法式猎人风味酱汁的提示，蘑菇和红葱头是介绍中的重点。

sources.title: Chloé Charles / Académie du Goût — Poulet sauté chasseur

examples.en: The chicken chasseur comes with mushrooms, shallots and a white-wine tomato sauce.
examples.zh: 法式猎人鸡配蘑菇、红葱头，以及白葡萄酒和番茄制成的酱汁。

definition.en: A fungal disease caused by Erysiphe necator, producing powdery growth on leaves, berries and other green tissues.
definition.zh: 由真菌 Erysiphe necator 引起，可在叶片、果粒及其他绿色组织表面形成粉状菌层。

definition.en: To like or choose one option more than another.
definition.zh: 在选项之间更喜欢某一个。可用 prefer A to B，也可用 would prefer + 名词或 to do。

examples.en: Would you prefer still water?
examples.zh: 您更想喝无气矿泉水吗？

definition.en: Burgundy designation for legally defined climats within village appellations.
definition.zh: 勃艮第 Premier Cru 通常是 Village AOC 内被批准使用 Premier Cru mention 的特定 Climat。

definition.en: Top distinction within the current Saint-Émilion classification.
definition.zh: 2022 classification 中 Château Figeac 与 Château Pavie 获 Distinction A。

sources.title: Conseil des Vins de Saint-Émilion — New classification 2022

definition.en: Wine extracted from fermented grape solids by pressing.
definition.zh: 红酒发酵/浸渍后通过压榨果渣获得的酒液，通常比自流部分含更多酚类与结构成分。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: Applying pressure to grapes or pomace to separate liquid from solids.
definition.zh: 白葡萄通常在发酵前压榨取汁，红葡萄常在浸渍/发酵后压榨；压榨强度会影响酚类和质地。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: The span of prices being considered, from a lower to an upper amount.
definition.zh: 所考虑的最低至最高价格范围；可用于自然地了解客人的预算。

examples.en: Do you have a price range in mind?
examples.zh: 您有考虑的价格区间吗？

definition.en: To decide which tasks or needs should receive attention first.
definition.zh: 判断并安排事项的先后顺序。prioritise 是常见英式拼写，prioritize 是常见美式拼写。

examples.en: We need to prioritise urgent requests.
examples.zh: 我们需要优先处理紧急请求。

definition.en: Fermentation that develops the bubbles in sparkling wine.
definition.zh: 字面是“起泡过程”。在 Champagne 语境中，指 tirage 后瓶内二次发酵：酵母产生额外酒精与 CO₂，形成气泡和瓶压。其他起泡酒的 prise de mousse 不一定在瓶中进行。

definition.en: Small choux pastry buns filled with cream or ice cream, often served with chocolate sauce.
definition.zh: 小型泡芙壳烤成后填入奶油或冰淇淋，常淋巧克力酱，外壳与柔软内馅形成对比；馅料和酱汁须确认。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to Make Profiteroles
Great British Chefs — Chocolate Profiteroles by Geoffrey Smeddle

examples.en: The profiteroles are small filled choux buns served with chocolate sauce.
examples.zh: 这些普罗菲特罗尔是填馅的小泡芙，搭配巧克力酱供应。

zh: 意式火腿〔英语常指生火腿〕

definition.en: In English menus, usually thinly sliced Italian dry-cured ham; Italian usage includes cooked ham too.
definition.zh: 英语菜单常指切薄片的意式风干生火腿；意大利语中也泛指火腿，应区分生火腿与熟火腿。

examples.en: The melon is served with thin slices of prosciutto.
examples.zh: 这道甜瓜配有薄切意式生火腿。

definition.en: Large northeastern Italian appellation for Prosecco.
definition.zh: 意大利东北部较大的 Prosecco DOC 产区，以 Glera 为核心，起泡类型常采用罐式法；也有 frizzante、静态及 Rosé 类型，不能把 Prosecco 等同于单一甜度或气泡强度。

definition.en: Removal and selection of vine wood to regulate structure and crop.
definition.zh: 休眠期或生长期对枝蔓进行选择和去除，用于控制结果点、长势、树形和下一季产量潜力。

sources.title: Penn State Extension — Dormant cane and spur pruning

definition.en: A laminated pastry made by repeatedly folding dough and fat into layers. Steam separates those layers during baking, producing a light, crisp shell for sweet or savoury dishes.
definition.zh: 将面团与油脂反复折叠、擀开形成层次的面皮，烘烤时蒸汽使薄层分开，产生轻盈酥脆的结构。常用于威灵顿、千层酥或派顶；与逐张铺叠的菲罗面皮做法不同。

sources.title: King Arthur Baking — Classic puff pastry
Great British Chefs — How to choose pastry

examples.en: The beef is wrapped in puff pastry, which bakes into crisp, flaky layers.
examples.zh: 牛肉包在起酥面皮中，烤后形成层层酥脆的外壳。

definition.en: Côte de Beaune village producing major Chardonnay wines.
definition.zh: 连接 Montrachet、Chevalier-Montrachet、Bâtard-Montrachet 等顶级白酒 Grand Cru。

definition.en: Galician-style octopus, boiled until tender, cut into pieces and dressed with olive oil, paprika and coarse salt. It is also known as pulpo a feira.
definition.zh: 将章鱼煮至软嫩，切块后撒上粗盐和红椒粉，再淋橄榄油的加利西亚菜。菜单上也常称 pulpo a feira；红椒粉可有甜味或辣味版本。

sources.title: Spain Tourism — Pulpo a feira recipe

examples.en: The octopus is boiled until tender, then finished with paprika and olive oil.
examples.zh: 章鱼煮至软嫩后，再用红椒粉和橄榄油调味。

definition.en: Pumping fermenting wine from the bottom of a vessel over the cap.
definition.zh: 从发酵容器底部抽取酒液并淋回酒帽，用于促进浸渍、提取、温度和氧管理。

definition.en: Submerging the cap into fermenting wine.
definition.zh: 把酒帽压回酒液中以促进浸渍和提取，常见法语术语为 pigeage。

definition.en: A broad class of nitrogen-containing compounds; methoxypyrazines are the subset linked to green-pepper aromas in wine.
definition.zh: Pyrazines 是一大类含氮杂环化合物；葡萄酒里常讨论的青椒、绿色植物气味主要来自其甲氧基吡嗪子类（methoxypyrazines），如 IBMP。两者不是严格同义，具体含量受品种、果实成熟与光照等影响。

sources.title: UC Davis Waterhouse Lab — Pyrazines and methoxypyrazines

definition.en: Loire sweet-wine appellation entitled to the Grand Cru mention.
definition.zh: 位于 Layon 一带的 Chenin Blanc 甜白 AOP，获准使用 Grand Cru 名称；葡萄通过过熟及可能的贵腐实现自然浓缩。

sources.title: InterLoire · Quarts de Chaume Grand Cru

definition.en: Soft pike dumplings made from fish mixed with a cooked flour or semolina base, eggs and butter, then cooked and sauced.
definition.zh: 以淡水狗鱼（pike / brochet）肉混合熟面糊或粗粒小麦粉基底、鸡蛋和黄油，塑成柔软的椭圆鱼茸丸，常烤焗后配酱汁。里昂菜单上常见的 Nantua 酱以淡水螯虾风味为特色，但并非每一份都用同一种酱。

sources.title: FAO — Northern pike / Brochet du Nord / 白斑狗鱼

examples.en: These are delicate pike dumplings; our version is baked and served with a crayfish sauce.
examples.zh: 这是口感细嫩的狗鱼茸丸，我们的版本以烤焗方式烹调，配淡水螯虾酱汁。

definition.en: A baked pastry tart filled with an egg-and-cream custard and smoked bacon pieces.
definition.zh: 以酥面团为底，填入蛋、奶油和烟熏猪肉丁烘烤的咸派；传统洛林式不以奶酪为必需，现代版本有所变化。

examples.en: The quiche Lorraine is a savoury pastry tart with bacon and a soft egg-and-cream filling.
examples.zh: 洛林咸派有酥皮、培根丁和柔软的蛋奶油内馅。

definition.en: A Spanish oxtail stew in which tail pieces are gently cooked with vegetables and wine until tender, producing a rich sauce. The wine and vegetables vary between recipes.
definition.zh: 西班牙炖牛尾，将牛尾段与洋葱、番茄等蔬菜和葡萄酒一起焖炖至软嫩，形成浓厚酱汁。不同配方所用蔬菜和酒款各不相同。

examples.en: The oxtail is gently braised with vegetables and wine for a rich, savoury sauce.
examples.zh: 牛尾与蔬菜和葡萄酒一起慢炖，形成浓郁咸香的酱汁。

definition.en: Melted cheese served over potatoes with pickled accompaniments.
definition.zh: 菜单中可指把融化奶酪刮下或从小烤盘倒在土豆上，配酸黄瓜、腌洋葱等的菜肴。Raclette 也可指所用奶酪；本词条解释上桌的融奶酪餐，而非奶酪产区或等级。

sources.title: Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs — Switzerland’s National Dishes

examples.en: The raclette is served with potatoes, gherkins and pickled onions.
examples.zh: 拉克莱特融奶酪餐配土豆、酸黄瓜和腌洋葱。

definition.en: Grated potato mixed into pancake batter and pan-fried, often served with pork and lingonberries.
definition.zh: 把土豆丝拌入含面粉、牛奶和鸡蛋的面糊后煎成饼，常配煎猪肉或培根及越橘酱。与主要由土豆丝直接煎成的 rösti 配方不同，介绍时应说明面糊和配菜。

examples.en: The raggmunk are potato pancakes with crisp edges, served with pork and lingonberries.
examples.zh: 瑞典土豆煎饼边缘酥脆，配猪肉和越橘上桌。

definition.en: A vegetable preparation combining aubergine, courgette, peppers, tomato, and herbs, cooked until tender.
definition.zh: 茄子、西葫芦、甜椒和番茄等搭配香草慢慢烹至软嫩的杂菜，可作主菜或配菜，不一定摆成薄片圆环。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Ratatouille by Galton Blackiston

examples.en: The ratatouille is a soft, herb-scented mix of aubergine, courgette, peppers, and tomato.
examples.zh: 这道杂菜以茄子、西葫芦、甜椒和番茄烹至软嫩，带有香草气息。

definition.en: Filled pasta parcels containing ricotta and spinach, served with a sauce chosen by the kitchen.
definition.zh: 用薄面皮包裹瑞可塔奶酪与菠菜馅的意式饺，馅中也常有硬质奶酪和肉豆蔻。这里说明的是馅料组合，番茄酱、黄油等搭配酱汁需要另行确认；ravioli 本身并不限定这种馅。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — ravioli ricotta e spinaci

examples.en: These ravioli have a spinach and ricotta filling, with tomato and basil sauce.
examples.zh: 这些意式饺里面是菠菜和瑞可塔奶酪，搭配番茄罗勒酱。

definition.en: Récoltant-Coopérateur producer category.
definition.zh: 合作社成员借助合作社生产后，以自己的品牌销售。

sources.title: Comité Champagne · Understanding the Champagne label
Union des Maisons de Champagne · Etiquetage

definition.en: A written or digital record showing that payment was received.
definition.zh: 证明款项已收取的纸质或电子凭证。receipt 的 p 不发音，与 recipe（食谱）区分。

examples.en: Could I have a receipt?
examples.zh: 可以给我一张收据吗？

definition.en: To simmer a liquid so that some evaporates, reducing volume and concentrating its flavour.
definition.zh: 通过加热让液体的一部分蒸发，减少体积并集中风味，常用于高汤或酱汁；与加水稀释相反。

examples.en: The sauce is reduced before the butter is added.
examples.zh: 这款酱汁先收浓，再加入黄油。

definition.en: A liquid concentrated through simmering so that water evaporates and flavour becomes more intense.
definition.zh: 液体经加热蒸发水分后得到的浓缩汁，常用于酱汁；既可指收汁过程，也可指完成后的浓缩液。

examples.en: The sauce includes a red wine reduction.
examples.zh: 这款酱汁中加入了红葡萄酒浓缩汁。

definition.en: Money returned to a customer after a payment.
definition.zh: 退还给客人的款项。此处练名词 /ˈriːfʌnd/；动词 refund 常重读第二音节。

examples.en: Can I get a refund?
examples.zh: 我可以获得退款吗？

definition.en: Broad regional appellation level in Burgundy.
definition.zh: 勃艮第 hierarchy 基础层，涵盖 Bourgogne、Bourgogne Aligoté、Coteaux Bourguignons 等。

definition.en: Riddling process that moves lees sediment toward the bottle neck.
definition.zh: 逐步旋转和倾斜瓶身，使沉淀聚集到瓶颈，便于后续 dégorgement。

definition.en: To say or do something again.
definition.zh: 把说过的话或做过的动作再重复一次。服务中常用来确认房号、姓名或订单。

examples.en: Could you repeat the room number?
examples.zh: 能再说一遍房间号码吗？

definition.en: An arrangement to keep a table, room or other service for a customer.
definition.zh: 预先保留桌位、客房等的安排。可 make、confirm 或 cancel a reservation。

examples.en: I have a reservation under the name Wu.
examples.zh: 我用吴先生这个名字订了位。

definition.en: Base wine from previous vintages retained for future blending.
definition.zh: 用于 non-vintage / multi-vintage assemblage，以增强 house style 稳定性、成熟度与复杂度。

sources.title: Champagne Philipponnat · Réserve perpétuelle and réserve essentielle

definition.en: Sugar remaining in wine after fermentation and/or later adjustment.
definition.zh: 成酒中保留下来的糖分；其水平与酸度、酒精、果香和质地共同影响感知甜度。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

zh: 鲁本咸牛肉酸菜三明治

definition.en: A toasted rye sandwich with corned beef, Swiss cheese, sauerkraut and a creamy dressing.
definition.zh: 把咸牛肉、瑞士风格奶酪、德式酸菜与俄式或千岛沙拉酱夹入黑麦面包，煎烤至表面焦脆、奶酪融化。酸菜的酸味平衡肉和奶酪的浓香；部分店也用烟熏腌牛肉 pastrami 制作。

sources.title: James Beard Foundation — James Beard on Making Super Sandwiches

examples.en: The Reuben has corned beef, sauerkraut and melted cheese on rye bread.
examples.zh: 鲁本三明治用黑麦面包，夹咸牛肉、酸菜和融化的奶酪。

zh: 托斯卡纳豆类面包浓汤

definition.en: A thick Tuscan soup of beans, leafy vegetables, and bread, traditionally reheated before serving.
definition.zh: 白豆、叶菜等蔬菜与面包共同炖成的托斯卡纳浓汤，面包吸汤后带来厚实质地，传统做法会再次加热。

examples.en: Ribollita is a hearty bean and vegetable soup thickened with bread.
examples.zh: 这道里波利塔是以面包增加稠度的豆类蔬菜浓汤。

definition.en: A mild, soft Italian-style cheese traditionally made by heating whey left from other cheesemaking.
definition.zh: 质地柔软、风味温和的意式乳酪，传统上以制酪剩余乳清再加热制成；常用于填馅、意面或甜点。

examples.en: The ravioli are filled with ricotta and spinach.
examples.zh: 这道意式饺子以瑞可塔乳酪和菠菜为馅。

definition.en: Sparkling wine made from Riesling, especially associated with Germany.
definition.zh: 以 Riesling 酿制的起泡酒，德国是重要产地；品种的酸度和香气可与起泡工艺结合。Riesling Sekt 本身不等于 Winzersekt，也不单凭名称保证传统法或长期酒泥熟成。

definition.en: Bordeaux shorthand for appellations east/north of the Dordogne, especially Saint-Émilion and Pomerol.
definition.zh: 常以 Merlot 与 Cabernet Franc、clay/limestone、Saint-Émilion 与 Pomerol 为核心理解。

definition.en: Pork slowly cooked until tender, shredded and mixed with its fat and juices to make a spread.
definition.zh: 猪肉经长时间缓慢烹调后撕成细丝，再与油脂和肉汁拌成可涂抹的熟肉酱，常配面包作为前菜。质地保留肉丝，与完全打细的肝酱不同；这里只收录猪肉版本。

sources.title: Emma Macdonald / Great British Chefs — Pork rillettes

examples.en: The pork rillettes have a soft, shredded texture and are served with crusty bread.
examples.zh: 这款猪肉酥酱口感柔软，并保留肉丝，搭配脆皮面包供应。

definition.en: Thin beef slices rolled around a savoury filling and braised in gravy.
definition.zh: 把薄牛肉片卷住芥末、培根、洋葱和酸黄瓜等常见馅料，先煎上色再加液体慢焖，配浓肉汁。Rinder 表明牛肉；rouladen 泛指卷制菜肴，其他肉种或蔬菜卷不应自动映射到此词。

examples.en: The beef rouladen are slowly braised, with a savoury filling and rich gravy.
examples.zh: 这道德式牛肉卷经过慢焖，内有咸香馅料，并配浓肉汁。

definition.en: The progressive physiological and compositional development of grapes before harvest.
definition.zh: 包括糖、酸、酚类、香气前体、种子与果皮状态等多维变化，不能只用糖度判断。

sources.title: New Mexico State University — Grapevine Growth and Phenology

definition.en: An Italian rice dish cooked with stock to develop a creamy texture while retaining some bite.
definition.zh: 米粒与高汤逐步烹调形成顺滑口感的意式米饭，通常保留一定咬感；浓润质地并不表示一定添加奶油。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — How to Make Risotto

examples.en: The mushroom risotto is creamy, with a slight bite to the rice.
examples.zh: 这道蘑菇烩饭口感顺滑，米粒仍保留轻微咬感。

definition.en: A Milanese risotto coloured and flavoured with saffron, traditionally enriched with butter, cheese and often bone marrow.
definition.zh: 米兰式烩饭以藏红花带来的金黄色和香气为识别特点，常以黄油、奶酪增添浓郁感；传统配方可用骨髓与牛肉高汤。它是 risotto 的具体做法，不能把所有烩饭都解释为藏红花烩饭。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — risotto alla Milanese

examples.en: The golden colour comes from saffron; this version is also made with beef stock.
examples.zh: 它的金黄色来自藏红花；这一版本也用了牛肉高汤。

definition.en: Récoltant-Manipulant producer category.
definition.zh: Champagne 标签注册代码，Récoltant-Manipulant：使用自家种植葡萄、完成酿造并自行销售的酒农生产者。代码反映经营身份，本身不是风格或质量等级。

sources.title: Comité Champagne · Understanding the Champagne label
Union des Maisons de Champagne · Etiquetage

definition.en: To cook food using dry heat, commonly in an oven, often developing a browned exterior.
definition.zh: 利用干热烤制食材，餐厅中常指烤箱烹调，可使表面上色；与放入汤汁中炖煮的做法不同。

sources.title: Iowa State University — Glossary of Cooking Terms

examples.en: The chicken is roasted with herbs and served with potatoes.
examples.zh: 这道鸡肉与香草一起烤制，配土豆供应。

definition.en: Sliced roast beef served as a Sunday lunch with gravy, Yorkshire pudding and vegetables.
definition.zh: 将整块牛肉烘烤、静置后切片，搭配肉汁、约克郡布丁和蔬菜组成的周日午餐。牛肉是这条菜名的明确主角；介绍时可说明肉的熟度与当天配菜。这里的 Yorkshire pudding 是咸味烤面糊配菜。

sources.title: Sainsbury’s Magazine / Tamsin Burnett-Hall — Triple-Mustard Roast Beef and Yorkshire Pudding

examples.en: The roast beef Sunday lunch comes with Yorkshire pudding, vegetables and gravy.
examples.zh: 这份周日烤牛肉套餐配约克郡布丁、蔬菜和肉汁。

definition.en: A leafy green with a distinct peppery bite, called arugula in American English. It adds freshness to salads and is also used over pizza or with pasta.
definition.zh: 带有明显胡椒般辛香的绿叶菜，英式英语称 rocket，美式英语通常称 arugula。常生食做沙拉，也可撒在披萨上或拌入意面；适合用 peppery 向客人解释其风味。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Salad leaf variety guide

examples.en: The rocket on top adds a fresh, peppery flavour to the pizza.
examples.zh: 披萨上面的芝麻菜增添了清新的胡椒般辛香。

definition.en: Tiny Grand Cru monopole in Vosne-Romanée.
definition.zh: Vosne-Romanée 顶级 Grand Cru，Domaine de la Romanée-Conti monopole；是 Monopole 概念的经典例子。

definition.en: A thick sauce commonly made with tomatoes, peppers, nuts, and olive oil.
definition.zh: 常以番茄、椒类、坚果和橄榄油制成的浓稠酱汁，风味醇厚；不同配方可能使用杏仁等坚果。

examples.en: The grilled vegetables are served with romesco on the side.
examples.zh: 这道烤蔬菜另配罗梅斯科酱。

definition.en: The rooted lower portion of a grafted vine onto which the scion is attached.
definition.zh: 嫁接葡萄藤的根系与下部部分；可影响抗根瘤蚜能力、土壤适应、耐旱性、石灰耐受、长势和成熟节奏等。

sources.title: Oregon State University — Grape phylloxera biology and management
Penn State Extension — Backyard grape growing

definition.en: Rosé Champagne made by blending red Champagne still wine with white base wine.
definition.zh: 以本产区酿制的静态红酒与白色基酒调配，形成桃红香槟的生产方法之一；与通过果皮浸渍取得颜色的 rosé de saignée 区分。

sources.title: Comité Champagne · De la cave à la table

definition.en: Rosé made by drawing juice from black grapes after skin maceration.
definition.zh: 以黑葡萄皮浸渍取得颜色后，放出部分葡萄汁酿成桃红酒；Champagne 也采用这一思路。与 rosé d’assemblage 的红白基酒调配法区分；maceration 是更宽泛的浸渍概念，并非所有浸渍法都严格等同于 saignée。

sources.title: Comité Champagne · De la cave à la table

definition.en: Still rosé appellation from Les Riceys area in the Côte des Bar.
definition.zh: 以 Pinot Noir 静态 rosé 著名，是 Champagne region 内少见独立 still-wine appellation。

sources.title: Syndicat des Producteurs de Rosé des Riceys

definition.en: A strongly aromatic herb with narrow, needle-like leaves. It is often cooked with roast meat or potatoes, and can also flavour bread or selected desserts.
definition.zh: 叶片细长、近似针形的香草，香气较鲜明，常与肉类、土豆一同烤制，也用于佛卡夏等面包。服务介绍可用 aromatic herb 说明它提供的是草本香气，而不是辣椒式辣味。

examples.en: These potatoes are roasted with rosemary and garlic, giving them a fragrant finish.
examples.zh: 这些土豆与迷迭香和蒜一起烤制，香气浓郁。

definition.en: Grated potatoes pan-fried into a flat cake with a crisp surface.
definition.zh: 将粗擦的土豆丝压成扁圆饼，用黄油或其他油脂煎出脆面。可用生土豆或预煮土豆，既能作配菜，也能加蛋、奶酪或肉类成为主菜。

sources.title: Switzerland Tourism — This Is Swiss Cuisine
Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs — Switzerland’s National Dishes

examples.en: The rösti is a crisp potato cake, served here alongside the veal.
examples.zh: 这份瑞士土豆丝饼表面酥脆，在这道菜里配小牛肉上桌。

definition.en: A sesquiterpene associated with black pepper aroma.
definition.zh: 与黑胡椒香气密切相关的化合物，在 Syrah 等部分品种中具有重要感官意义。

definition.en: To use all of a supply so that none remains.
definition.zh: 某种库存或供应已用完；餐厅里可表示售罄。过去式 ran out of，完成时 have run out of。

examples.en: We’ve run out of that dish.
examples.zh: 那道菜已经售罄了。

definition.en: An Austrian chocolate cake with apricot jam and a chocolate glaze.
definition.zh: 奥地利经典巧克力蛋糕，蛋糕体配杏子果酱，外覆巧克力糖衣，常与打发奶油同上。一般菜单上的 Sachertorte 是菜式名称，不代表一定来自维也纳萨赫酒店或使用其保密配方。

examples.en: The Sachertorte has apricot jam between chocolate cake layers and a chocolate glaze.
examples.zh: 萨赫蛋糕的巧克力蛋糕层之间有杏子果酱，外面覆巧克力糖衣。

definition.en: A spice made from the red stigmas of the saffron crocus. It gives food a golden colour and a distinctive hay-like aroma, often in rice and sauces.
definition.zh: 由番红花的红色柱头制成的香料，通常先浸泡以释放颜色与香气。能为米饭、酱汁和甜点带来金黄色泽及近似干草的细致香气；它与姜黄是不同的食材。

examples.en: The risotto gets its golden colour and delicate aroma from saffron.
examples.zh: 这款烩饭的金黄色泽和细致香气来自藏红花。

definition.en: A culinary herb with grey-green leaves and a pronounced herbal flavour. It is used with roast poultry, stuffings, pumpkin and butter sauces for pasta or gnocchi.
definition.zh: 常用于西餐的灰绿色叶片香草，草本风味鲜明，可为烤禽肉、填馅和南瓜菜肴调味。也常与黄油配成意面或意式团子的酱汁；此处 sage 指食材，不是“智者”。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Gnocchi with brown butter and sage pesto

examples.en: The ravioli are finished with sage butter, which gives the sauce a fragrant herbal flavour.
examples.zh: 这款意式饺子最后拌入鼠尾草黄油，酱汁带有芬芳的草本风味。

definition.en: Right Bank appellation centered on the historic town of Saint-Émilion.
definition.zh: 与 Merlot/Cabernet Franc、limestone/clay terroirs 及独立 classification system 紧密相关。

definition.en: Revisable classification for Saint-Émilion Grand Cru estates.
definition.zh: 2022 版本包含 14 Premiers Grands Crus Classés，其中 2 家 Distinction A，以及 71 Grands Crus Classés。

definition.en: A separate appellation with stricter production requirements than Saint-Émilion.
definition.zh: 这是 appellation，不等于 Grand Cru Classé；必须与 classification status 分开理解。

definition.en: Northern major communal appellation of the Haut-Médoc.
definition.zh: Médoc 四大经典 commune 之一；学习其位置、结构感、土壤差异及代表 estates。

definition.en: Compact Left Bank communal appellation between Pauillac and Margaux.
definition.zh: Médoc 经典 commune 之一，聚集多家 1855 classified growths。

definition.en: Cabernet Franc appellation adjacent to Bourgueil.
definition.zh: 以 Cabernet Franc 为核心，砂砾 terraces 是重要 terroir 学习节点。

sources.title: InterLoire · Climate and geology of Loire wines

definition.en: A leaf salad topped with warm goat’s cheese, often served on toasted bread with a vinaigrette.
definition.zh: 将温热的山羊奶酪与生菜组合，奶酪常放在烤面包上，配油醋类沙拉汁。核桃、蜂蜜、培根或水果都可能成为配料；chaud 指温热的奶酪部分，并非整盘蔬菜都煮热。

sources.title: Taste France — Warm Goat’s Cheese Salad

examples.en: The salad is topped with warm goat’s cheese on toast; this version also has walnuts.
examples.zh: 沙拉上放着铺有温热山羊奶酪的烤面包，这个版本也含核桃。

definition.en: A bistro salad of leaves, bacon pieces and egg, commonly finished with croutons and a sharp dressing.
definition.zh: 里昂小酒馆常见的沙拉，以叶菜、培根丁和鸡蛋构成，常配脆面包丁与带酸味的沙拉汁。常见版本用卷叶菊苣和水波蛋；其他版本也会用煮蛋，不能把所有沙拉配方视为相同。

examples.en: Our Lyonnaise salad comes with crisp bacon, a poached egg and a tangy dressing.
examples.zh: 我们的里昂沙拉配脆培根、水波蛋和带酸味的沙拉汁。

definition.en: A salad of tomatoes, raw vegetables, olives, eggs, and fish such as tuna or anchovies.
definition.zh: 尼斯风味沙拉以番茄、生蔬菜、橄榄、熟蛋及金枪鱼或鳀鱼等组成，通常淋橄榄油；餐厅配方常有差异。

sources.title: Nice Côte d’Azur Tourist Office — Salade Niçoise

examples.en: The Niçoise salad brings together tomatoes, olives, eggs, and savoury fish.
examples.zh: 这道尼斯沙拉将番茄、橄榄、鸡蛋和咸鲜鱼类组合在一起。

zh: 萨尔莫雷霍番茄面包冷汤

definition.en: A thick Andalusian cold soup made by blending tomatoes, bread, olive oil and garlic. Chopped hard-boiled egg and cured ham are common toppings.
definition.zh: 安达卢西亚的浓稠冷汤，以番茄、面包、橄榄油和蒜搅打而成。常用切碎的水煮蛋和风干火腿作配料；面包使汤体更浓滑。

examples.en: Salmorejo is a chilled tomato soup thickened with bread and olive oil.
examples.zh: 萨尔莫雷霍是一款用面包和橄榄油增加浓稠感的番茄冷汤。

zh: 罗马式火腿鼠尾草小牛肉

definition.en: Thin veal slices cooked with prosciutto and sage, commonly served with a wine-and-butter pan sauce.
definition.zh: 薄小牛肉片搭配意式生火腿和鼠尾草煎制，常用葡萄酒与黄油制作锅汁；其他肉类版本应另外说明。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — How to Make Saltimbocca

examples.en: The saltimbocca combines tender veal, savoury prosciutto, and fragrant sage.
examples.zh: 这道萨尔廷博卡结合了嫩小牛肉、咸鲜意式火腿和鼠尾草香气。

definition.en: An airy baked egg-white dessert formed into peaks and dusted with icing sugar.
definition.zh: 萨尔茨堡的蓬松蛋白甜点，将打发蛋白与蛋黄、少量面粉等轻拌后，堆成山峰状烘烤，表面撒糖粉。口感轻盈，出炉后应尽快上桌，放久会回落；名称里的 Nockerl 在这里不是咸味小面疙瘩。

examples.en: The Salzburger Nockerl is very light and is best enjoyed as soon as it arrives.
examples.zh: 萨尔茨堡蛋白舒芙蕾非常轻盈，建议上桌后尽快享用。

relatedTerms: Could you check the preparation time?

definition.en: Centre-Loire appellation producing Sauvignon Blanc whites and Pinot Noir reds/rosés.
definition.zh: 官方当前白酒为 Sauvignon Blanc，红/桃红为 Pinot Noir；三大 soil family 为 terres blanches、caillottes、clay-flint。

definition.en: Fried sardines marinated with softened onions and vinegar, sometimes with raisins and pine nuts.
definition.zh: 先将沙丁鱼炸熟，再与炒软的洋葱和醋汁层叠腌渍的威尼斯菜，风味酸甜。葡萄干、松子或葡萄酒属于不同版本的变化；这不是直接用酸汁腌生鱼的做法。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — sarde in saor

examples.en: The sardines are fried first, then marinated with onions and vinegar.
examples.zh: 沙丁鱼会先炸熟，再与洋葱和醋汁一起腌入味。

definition.en: A German pot roast, commonly beef, marinated with vinegar, vegetables and spices before browning and slow braising. The sauce is tangy; some regional versions add raisins or other sweet ingredients.
definition.zh: 德国酸腌焖肉，常以牛肉在醋、蔬菜和香料调成的腌液中腌制，再煎上色后慢焖。酱汁带酸香，部分地区会用葡萄干或糖浆增加甜味。

sources.title: Cologne City Portal — Sauerbraten recipe supplied by Gaffel Haus Köln

examples.en: The beef is marinated before slow cooking, giving the sauce a distinctive tang.
examples.zh: 牛肉在慢炖前先腌制，因此酱汁带有鲜明酸香。

definition.en: Salmon enclosed in pastry and baked, often with a filling of greens, herbs or a creamy cheese mixture.
definition.zh: 将三文鱼包入酥皮烘烤，外层金黄酥脆，内层可加入菠菜、西洋菜、香草或奶酪馅。En croûte 在这里表示包在面皮中烤制，说明的是做法；夹层配料可随餐厅版本变化。

sources.title: Mercotte — Saumon en croûte à la julienne de légumes

examples.en: The salmon is baked in puff pastry with spinach and cream cheese.
examples.zh: 三文鱼与菠菜、奶油奶酪一起包入酥皮烘烤。

definition.en: Loire appellation producing white, red, rosé and sparkling wines.
definition.zh: 多风格产区；Chenin Blanc、Cabernet Franc 和 sparkling 均重要。

definition.en: Cabernet Franc-focused red appellation in Saumur.
definition.zh: Loire 重要的 Cabernet Franc 红酒产区，位于 Saumur 一带；石灰岩与 tuffeau 地质是重要学习节点。

sources.title: InterLoire · Climate and geology of Loire wines

definition.en: To cook food quickly in a shallow pan with a small amount of fat.
definition.zh: 在浅锅中用少量油脂快速加热食材，常用于蘑菇或蔬菜；解释菜单时可强调锅炒而非深油炸。

sources.title: Iowa State University — Methods of Preparation

examples.en: The mushrooms are sautéed with garlic and butter.
examples.zh: 这些蘑菇用蒜和黄油煸炒。

definition.en: Sweet-wine appellation south of Bordeaux known for botrytized wines.
definition.zh: 以 Sémillon、Sauvignon Blanc、noble rot、selective harvesting 与 1855 sweet-wine classification 为核心。

definition.en: Principal aromatic white grape of dry white Bordeaux and part of sweet Bordeaux blends.
definition.zh: 为白波尔多带来高酸、柑橘与草本张力；与 Sémillon 组合可形成干白和甜白不同风格。

sources.title: CIVB — The Art of the Blend

definition.en: Chenin Blanc appellation in Anjou best known for dry white wines.
definition.zh: 以干型 Chenin Blanc 著名，片岩风土、结构与陈年潜力是核心；产区也允许带甜度的酒，不能定义为只产干白。

definition.en: Small Chenin Blanc appellation within the Savennières area.
definition.zh: Savennières 体系内重要独立 AOP，100% Chenin Blanc，结构与陈年潜力突出。

definition.en: Describing food on the non-sweet side of a menu, such as cheese tarts or meat pastries; US spelling: savory.
definition.zh: 用于区分咸味菜品与甜点，常形容奶酪挞、肉馅酥点等，未必表示盐放得多。美式拼写是 savory；它的范围比 umami 的鲜味宽，不宜简单互换。

examples.en: We have a savoury tart with spinach and cheese, as well as a sweet fruit tart.
examples.zh: 我们既有菠菜奶酪咸挞，也有甜的水果挞。

definition.en: A bivalve shellfish valued for its sweet, tender flesh. It is often seared or poached; some preparations also include the roe, known as coral.
definition.zh: 双壳贝类，肉质细嫩、带自然甜味，西餐常煎制、汆煮或烤制。部分做法也使用称为 coral 的贝黄；菜单上应区分整只带壳呈现还是只供应贝肉，干贝则是另一种加工形态。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook scallops

examples.en: The scallops are pan-seared and served with a smooth celeriac purée.
examples.zh: 这道扇贝采用香煎做法，配顺滑的根芹泥。

definition.en: Metamorphic rock important in Anjou and parts of western Loire.
definition.zh: 片岩是一类具片理的变质岩；在 Anjou 西部及 Savennières 等地是重要地质组成。岩性、土层和坡位共同影响葡萄园，不能仅由片岩推断酒的风味。

sources.title: InterLoire · Climate and geology of Loire wines

definition.en: German roast pork; a familiar Bavarian version uses pork shoulder or belly with the rind, roasted over vegetables and beer until tender, with a crisp crust and gravy.
definition.zh: 德式烤猪肉。常见巴伐利亚版本使用带皮猪肩肉或猪腹肉，与蔬菜和啤酒一起烘烤，肉质软嫩、猪皮酥脆，并以烤汁作酱。

sources.title: Bavaria Tourism — Roast pork with crust and beer gravy

examples.en: The pork is roasted until tender and served with crisp crackling and gravy.
examples.zh: 猪肉烤至软嫩，配酥脆猪皮和烤肉汁。

definition.en: German pork knuckle roasted to produce a crisp rind and tender meat.
definition.zh: 德式带骨猪肘，经过烹煮和烘烤等步骤，使肉质软嫩、外皮酥脆。巴伐利亚餐馆常见，常配肉汁和饺团或卷心菜类配菜；名称指猪肘这一部位，不应与普通烤猪肉混为一谈。

sources.title: Chef Alexander Herrmann / BR Bayern 1 — Schweinshaxe
Chef Florian Lerche / BR — Schweinshaxe mit Bayrisch Kraut und Brezn-Serviettenknödel

examples.en: The pork knuckle has tender meat under a crisp, roasted rind.
examples.zh: 这道烤猪肘的皮酥脆，里面的肉很柔嫩。

definition.en: The shoot or upper plant material grafted onto a rootstock.
definition.zh: 在嫁接葡萄藤中，位于砧木之上的栽培品种部分；通常决定果实品种身份及主要品种特征。

sources.title: Oregon State University — Grape phylloxera biology and management
Penn State Extension — Backyard grape growing

en: Scones with clotted cream and jam
zh: 司康配凝脂奶油与果酱
aliases: scone with clotted cream and jam
scones with jam and clotted cream

definition.en: Plain or fruit scones served with thick clotted cream and jam.
definition.zh: 将原味或含葡萄干的司康烤至松酥，剖开后配凝脂奶油和果酱食用，是英式茶点常见组合。司康由面粉、黄油、奶类和膨松剂制成，口感介于面包与酥点之间；这里的 clotted cream 指质地浓厚的凝脂奶油。

sources.title: William Drabble / Great British Chefs — Fruit Scones

examples.en: The warm scones come with clotted cream and strawberry jam.
examples.zh: 温热的司康配凝脂奶油和草莓果酱。

definition.en: A cooked egg enclosed in sausage meat, crumbed and fried.
definition.zh: 把煮好的鸡蛋包在调味肉馅中，裹上面包糠炸制；切开能看到蛋心、肉层和酥脆外壳。传统常用香肠肉，现代版本可能更换肉馅或蛋的熟度。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Scotch Egg Recipes

examples.en: The Scotch egg has a crisp crumb coating around the sausage meat and egg.
examples.zh: 苏格兰蛋的鸡蛋和香肠肉馅外包着一层酥脆面包糠。

definition.en: To brown a food’s surface quickly with intense heat, creating flavour and a crust.
definition.zh: 用较高温度让食材表面迅速上色，形成焦香与外壳；并不能把肉汁封住，也不代表内部已熟透。

examples.en: The tuna is seared on the outside and served rare in the centre.
examples.zh: 这道金枪鱼外层煎上色，中心仍保留较生的状态。

definition.en: A second château wine made from lots, parcels or younger vines not selected for the grand vin, depending on estate practice.
definition.zh: 波尔多 estate selection 与品牌架构的重要概念；不同酒庄 second wine 的来源与定位并不完全相同。

sources.title: Château Margaux — Pavillon Rouge, estate selection

definition.en: German-language sparkling-wine category with a wide quality range.
definition.zh: 广义 Sekt 可使用非德国 base wine；需进一步看 Deutscher Sekt、Sekt b.A.、Winzersekt 等来源与质量线索。

definition.en: German quality sparkling wine from a specified Anbaugebiet.
definition.zh: Sekt bestimmter Anbaugebiete 的缩写，指来自特定德国葡萄种植区的品质起泡酒；名称强调来源，并不单凭 b.A. 保证传统法。

definition.en: Whole-cluster fermentation in which crushed grapes at the bottom create CO₂ that drives intracellular fermentation in intact berries above.
definition.zh: 传统 Beaujolais 常见工艺；底部浆果受压后发酵产生 CO₂，上部整果发生 intracellular fermentation。

definition.en: Major Bordeaux white grape important in dry whites and especially botrytized sweet wines.
definition.zh: 可带来较圆润、蜡质与陈年复杂度，对 noble rot 敏感，是 Sauternes/Barsac 的核心品种之一。

sources.title: CIVB — The Art of the Blend

definition.en: A coarse wheat milling product, commonly made from durum wheat. It brings texture to pasta and bread and can also be cooked into a soft pudding or porridge.
definition.zh: 通常由杜兰小麦磨制的粗粒小麦粉，颜色偏淡黄，常用于意面、面包，也可加液体煮成柔软的布丁或粥。菜品介绍应结合实际做法，不能把 semolina 一律解释成某一种面食。

examples.en: These Roman-style gnocchi are made with semolina, so their texture differs from potato gnocchi.
examples.zh: 这些罗马式团子用杜兰小麦粗粒粉制作，口感与土豆团子不同。

definition.en: Individually, rather than as one group.
definition.zh: 各自或分开进行。pay separately 表示分开结账。

examples.en: We’d like to pay separately.
examples.zh: 我们想分开结账。

definition.en: An additional charge on a bill for service, subject to the venue’s stated policy.
definition.zh: 账单中另列的服务相关费用，是否收取、金额及与小费的关系取决于当地规定和餐厅政策，应清楚说明。

examples.en: The service charge is shown separately on your bill.
examples.zh: 服务费在您的账单上单独列示。

definition.en: Shell-shaped Neapolitan pastries with crisp layers and a sweet ricotta-and-semolina filling.
definition.zh: 那不勒斯的贝壳形甜酥点，ricce 指层层展开的脆皮版本，通常包入瑞可塔、粗粒小麦粉和糖渍果皮馅。需要与使用甜酥派皮的 sfogliatelle frolle 区分；制皮脂肪也可能用猪油，不能单凭甜点外观判断。

sources.title: GialloZafferano — Easy Sfogliatelle; ricce and frolle distinction

examples.en: The sfogliatelle ricce have crisp layers around a ricotta and semolina filling.
examples.zh: 这款千层贝壳酥的脆皮包着瑞可塔奶酪和粗粒小麦粉馅。

definition.en: A small onion-type bulb used for delicate onion flavour in sauces, dressings, and cooking.
definition.zh: 一种小型葱属鳞茎，常切碎用于酱汁或油醋汁，中文可称红葱头或小洋葱；不要与青葱混淆。

examples.en: The vinaigrette contains finely chopped shallots.
examples.zh: 这款油醋汁里有切碎的红葱头。

definition.en: A baked dish of lamb cooked with vegetables and gravy, covered with mashed potato and browned in the oven. The topping replaces the pastry crust of many other pies.
definition.zh: 把羊肉与蔬菜、肉汁煮成内馅，覆上土豆泥后入烤箱烤至表面上色的菜肴。常用羊肉末，也有熟羊肉版本；这里的派以土豆泥作顶层。

examples.en: The lamb filling is topped with mashed potato and baked until golden.
examples.zh: 羊肉馅上覆盖土豆泥，再烤至表面金黄。

definition.en: A pastry made by combining flour and fat into a tender, relatively sturdy dough. Its crumbly texture makes it suitable for pie, tart and quiche cases.
definition.zh: 由面粉与油脂混合成面团的派皮，烤后酥松，结构较适合承托馅料，常用于咸派、果馅派和挞底。它可制成咸味或甜味版本，与明显膨起分层的起酥面皮应分开说明。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to choose pastry

examples.en: The quiche has a shortcrust pastry base with a tender, crumbly texture.
examples.zh: 这款咸派以酥松派皮作底，口感细嫩酥散。

definition.en: Cooked shrimp served with creamy grits, often accompanied by a savoury pan sauce.
definition.zh: 把煮成软滑浓稠状的玉米糁 grits 作为底或配菜，搭配煎炒鲜虾和鲜味酱汁。部分版本在玉米糁中加奶酪，或在虾汁中加培根、烟熏香肠。它能同时呈现虾肉的弹嫩与玉米糁的绵滑。

sources.title: John Besh / James Beard Foundation — Duck Camp Shrimp and Grits
Jim Shirley / James Beard Foundation — Spiced Shrimp with Smoked Gouda Grits

examples.en: The shrimp are served over creamy grits with a savoury sauce.
examples.zh: 鲜虾铺在软滑的玉米糁粥上，配鲜味酱汁。

definition.en: French word for flint; also used for flint-bearing vineyard soils.
definition.zh: Silex 本义是燧石。在 Sancerre、Pouilly-Fumé 的风土描述中，常指含燧石的土壤，尤其 clay-flint；不能把 gunflint 香气视为这种土壤必然产生的结果。

definition.en: Smooth and soft on the palate, with a silk-like impression; commonly used for sauces, custards and purées.
definition.zh: 像丝绸般顺滑柔细的口感，常形容酱汁、蛋奶甜品或蔬菜泥。与 velvety 都强调顺滑，不能只凭这个词判断脂肪含量、奶制品用量或菜品浓度。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — chestnut gnocchi with mushroom velouté

examples.en: The mushroom sauce is silky and coats the gnocchi lightly.
examples.zh: 菌菇酱丝滑细腻，薄薄地裹在意式团子上。

definition.en: To cook in liquid held just below a full boil, with gentle movement rather than vigorous bubbling.
definition.zh: 把液体维持在接近沸腾的温和状态，让食物慢慢煮制，常用于汤、酱汁和炖菜。与剧烈翻滚的 boil 不同；simmer 说明加热状态，不等于某一种固定炖菜。

examples.en: The tomato sauce simmers gently with garlic and basil.
examples.zh: 这款番茄酱会与蒜和罗勒一起保持微沸慢煮。

definition.en: At a low speed, or with more time allowed.
definition.zh: 表示动作速度慢；请别人放慢语速时说 more slowly。

examples.en: Could you speak more slowly?
examples.zh: 可以说得慢一点吗？

definition.en: To expose food to smoke for flavour and, in some preparations, preservation; smoked describes food treated this way.
definition.zh: 让食物接触烟气以增加风味，某些做法也用于保藏。菜单上的 smoked 通常说明进行了烟熏处理，而 smoky 只描述味道或香气；具体生熟状态需看实际工艺。

examples.en: We smoke the cheese over wood chips for a gentle smoky flavour.
examples.zh: 我们用木屑烟熏这款奶酪，让它带上柔和的烟熏风味。

definition.en: Having an aroma or flavour reminiscent of smoke; describes the sensory result rather than proving a particular smoking process.
definition.zh: 闻起来或尝起来有类似烟熏的气息。smoky 描述感官风味，smoked 则通常表示经过烟熏处理；一道菜也可能因为加入烟熏调料而呈现 smoky 风味。

examples.en: The paprika gives the sauce a smoky flavour.
examples.zh: 红椒粉给这款酱汁带来了烟熏风味。

definition.en: Open-faced sandwiches, usually on rye bread, with carefully arranged savoury toppings.
definition.zh: 通常以抹黄油的黑麦面包为底，上铺鱼、肉、鸡蛋或蔬菜等配料，单片开放式呈现。它是一类丹麦菜式，不是一套固定馅料；服务员须进一步介绍所点版本的实际配料。

sources.title: Trine Hahnemann — Smørrebrød: The Danish Lunch

examples.en: This smørrebrød is an open-faced rye sandwich topped with roast beef.
examples.zh: 这份丹麦开放式三明治以黑麦面包为底，上铺烤牛肉。

definition.en: Sole lightly dusted with flour and pan-fried, finished with butter, lemon, and parsley.
definition.zh: 鳎鱼薄裹面粉后以黄油煎制，配柠檬与欧芹调味的黄油汁，可整鱼或鱼柳供应；鱼种和配料须核对。

examples.en: The sole is lightly floured and pan-fried, with a lemon-and-parsley butter sauce.
examples.zh: 这道鳎鱼薄裹面粉香煎，配柠檬欧芹黄油汁。

definition.en: Sole fillets with white grapes and a wine-based sauce, often enriched with cream.
definition.zh: 鳎鱼柳配含白葡萄的葡萄酒或味美思酱汁，常加入奶油，带有葡萄的清甜。具体鱼种、乳制品及香草配料会变化；Véronique 不能被解释成所有奶油鱼料理。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Lemon Sole Veronique
California Table Grape Commission — Sole Véronique

examples.en: The sole is served with white grapes in a creamy vermouth sauce.
examples.zh: 这道鳎鱼配白葡萄，淋上奶油味美思酱汁。

definition.en: A light savoury dish made by folding whipped egg whites into a cheese base and cooking it.
definition.zh: 将打发蛋白拌入奶酪基底，加热形成蓬松结构的咸味舒芙蕾；可现烤或采用二次加热方式，按本店做法说明。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Cheese Soufflés by Shaun Rankin

examples.en: The cheese soufflé is light and airy, with a warm, savoury cheese flavour.
examples.zh: 这道奶酪舒芙蕾轻盈蓬松，带有温热的咸香奶酪风味。

definition.en: A soup of slowly browned onions and stock, commonly served with cheese-topped toasted bread.
definition.zh: 洋葱慢慢炒至褐色后加入高汤煮成浓味汤，常配烤奶酪面包；高汤可含肉，不能仅凭洋葱名称判断。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — French Onion Soup by Louise Robinson

examples.en: The French onion soup has slowly browned onions and a toast topped with melted cheese.
examples.zh: 这道法式洋葱汤使用慢炒上色的洋葱，配一片融化奶酪烤面包。

definition.en: Cooking food, usually sealed in a bag, in a water bath at a precisely controlled temperature.
definition.zh: 通常将食材装袋，放入精确控温的水浴中烹调，重点是温度与时间控制；并非仅指任何低温慢煮。

sources.title: Anova Culinary — What Is Sous Vide Cooking?

examples.en: The chicken is cooked sous vide, then browned in a pan.
examples.zh: 这道鸡肉先用精控水浴烹调，再下锅煎上色。

definition.en: Chicken pieces coated in seasoned flour and fried until the outside is crisp.
definition.zh: 把鸡肉块调味后裹上带香料的面粉，再用油炸或半煎炸的方式做出酥脆外层。经典版本常使用带骨鸡块，外皮焦香、内部多汁；不同厨房会用盐水或酪乳预处理，风味和裹粉厚度各有做法。

sources.title: James Beard Foundation — Juanita Dean’s Southern Fried Chicken
The Splendid Table — Southern Fried Chicken

examples.en: The Southern fried chicken has a crisp, seasoned flour coating.
examples.zh: 这份南方炸鸡裹着调味面粉，外层酥脆。

definition.en: Small pieces of meat, commonly pork or chicken, threaded onto skewers and grilled with seasonings such as oregano. They may be served with pita bread or inside a pita wrap.
definition.zh: 将猪肉或鸡肉等切成小块、穿串，加入牛至等调味料后烤熟的希腊菜。可配皮塔饼上桌，也可做成夹有蔬菜和酱料的皮塔卷。

sources.title: Official Athens Guide — Souvlaki and its forms

examples.en: These grilled meat skewers are seasoned with oregano and served with pita bread.
examples.zh: 这些烤肉串用牛至调味，搭配皮塔饼供应。

definition.en: Spaghetti dressed in a dark cuttlefish-ink sauce, often with pieces of cuttlefish, garlic, parsley and white wine.
definition.zh: 以墨鱼汁制作深黑色酱汁的长意面，常加入墨鱼肉、蒜、欧芹和白葡萄酒，突出海鲜的咸鲜味。菜单中的这个名称通常描述整道墨鱼汁意面；它也可能被用来指面团本身染黑的干面，需要结合菜品说明理解。

sources.title: Chef Stefano Barbato — Spaghetti al nero di seppia

examples.en: The dark sauce gets its colour from cuttlefish ink, and we add pieces of cuttlefish.
examples.zh: 酱汁的黑色来自墨鱼汁，我们还加入了墨鱼肉。

definition.en: Spaghetti tossed in a tomato sauce with olives, capers and garlic; many versions also include anchovies and chilli.
definition.zh: 长意面拌番茄、橄榄、酸豆和蒜制成的酱汁，风味咸鲜；不少版本加入凤尾鱼和辣椒。介绍菜品时应说明本店是否使用凤尾鱼，而不能仅凭番茄酱外观判断。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — spaghetti alla puttanesca

examples.en: Our puttanesca has a tomato sauce with olives, capers and anchovies.
examples.zh: 我们的这款意面配番茄酱，里面有橄榄、酸豆和凤尾鱼。

definition.en: Spaghetti tossed with clams and their juices, commonly flavoured with garlic, parsley, and white wine.
definition.zh: 细长意面与蛤蜊及其烹调原汁拌合，常用蒜、欧芹和白葡萄酒提味；也有加番茄的版本，需说明当日做法。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — Spaghetti alle Vongole

examples.en: The spaghetti alle vongole is tossed with clams, garlic, and their savoury cooking juices.
examples.zh: 这道蛤蜊细面拌入了蛤蜊、蒜和鲜味烹调原汁。

definition.en: A Greek savoury pie with spinach, onions, herbs and commonly feta, enclosed in layers of thin phyllo pastry and baked until crisp.
definition.zh: 希腊咸派，将菠菜、洋葱、香草及常见的菲达奶酪制成内馅，包入或夹在多层薄酥皮中烤至酥脆。可做成整盘派，也有小份形状。

sources.title: Diane Kochilas — Key ingredients in spanakopita

examples.en: The crisp phyllo pastry holds a filling of spinach, herbs and feta cheese.
examples.zh: 酥脆的薄酥皮包裹着菠菜、香草和菲达奶酪馅。

definition.en: Wine containing significant dissolved carbon dioxide.
definition.zh: 含有显著溶解 CO₂ 并呈现气泡的葡萄酒；气泡来源和生产方式因类别与法规而不同。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: A steamed suet pudding dotted with dried currants, commonly served with custard.
definition.zh: 把面粉、糖、碎板油类脂肪和小粒葡萄干混合，装入布丁碗隔水蒸熟的英式甜点。切面上散布的深色果干就是名称里的 spotted，口感厚实而湿润，常配温热蛋奶酱；现代配方也会用植物性 suet。

sources.title: Prue Leith / The Great British Bake Off — Spotted Dick and Custard

examples.en: Spotted dick is a steamed fruit pudding, served with warm custard.
examples.zh: 这道葡萄干蒸布丁配温热蛋奶酱上桌。

definition.en: Italian term for fully sparkling wine at higher pressure.
definition.zh: 与 frizzante 对应的 higher-pressure sparkling term。

sources.title: Consorzio Prosecco DOC · Types of Prosecco

definition.en: Pruning that retains short spurs with a small number of buds.
definition.zh: 在永久性或半永久性枝臂上保留短结果枝，常见于 cordon-trained vines。

sources.title: Penn State Extension — Dormant cane and spur pruning

definition.en: Société de Récoltants producer category.
definition.zh: Champagne 标签注册代码，Société de Récoltants：多个葡萄种植者组成公司，共同酿造并销售由其收成制成的香槟。

sources.title: Union des Maisons de Champagne · Etiquetage

definition.en: An inert vessel material used for wine fermentation and maturation; it does not itself contribute the wood-derived flavours associated with oak.
definition.zh: 用于发酵与熟成的惰性容器材料，本身不提供橡木所带来的木质风味。

sources.title: WSET · Level 3 Award in Wines specification

definition.en: A savoury pie with tender beef in an ale-based gravy beneath pastry.
definition.zh: 牛肉块与洋葱、艾尔啤酒和高汤慢炖成浓汁馅料，再盖上或包入面皮烤熟。Ale 在这里是参与烹调的啤酒，带来麦芽风味；steak 指牛肉馅料，不表示上桌的是一整块煎牛排。

examples.en: The steak and ale pie has slow-cooked beef and a golden pastry lid.
examples.zh: 这道艾尔啤酒牛肉派用慢炖牛肉作馅，上面是金黄的酥皮。

definition.en: A savoury pastry pie filled with beef, kidney and gravy.
definition.zh: 将牛肉块与腰子炖软，连同浓肉汁包入或盖上面皮后烘烤。腰子是动物肾脏；不同配方会加蘑菇或啤酒，也有加入烟熏牡蛎的版本，因此介绍时不能只凭菜名断定全部配料。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Steak and Kidney Pie with Smoked Oysters

examples.en: The steak and kidney pie has a rich gravy beneath the pastry.
examples.zh: 这道牛肉腰子派的面皮下面是浓郁的肉汁馅料。

definition.en: A seared steak seasoned generously with peppercorns and served with a peppery pan sauce.
definition.zh: 牛排以胡椒粒调味，煎制后配胡椒锅汁；酱汁常用高汤、白兰地和少量奶油。Au poivre 强调胡椒，而非辣椒；牛肉部位、胡椒种类及是否加奶油，应按餐厅版本介绍。

sources.title: Bryan Webb / Great British Chefs — Steak au poivre

examples.en: The steak has a peppercorn crust and a rich pan sauce; how would you like it cooked?
examples.zh: 这款牛排表面带胡椒粒，配浓郁锅汁；您希望几分熟？

definition.en: Finely chopped raw beef mixed with savoury seasonings, often accompanied by an egg yolk.
definition.zh: 细切生牛肉拌入红葱头、酸豆、酸黄瓜或芥末等调味，常配蛋黄；必须明确生食状态，并核对具体配料。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Steak Tartare by Tom Aikens

examples.en: The steak tartare is finely chopped raw beef with savoury seasonings; it is served uncooked.
examples.zh: 这道塔塔是细切生牛肉拌咸鲜调味料，以未经烹熟的状态供应。

definition.en: Cooked by the heat of steam.
definition.zh: 借助蒸汽加热烹调。steamed rice 是蒸米饭，可与 fried rice（炒饭）对照。

examples.en: Would you like steamed rice?
examples.zh: 您要蒸米饭吗？

definition.en: A moist sponge pudding, commonly made with dates, served with warm toffee sauce.
definition.zh: 质地湿润的英式海绵蛋糕类甜点，常把切碎椰枣加入面糊，配温热的黄油、糖和奶油制成的太妃糖酱。这里的 pudding 指甜点，不是通常中式理解的凝乳状布丁。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Galton Blackiston’s Sticky Toffee Pudding

examples.en: The sticky toffee pudding is a warm date sponge with a rich toffee sauce.
examples.zh: 太妃糖布丁是温热的椰枣海绵蛋糕，配浓郁太妃糖酱。

definition.en: A Greek slow-cooked stew distinguished by plenty of small onions, with beef or rabbit among common versions.
definition.zh: 以大量小洋葱与肉慢炖的希腊炖菜，常见牛肉或兔肉，也有其他主料版本。介绍时要说明本店所用肉类，不能只把 stifado 统一译成牛肉。

sources.title: Visit Greece — Local flavours of Greek cuisine
Chef Akis Petretzikis — Greek rabbit stew, Stifado

examples.en: Our stifado uses beef, slowly cooked with small onions until tender.
examples.zh: 我们的 stifado 用牛肉与小洋葱一起慢炖至柔软。

definition.en: Wine without significant retained carbon dioxide pressure.
definition.zh: 相对于起泡酒而言，没有显著气泡压力的葡萄酒类别；颜色、甜度与是否加强是不同分类维度。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: In cooking, a flavourful liquid made by simmering ingredients such as bones, meat, fish or vegetables. It provides a base for soups, sauces, braises and risotto.
definition.zh: 在烹饪语境中，指用骨、肉、鱼或蔬菜等原料熬煮取得的风味液体，是汤、酱汁、焖菜与烩饭的基础。应说明 chicken stock、fish stock 或 vegetable stock 等实际来源。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to make chicken stock
Great British Chefs — How to make vegetable stock
Iowa State University — Glossary of cooking terms

examples.en: This risotto is cooked with vegetable stock, which adds flavour as the rice absorbs it.
examples.zh: 这款烩饭用蔬菜高汤煮制，米粒吸收汤汁时也吸收了风味。

definition.en: Cooked potatoes roughly mashed with other vegetables, such as carrots, leeks or Brussels sprouts. This Belgian dish is often served with sausage, bacon or an egg.
definition.zh: 将煮熟的土豆与胡萝卜、韭葱或抱子甘蓝等蔬菜一起粗压成泥的比利时菜，保留一些颗粒感。常搭配香肠、培根或鸡蛋，蔬菜组合可以变化。

examples.en: Stoemp is a rustic potato mash mixed with vegetables and served as a hearty accompaniment.
examples.zh: 斯通普是混合蔬菜、保留颗粒感的土豆泥，是一道丰实的配菜。

definition.en: Pleasantly moist and juicy to eat; an approving menu word often used for meat, fish and seafood.
definition.zh: 用于称赞食物汁液充足、吃起来鲜美，常见于肉类、鱼类和海鲜介绍。比 juicy 带有更明显的赞赏语气，但不是一种独立烹调方法，也不是熟度等级。

examples.en: The prawns are succulent and served with garlic butter.
examples.zh: 这份虾鲜美多汁，配蒜香黄油。

definition.en: To offer an idea, or to indicate that an explanation may be possible.
definition.zh: 可表示提出建议，也可表示某些线索提示一种可能性。盲品中 suggest 并不等于证明；建议动作可用 suggest doing。

examples.en: These features suggest a cool climate.
examples.zh: 这些特征提示它可能来自冷凉气候。

definition.en: A chilled mould of bread filled with juicy summer berries.
definition.zh: 用面包片铺满模具，填入加糖略煮出汁的夏季莓果，再加压冷藏成形。面包吸满红紫色果汁，倒扣后外形完整，内部仍有软嫩果肉。这是一道果香浓、口感湿润的冷甜点。

sources.title: Chris Mosler / Great British Chefs — Summer Pudding

examples.en: The summer pudding is made with berries and bread soaked in their juice.
examples.zh: 夏日莓果布丁用莓果和吸满果汁的面包制成。

definition.en: Roman rice croquettes, commonly tomato-flavoured, with a mozzarella centre inside a crisp breadcrumb coating.
definition.zh: 罗马常见的裹屑炸米饭小食，经典形式常用番茄风味米饭包马苏里拉，掰开可拉丝；也有含肉等版本。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — Supplì al Telefono

examples.en: The supplì are crisp rice croquettes with melted mozzarella in the middle.
examples.zh: 这道罗马炸米饭可乐饼外层酥脆，中间包有融化的马苏里拉乳酪。

definition.en: A Catalan fish or seafood stew, with the catch and sauce varying by recipe.
definition.zh: 加泰罗尼亚海鲜炖菜，常以鱼鲜高汤和番茄等煮成酱汁，再加入鱼或贝类。部分版本用含杏仁、面包及蒜的 picada 增稠，也可能含火腿；具体鱼种与配料需按本店配方介绍。

sources.title: Great British Chefs Kitchen — Suquet de peix
Spain.info — Rural tourism and coastal fish stews

examples.en: Our suquet combines squid, clams and prawns in a tomato-based sauce thickened with almond picada.
examples.zh: 我们的 suquet 将鱿鱼、蛤蜊和虾放入番茄酱汁，并以杏仁 picada 增稠。

definition.en: Ageing wine on its lees before bottling.
definition.zh: 在 Muscadet 语境中与法规规定的 fine-lees ageing 和装瓶窗口相关，增加质地、复杂度并可保留轻微 CO₂。

sources.title: Fédération des Vins de Nantes · Muscadet sur lie
INAO · Muscadet Sèvre et Maine sur lie

definition.en: Reserved unfermented grape must used to adjust sweetness.
definition.zh: 通常是预留的未发酵葡萄汁，在成酒阶段用于调整甜度与平衡；历史上与德国葡萄酒相关。

sources.title: WSET — Level 2 Award in Wines Session Plans, 2023

definition.en: Small seasoned meatballs, often accompanied by cream sauce, mashed potatoes and lingonberries.
definition.zh: 把调味肉馅搓成小丸煎熟，常见配方混合牛肉和猪肉，再配奶油肉汁、土豆泥及越橘酱。也有其他肉类与植物版本，不能只凭菜名推定固定肉种。

examples.en: Our Swedish meatballs come with cream sauce, mashed potatoes and lingonberry jam.
examples.zh: 我们的瑞典肉丸配奶油酱、土豆泥和越橘酱。

definition.en: Wine with perceptible or legally defined elevated sweetness.
definition.zh: 甜度可来自保留葡萄原生糖、发酵中止、贵腐/风干浓缩、冰冻浓缩或法规允许的后期调甜等不同路径。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: A Viennese dish of beef gently simmered with root vegetables and aromatics, then sliced and served with broth and accompaniments such as apple-horseradish or chive sauce.
definition.zh: 维也纳清炖牛肉，以适合炖煮的牛肉配根茎蔬菜和香料轻柔慢煮，熟后切片并带少许汤汁供应，常搭配苹果辣根酱或细香葱酱。

examples.en: The beef is gently simmered with vegetables and served in slices with a little broth.
examples.zh: 牛肉与蔬菜轻柔慢煮后切片，带少许汤汁供应。

definition.en: A cooked beef steak sliced before serving, often presented with rocket and shavings of Parmigiano Reggiano.
definition.zh: 将煎制或烤制好的牛排切片上桌，常搭配芝麻菜、帕尔马奶酪薄片和橄榄油。Tagliata 强调切片呈现，并不指定唯一的牛肉部位；服务时可进一步说明本店部位和建议熟度。

examples.en: We serve the tagliata sliced, with rocket and Parmesan shavings.
examples.zh: 我们的牛排切片后上桌，搭配芝麻菜和帕尔马奶酪薄片。

definition.en: The second pressing fraction in Champagne.
definition.zh: 香槟压榨第二段汁，成分和结构与 cuvée 不同，producer 可据目标酒款决定用途。

definition.en: To look after someone or deal with a task or problem.
definition.zh: 照顾客人或负责处理问题。服务承诺应说明具体行动，并在完成后向客人反馈。

examples.en: I’ll take care of that for you.
examples.zh: 我来为您处理。

definition.en: Showing a lively, pleasantly sharp taste, often with noticeable acidity; useful for dressings, yogurt and citrus desserts.
definition.zh: 味道鲜明而带令人愉快的酸锐感，常用于沙拉汁、酸奶或柑橘甜品。与笼统的 sour 相比，它常带赞赏意味；不表示辣椒的灼热感，也不必然意味着酸度很高。

examples.en: The tangy yogurt dressing balances the sweetness of the roasted carrots.
examples.zh: 酸爽的酸奶酱平衡了烤胡萝卜的甜味。

definition.en: Sparkling-wine method in which the second fermentation occurs in a pressurised tank.
definition.zh: 通常指基酒在密闭压力罐内进行二次发酵，使 CO₂ 留在酒中，Prosecco 是典型例子。Asti 常用的是从葡萄汁开始的单次受控发酵，虽然也使用压力罐，不能据此称为二次发酵。

sources.title: WSET · A guide to sparkling wine production methods and regional styles

definition.en: A group of phenolic compounds that can create a drying, astringent feel in the mouth.
definition.zh: 葡萄皮、籽、梗及木材等来源的酚类物质，可产生收敛、干涩的触感，并影响结构。常用复数 tannins；与甜度意义上的 dry 不同。

examples.en: The tannin feels firm.
examples.zh: 这款酒的单宁触感紧实。

definition.en: A smooth dip made by blending fish roe with oil, lemon and bread or another starchy base.
definition.zh: 以鱼籽、油和柠檬等打成柔滑蘸酱，常用浸软面包作底，也有土豆版本。Tarama 是鱼籽原料，taramosalata 是完成的蘸酱；不是蔬菜沙拉。

sources.title: Chef Akis Petretzikis — Greek Fish Roe Dip, Taramosalata
Discover Greece — Top Greek dishes in Athens

examples.en: The taramosalata is a smooth fish-roe dip with a fresh lemon flavour.
examples.zh: 这份鱼籽蘸酱质地柔滑，带有清新的柠檬风味。

definition.en: An aromatic herb with narrow leaves and an anise-like note. Common in French cooking, it flavours béarnaise and is used with chicken, eggs and fish.
definition.zh: 叶片细长、带类似茴香气息的香草，在法式料理中很常见。可为鸡肉、鱼和蛋类增香，也是伯那西酱的重要风味来源；介绍酱汁时，可说明其清晰的草本香气。

examples.en: The tarragon in this sauce gives it a gentle anise note that complements the chicken.
examples.zh: 酱汁中的龙蒿带有淡淡的茴香气息，与鸡肉相衬。

definition.en: A Galician almond cake made mainly with ground almonds, sugar and eggs, baked and usually dusted with icing sugar around a St James cross design. Versions with a pastry base also exist.
definition.zh: 加利西亚杏仁蛋糕，主要由磨碎杏仁、糖和鸡蛋混合烘烤而成，表面通常撒糖粉并留出圣雅各十字图案。既有无底版本，也有带饼皮底的版本。

sources.title: Tarta de Santiago Regulatory Council — Characteristics and preparation
Spain Tourism — Tarta de Santiago recipe

examples.en: This is a baked almond cake with a soft, slightly grainy texture and a sugar-dusted top.
examples.zh: 这是一款烘烤杏仁蛋糕，口感柔软、略带细颗粒感，表面撒有糖粉。

definition.en: A pastry tart filled with a smooth, tangy lemon mixture, commonly set with eggs.
definition.zh: 酥脆塔皮中填入带酸甜平衡的细滑柠檬馅，常以鸡蛋帮助凝固。奶油、黄油和塔皮坚果成分会随做法变化；菜名不必然表示表面有蛋白霜，需要与 lemon meringue tart 区分。

examples.en: The lemon tart has a crisp pastry base and a smooth, tangy filling.
examples.zh: 柠檬塔以酥脆塔皮为底，内馅细滑，带清晰酸味。

definition.en: An upside-down tart with caramelised apples baked beneath pastry, then inverted for serving.
definition.zh: 苹果先与糖和黄油形成焦糖风味，上覆派皮烘烤后翻转上桌，果面朝上；也有其他水果版本，须说明主料。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Tarte Tatin by Marcus Wareing
Great British Chefs — Tarte Tatin Recipes

examples.en: The tarte Tatin has caramelised apples over pastry, revealed when the tart is turned out.
examples.zh: 塔坦挞翻转脱模后，焦糖苹果呈现在派皮上方。

definition.en: Potatoes baked with onions, bacon, and Reblochon cheese until the cheese melts and browns.
definition.zh: 土豆搭配洋葱、烟肉丁及勒布洛雄奶酪入炉焗烤，奶酪融化覆盖表面；是否加入奶油或葡萄酒依配方而异。

examples.en: The tartiflette combines potatoes, onion, and bacon beneath melted Reblochon cheese.
examples.zh: 这道塔尔蒂弗莱特把土豆、洋葱和烟肉放在融化的勒布洛雄奶酪之下。

definition.en: Cool-climate Australian sparkling wines strongly associated with Tasmania.
definition.zh: 澳大利亚高质量 traditional-method sparkling 重要节点，常用 Chardonnay / Pinot Noir。

definition.en: A set sequence of smaller courses designed to present a chef’s range of dishes.
definition.zh: 由多道较小份菜肴组成、按安排顺序供应的套餐，用于展示厨房风格；课程数、替换和配酒须另行确认。

examples.en: Our tasting menu has six courses; wine pairing is available separately.
examples.zh: 我们的品鉴套餐有六道菜，配酒可以另外选择。

definition.en: A norisoprenoid associated with kerosene/petrol aromas.
definition.zh: 常与陈年 Riesling 的煤油/汽油类香气相关，其形成与葡萄前体、成熟和陈年过程有关。

definition.en: Offering little resistance when cut or chewed; describes food texture rather than a particular level of meat doneness.
definition.zh: 形容食物容易切开、咬断，口感软嫩而不韧硬，可用于肉类和蔬菜。tender 说的是质地，不等于牛排的 rare 或 medium，也不保证肉汁多少。

examples.en: The lamb shoulder is slow-cooked until tender and served with rosemary jus.
examples.zh: 羊肩肉经过慢煮，口感软嫩，配迷迭香肉汁。

definition.en: Clay-limestone soils associated with Kimmeridgian marl in Centre-Loire.
definition.zh: Sancerre/Pouilly-Fumé 重要土壤术语，粘土-石灰岩与 Kimmeridgian marl 关联。

definition.en: A rustic meat terrine baked in a mould, chilled and served in slices, commonly based on pork.
definition.zh: 把调味肉馅装入长形模具烘烤，冷却定形后切片供应的乡村风格熟肉冷盘，常以猪肉为主。这里的“冻”指冷却定形的肉制品，不是甜味果冻；与包有面皮的 pâté en croûte 要区分。

sources.title: Grégory Marchand — Terrine de Campagne, published by Taste of France

examples.en: The country terrine is a chilled pork preparation served in slices with bread.
examples.zh: 这款乡村肉酱冻以猪肉制成，冷却后切片，搭配面包供应。

definition.en: The interaction of site, climate, soil, vine, and human practice as expressed in wine.
definition.zh: 在 SOMM100 中不把 terroir 简化成“土壤”，而视为气候、地形、土壤、水分、植物材料与人为管理共同作用的系统。

sources.title: OIV — Resolution VITI 333/2010, definition of terroir

definition.en: An expression of appreciation when a guest has had to wait.
definition.zh: 客人等候或配合处理问题后表示感谢。patience 指耐心，不是 patients（病人）；必要时再接具体进度，让感谢有实际回应。

sources.title: British Council · A response to a complaint

examples.en: Thank you for your patience. The kitchen has confirmed that your main courses are being plated.
examples.zh: 谢谢您的耐心等待。厨房刚确认，您的主菜正在装盘。

definition.en: An aromatic culinary herb used fresh or dried. Its small leaves season roast dishes, sauces and stews, and some varieties also work in fruit desserts.
definition.zh: 香气细致的烹饪香草，鲜叶或干叶都可用于调味，常见于烤肉、炖菜和酱汁。细小叶片也能为水果甜点增添草本气息；菜单中的 thyme 通常指香草本身而非某款酱汁。

sources.title: University of Delaware — Herbs and spices with foods

examples.en: The roast chicken is seasoned with thyme for a gentle herbal aroma.
examples.zh: 这道烤鸡用百里香调味，带有温和的草本香气。

definition.en: Bottling stage that initiates the second-fermentation process.
definition.zh: 基酒完成 assemblage 后加入 tirage mixture 并装瓶，进入瓶中二次发酵流程。

definition.en: A chilled layered dessert of coffee-soaked sponge fingers, mascarpone cream, and cocoa.
definition.zh: 将浸咖啡的手指饼与马斯卡彭乳酪糊分层冷藏，表面撒可可；蛋的处理方式和是否加酒因配方而异。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — Tiramisu by Sally Abé

examples.en: The tiramisu layers coffee-soaked sponge fingers with mascarpone cream and a dusting of cocoa.
examples.zh: 提拉米苏以浸过咖啡的手指饼和马斯卡彭乳酪糊分层，表面撒可可粉。

definition.en: Sausages baked in a risen, Yorkshire-pudding-style batter.
definition.zh: 将香肠放入鸡蛋、牛奶和面粉调成的面糊里烘烤，使面糊膨起并形成金黄边缘。这道英国菜的名字是俗称，主料不是蟾蜍；香肠种类和所配肉汁由餐厅决定。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Toad in the Hole

examples.en: Toad in the hole is baked sausages surrounded by a light, puffed batter.
examples.zh: 这道英式香肠烤布丁是在香肠周围烤出蓬松面糊层。

definition.en: As a group or in one combined action.
definition.zh: 一起或合在一起。在结账语境中 pay together 表示一起结账。

examples.en: Would you like to pay together?
examples.zh: 您要一起结账吗？

definition.en: Hollowed tomatoes filled with a savoury stuffing and baked; meat-based fillings are common.
definition.zh: 将番茄掏出部分果肉，填入调味馅料后烘烤，常用小牛肉、牛肉或猪肉，配香草、面包屑等。菜名只说明“酿番茄”，并不保证馅料是素食；服务时应补充具体肉类和配菜。

sources.title: Stephen Cooks French / Taste of France — Tomates farcies

examples.en: These baked tomatoes are filled with veal, herbs and breadcrumbs and served with rice.
examples.zh: 这些烤番茄填入小牛肉、香草和面包屑，搭配米饭供应。

zh: 卡普里巧克力杏仁蛋糕

definition.en: A rich chocolate-and-almond cake with a tender, moist centre; some recipes also include other ground nuts or a little starch.
definition.zh: 以巧克力、磨碎的杏仁、黄油、糖和鸡蛋制成的浓郁蛋糕，中心湿润，表层较薄。部分做法加入榛子或少量淀粉；这里的 Caprese 指这款甜点，与番茄、马苏里拉奶酪组成的卡普雷塞沙拉是不同菜品。

sources.title: Sal De Riso / GialloZafferano — Torta caprese

examples.en: The torta Caprese is a moist chocolate cake made with ground almonds.
examples.zh: 卡普里蛋糕是一款加入杏仁粉、口感湿润的巧克力蛋糕。

definition.en: Pasta parcels filled with pumpkin; the Mantuan style often adds amaretti, cheese and fruit mostarda.
definition.zh: 南瓜馅的意式面饺，曼托瓦风格常在馅内加入杏仁饼干、奶酪和带芥末辛香的水果蜜饯 mostarda，呈甜咸交织的风味。不同地区的南瓜馅配方会变化，不能把杏仁饼干或 mostarda 当成所有版本的必备。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — tortelli di zucca

examples.en: The pumpkin tortelli have a sweet-savoury filling and are finished with melted butter.
examples.zh: 这道南瓜意式饺的馅料带甜咸风味，最后淋上融化的黄油。

definition.en: Small filled pasta rings served in a clear broth, traditionally with a meat-based filling.
definition.zh: 小巧环形意式饺子在清汤中供应，常见馅料含猪肉、意式肉肠和火腿；肉馅组合与汤底须分别确认。

sources.title: Great Italian Chefs — Tortellini in Brodo by Valeria Necchio

examples.en: The tortellini are small filled pasta rings served in a clear, savoury broth.
examples.zh: 这些托尔泰利尼是小巧的环形馅面，盛在鲜味清汤中。

definition.en: A thick Spanish omelette made by gently cooking potatoes in olive oil, combining them with eggs, and setting the mixture in a pan. Onion is a common optional ingredient.
definition.zh: 厚实的西班牙蛋饼：土豆先在橄榄油中慢慢煎软，再拌入鸡蛋，放回平底锅煎至成形。常见版本加入洋葱，也有不加洋葱的做法。

examples.en: This Spanish omelette has tender potato slices held together with egg.
examples.zh: 这款西班牙蛋饼用鸡蛋包裹软嫩的土豆片。

definition.en: Central Loire wine area including Vouvray, Montlouis, Chinon and Bourgueil.
definition.zh: Touraine 既可指卢瓦尔中部较大的葡萄酒区域，也是一项 AOP 的名称。此处指区域，包含 Vouvray、Montlouis-sur-Loire、Chinon、Bourgueil 等；区域内除 Chenin Blanc、Cabernet Franc 外，也有重要的 Sauvignon Blanc 等品种。

definition.en: Beef fillet served on toast with foie gras, a rich sauce and, in the classical presentation, truffle.
definition.zh: 把菲力牛排放在烤面包或煎面包上，搭配肥肝、浓郁肉汁，经典呈现还会加入松露。常见酱汁以马德拉酒调味；服务介绍要说明所用肥肝、松露及酱汁，不能只把它译成普通牛排。

sources.title: Richard Turner / Great British Chefs — Tournedos Rossini

examples.en: The fillet is topped with foie gras and served on toast with a Madeira sauce.
examples.zh: 菲力牛排上放肥肝，以面包垫底，搭配马德拉酒酱汁。

definition.en: Sparkling-wine method in which the second fermentation occurs in the bottle later sold.
definition.zh: 二次发酵通常在最终销售的瓶中进行，之后酒泥熟成、转瓶、除渣，再按风格决定 dosage 并封瓶；Champagne、Cava、Franciacorta 是典型例子。零补糖酒并不省略二次发酵前的 tirage。

sources.title: WSET · A guide to sparkling wine production methods and regional styles

definition.en: Bottle-fermented sparkling method in which wine is transferred under pressure to tank for filtration and rebottling.
definition.zh: 先瓶中二次发酵，再加压转移至罐中统一过滤/调配后重新装瓶，省去逐瓶 riddling/disgorgement。

sources.title: WSET · Level 3 Award in Wines specification

definition.en: A pastry tart with a sweet golden-syrup filling thickened with breadcrumbs and brightened with lemon.
definition.zh: 在酥皮挞壳内填入金黄糖浆、面包屑和柠檬调成的馅，再烤至凝结。面包屑吸收糖浆，形成湿润而略有颗粒感的内馅；柠檬带来清香。菜名虽有 treacle，常见配方的主角是 golden syrup 金黄糖浆。

examples.en: The treacle tart has a sweet syrup filling with a little lemon.
examples.zh: 这款糖浆挞的内馅甜润，带一点柠檬香。

definition.en: Traditional-method sparkling wine from Trentino.
definition.zh: 山地传统法起泡酒；altitude、cool climate 和 long lees ageing 是核心。

sources.title: Istituto Trento DOC · Trentodoc styles and ageing

definition.en: Vintage Trentodoc with minimum 24 months lees ageing.
definition.zh: 官方最低酒泥熟成 24 个月。

sources.title: Istituto Trento DOC · Trentodoc styles and ageing

definition.en: Reserve Trentodoc with minimum 36 months lees ageing.
definition.zh: 官方最低酒泥熟成 36 个月。

sources.title: Istituto Trento DOC · Trentodoc styles and ageing

definition.en: Successive selective picking passes through a vineyard.
definition.zh: 甜酒生产中多次进园挑选达到合适成熟度或贵腐程度的葡萄；Loire sweet Chenin 关键术语。

zh: 英式水果奶油分层甜点

definition.en: A layered dessert of sponge cake, fruit, custard and whipped cream.
definition.zh: 将海绵蛋糕、水果、卡仕达蛋奶酱和打发奶油分层装入碗或杯中，冷藏后舀着吃。蛋糕可浸雪莉酒或果汁，水果层也可做成凝冻。辨认这道甜点的关键是能同时吃到蛋糕、果香和奶油蛋奶酱的层次。

sources.title: GBC Kitchen / Great British Chefs — Strawberry Trifle

examples.en: The trifle has layers of sponge cake, strawberries, custard and whipped cream.
examples.zh: 这份分层甜点有海绵蛋糕、草莓、蛋奶酱和打发奶油。

zh: 罗马式番茄薄荷炖牛肚

definition.en: Beef tripe cooked in tomato sauce with aromatic vegetables, mint and grated Pecorino Romano.
definition.zh: 将处理好的牛肚与番茄、洋葱、芹菜等慢煮，最后用薄荷与佩科里诺罗马羊奶酪增香。牛肚是牛的胃部，煮好后柔软而保留弹性；薄荷的清香是介绍这道罗马菜时很有辨识度的细节。

examples.en: The tripe is slow-cooked with tomato, then finished with mint and Pecorino Romano.
examples.zh: 牛肚与番茄慢煮，最后加入薄荷和佩科里诺罗马羊奶酪。

definition.en: Short twisted trofie pasta dressed with basil pesto; potatoes and green beans are familiar additions.
definition.zh: Trofie 是短小、扭转的意面，表面容易裹住以罗勒、松子、蒜、橄榄油和奶酪制成的青酱。常见搭配还包括土豆和四季豆，入口兼有草本香气与柔润口感。

examples.en: Our trofie comes with basil pesto, potatoes and green beans.
examples.zh: 我们的扭面配罗勒青酱、土豆和四季豆。

definition.en: An aromatic edible fungus that grows underground, often shaved over dishes in small amounts.
definition.zh: 地下生长、香气鲜明的食用真菌，常刨薄片作为点缀；菜单中应区分鲜松露、松露制品与松露巧克力。

examples.en: Would you like freshly shaved truffle on your pasta?
examples.zh: 您需要在意面上加现刨松露片吗？

definition.en: Trout served with toasted almonds and butter, commonly pan-fried and finished with lemon.
definition.zh: 鳟鱼经煎制等方式烹调后，配烘香的杏仁片与黄油，常以柠檬平衡油润口感。英文菜单也常写 trout amandine 或 trout almondine；鱼可整条或鱼柳供应，服务时应说明实际呈现。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — How to cook trout
RICARDO — Trout with Brown Butter and Almonds

examples.en: The trout comes with toasted almonds and brown butter, with lemon on the side.
examples.zh: 这道鳟鱼配烘香杏仁片和焦化黄油，旁边附柠檬。

definition.en: Soft porous chalky limestone widespread in Saumur and Touraine.
definition.zh: Saumur 与 Touraine 常见的柔软、多孔石灰岩，也是当地建筑与岩凿酒窖的重要岩石；地质背景应与实际土层、坡位一起理解。

sources.title: InterLoire · Climate and geology of Loire wines

definition.en: A cool yogurt dip mixed with grated cucumber, garlic and olive oil.
definition.zh: 浓稠酸奶拌入沥水黄瓜碎、蒜与橄榄油，常以醋调酸，也可加莳萝。可作为小食蘸酱或烤肉配酱；名字不是单指酸奶。

sources.title: Chef Akis Petretzikis — Greek tzatziki sauce

examples.en: The tzatziki is a cool, garlicky yogurt dip with grated cucumber.
examples.zh: 这份 tzatziki 是清凉的黄瓜酸奶蘸酱，带有蒜香。

definition.en: The savoury basic taste associated with glutamate, distinct from sweetness, sourness, saltiness and bitterness.
definition.zh: 一种独立于甜、酸、咸、苦的基本味觉，常与食物中的谷氨酸相关。介绍高汤、熟成奶酪等时，可用它说明鲜味深度；鲜味强并不等于咸度高。

sources.title: Great British Chefs — Comté cheese guide

examples.en: The aged cheese adds extra umami to the sauce.
examples.zh: 熟成奶酪为这款酱汁增加了鲜味。

definition.en: Major Champagne subregion along the Marne Valley.
definition.zh: 沿 Marne 河谷展开的 Champagne 主要子区；东部更常见 Pinot Noir，西部 Meunier 尤为重要，地质和品种分布会随具体村庄变化。

sources.title: Comité Champagne · Champagne and its soil

definition.en: Potent sulfur-containing aroma compounds released from non-aromatic precursors during fermentation.
definition.zh: 部分葡萄中以无香前体形式存在，经酵母转化释放，可产生百香果、葡萄柚、黑醋栗芽等强烈香气。

sources.title: UC Davis Waterhouse Lab — Volatile thiols

definition.en: Vin Doux Naturel, a French category of fortified sweet wine.
definition.zh: 法国天然甜葡萄酒体系，典型逻辑是在发酵过程中加烈止酵，从而保留葡萄本身糖分。

sources.title: INAO — Muscat de Frontignan, vin doux naturel and mutage

definition.en: A smooth sauce made from a light stock thickened with a pale roux.
definition.zh: 以浅色高汤和浅色面粉糊制成的基础酱汁，高汤可来自鸡、鱼或小牛；名称本身不代表素食。

sources.title: Escoffier — How to Make the 5 Mother Sauces

examples.en: Let me confirm which stock the kitchen uses in the velouté.
examples.zh: 我为您确认一下厨房这款维鲁特酱用的是什么高汤。

definition.en: Exceptionally smooth in the mouth, suggesting the soft feel of velvet; often used for soups, sauces and purées.
definition.zh: 入口细腻、柔滑，借天鹅绒的触感形容浓汤、酱汁或泥状配菜。与 silky 的丝滑含义接近，并没有严格的浓稠度界线；它本身不说明是否加入奶油。

examples.en: The cauliflower soup is blended until velvety and finished with chives.
examples.zh: 这款花椰菜汤搅打得柔滑细腻，最后撒上细香葱。

definition.en: The onset of grape ripening when berries soften and change color.
definition.zh: 葡萄进入成熟阶段的重要物候点，浆果开始软化、红葡萄着色，糖上升而酸度与部分青味物质逐渐下降。

sources.title: New Mexico State University — Grapevine Growth and Phenology

definition.en: French for green. Aligoté Vert is a type of Aligoté, contrasted with Aligoté Doré; the descriptor is not a separate variety name.
definition.zh: 法语意为“绿色的”。Aligoté Vert 为 Aligoté 的品种内类型，常与 Aligoté Doré 对举；该描述词不是独立品种名称。

definition.en: A smooth chilled soup made with leeks and potatoes and enriched with cream or a similar dairy ingredient.
definition.zh: 以韭葱和土豆煮熟打细，再加入奶油或类似乳制品，冷却后供应的浓汤。学习重点是 chilled：它的冷食方式是菜品特色；汤底与乳制品可随餐厅配方改变。

examples.en: The vichyssoise is served chilled, with a smooth leek and potato base.
examples.zh: 这道维希冷汤以韭葱和土豆为基底，口感细滑，冷食供应。

definition.en: Burgundy communal appellation level, within which designated climats may qualify as Premier Cru.
definition.zh: 勃艮第的村庄级 appellation，通常以村庄或 commune 命名；同一 Village AOC 内可以有获准标注 Premier Cru 的 climat。Premier Cru 是村庄 AOC 内的规定称号，不是与 Village AOC 完全并列的独立 AOC。

definition.en: Still base wine used for Champagne blending before tirage.
definition.zh: 在 Champagne 语境中，指二次发酵前用于 assemblage 的静态基酒；品种、村庄和年份不同的 vins clairs 可分别品尝后再调配。

definition.en: A dressing combining oil and vinegar, often with seasoning, herbs, or mustard.
definition.zh: 将油和醋混合并调味的沙拉汁，可加入香草或芥末；口味和额外原料因餐厅配方而不同。

examples.en: Would you prefer the vinaigrette on the salad or on the side?
examples.zh: 您希望油醋汁拌入沙拉，还是另外盛放？

definition.en: The processes that turn grapes or must into wine.
definition.zh: 把葡萄或葡萄醪转化为葡萄酒的一系列工艺；按酒型可涉及压榨、发酵、浸渍、熟成、澄清、过滤与装瓶。并非每款酒都会采用全部步骤。

sources.title: OIV — International Code of Oenological Practices, product definitions and practices

definition.en: In wine, the harvest year of the grapes used to make it.
definition.zh: 葡萄酒语境通常指葡萄采收的年份，并非装瓶年份。酒标年份使用比例须遵守当地规则。

examples.en: Which vintage would you like?
examples.zh: 您想要哪个年份？

definition.en: Champagne declared from a single vintage and aged for a longer legal minimum.
definition.zh: 以单一年份收成酿制、标示该年份的香槟；法规要求上市前最低熟成 36 个月。单一年份不等于单一葡萄品种、单一村庄或单一葡萄园。

sources.title: Comité Champagne · Understanding the Champagne label

definition.en: A chilled Italian dish of thinly sliced veal served with a savoury tuna-based sauce.
definition.zh: 冷切小牛肉配金枪鱼风味酱汁的意大利菜，常见酱汁还含酸豆或鳀鱼；虽然主体是肉，也可能含鱼类原料。

examples.en: Vitello tonnato is chilled veal with a tuna-based sauce.
examples.zh: 这道菜是冷切小牛肉，配以金枪鱼为基础的酱汁。

definition.en: Grape growing and vineyard management.
definition.zh: 葡萄栽培与葡萄园管理，可用于酿酒葡萄、鲜食葡萄等用途。本课程重点为酿酒葡萄，涵盖选址、整枝、冠层、水分、产量、病虫害与采收。

sources.title: Penn State Extension — Wine Grape Production
Penn State Extension — Backyard grape growing

definition.en: The cultivated grape species to which Aligoté and many other wine-grape varieties belong. Species and cultivar are different taxonomic levels.
definition.zh: Aligoté 及许多酿酒葡萄品种所属的葡萄物种。“物种”与“栽培品种”不是同一分类层级。

sources.title: Oregon State University — Grape phylloxera biology and management
Penn State Extension — Backyard grape growing

definition.en: Côte de Beaune village appellation focused on Pinot Noir.
definition.zh: 伯恩丘重要红酒村，常作为更细致芳香型 Pinot Noir 的 comparative anchor。

definition.en: Côte de Nuits village containing some of Burgundy's most famous Grand Crus.
definition.zh: 夜丘村庄及同名村庄级 AOC；村内还有 Romanée-Conti、La Tâche、Richebourg、Romanée-Saint-Vivant 等独立 Grand Cru AOC。

definition.en: Chenin Blanc appellation in Touraine producing still and sparkling wines across sweetness levels.
definition.zh: 100% Chenin Blanc 核心产区，可 dry / off-dry / sweet / sparkling；年份对甜度和风格影响明显。

sources.title: Syndicat des Vignerons de Vouvray · The four expressions of Chenin Blanc

definition.en: Vertical Shoot Positioning, a trellis system that trains shoots upward.
definition.zh: 常见棚架与冠层训练方式，把新梢向上定位，便于形成较规则的叶幕和果实区。

sources.title: University of Minnesota Extension — Trellises for grapes

definition.en: An apple-and-celery salad with a creamy dressing, often including walnuts and grapes.
definition.zh: 以苹果、西芹和柔滑酱汁为核心的沙拉。原始配方用蛋黄酱，核桃及葡萄是后来常见的加入方式；当代餐厅也会改用其他酱汁，不能把某一版本当成唯一配方。

sources.title: Hilton — Cooking with Chris: Waldorf Salad

examples.en: Our Waldorf salad combines crisp apple and celery with walnuts in a creamy dressing.
examples.zh: 我们的华尔道夫沙拉把爽脆苹果、西芹和核桃拌入柔滑酱汁。

definition.en: The ability of soil to retain water; only part of that water is available to plant roots.
definition.zh: 土壤保留水分的能力；根系可利用水量还取决于土壤对水的吸持强度、结构及根系分布。保水与排水并非简单对立，二者共同影响葡萄藤水分状态。

sources.title: Oregon State University Extension — Soil-plant-water relationships

zh: 比利时奶油蔬菜炖鸡或鱼

definition.en: A Belgian stew of chicken or fish gently cooked with vegetables in broth, then finished with a creamy sauce, often using cream and egg yolk.
definition.zh: 比利时炖菜，将鸡肉或鱼与胡萝卜、韭葱、西芹等蔬菜在高汤中煮熟，再将汤汁调成浓滑酱汁，常用奶油和蛋黄增添质感。

sources.title: Visit Brussels — Waterzooi and its fish and chicken versions

examples.en: Waterzooi is a gentle, creamy stew; this version is made with chicken and vegetables.
examples.zh: 瓦特佐伊是一道柔和浓滑的炖菜，这个版本使用鸡肉和蔬菜。

definition.en: Toast topped with a seasoned cheese mixture and grilled until browned.
definition.zh: 把调味奶酪糊铺在吐司上烤至融化上色，常用啤酒、芥末或伍斯特酱增味。它是一道奶酪吐司菜肴；rarebit 不能按发音误解成兔肉，具体调味仍须看配方。

examples.en: The Welsh rarebit is toast with a savoury melted-cheese topping.
examples.zh: 威尔士奶酪烤吐司是在吐司上铺咸香奶酪料烤制而成。

definition.en: Loire terroir concept for pale chalky limestone influenced by the Paris Basin.
