definition.zh: 与 Black Anjou 对照，主要指 chalky limestone / tuffeau-influenced geology。

sources.title: InterLoire · Climate and geology of Loire wines

definition.en: Pressing intact grape bunches, with their stems, to obtain juice before fermentation. It is a different operation from fermenting whole bunches.
definition.zh: 将保留果梗的完整葡萄串压榨取汁，再进行发酵；与整串葡萄直接参与发酵是不同操作。

definition.en: Viennese beef goulash slowly cooked with plenty of onions and sweet paprika.
definition.zh: 维也纳式浓汁炖牛肉，以牛腱等肉块、大量洋葱和甜红椒粉慢炖。洋葱煮软后融入酱汁，带来浓厚口感，常配面包或土豆；这里指奥地利的浓汁做法，并非所有 goulash 的统称。

examples.en: Our Viennese goulash is slow-cooked beef in a rich onion and paprika sauce.
examples.zh: 我们的维也纳炖牛肉以洋葱和红椒粉慢炖，酱汁浓厚。

definition.en: A thin veal cutlet coated in flour, egg and breadcrumbs, then pan-fried until golden. Lemon is a common garnish.
definition.zh: 将小牛肉片拍薄，依次裹面粉、蛋液和面包糠，再用平底锅煎炸至金黄。常配柠檬上桌；传统名称 Wiener Schnitzel 特指小牛肉版本。

examples.en: This is a thin veal cutlet with a light, crisp breadcrumb coating.
examples.zh: 这是一片拍薄的小牛排，外裹轻盈酥脆的面包糠。

definition.en: Traditional-method Sekt b.A. made from the grower’s own grapes and labelled with vintage and variety.
definition.zh: 德国酒农以自种葡萄酿制的传统法 Sekt b.A.，标签需标示年份和品种；允许委托专业酒厂完成起泡工序，因此不能简单理解为全部工序必须在自家酒庄进行。

en: Would you like a few more minutes?

definition.en: An offer to give a guest more time to decide.
definition.zh: 客人还在看菜单时，主动给对方更多决定时间。Would you like 后可接名词；这里的 more 表示在已经给出的时间上再增加一些。

sources.title: Cambridge Dictionary · Would: requests and offers
British Council · English for the World of Work: Tourism / Catering Services

examples.en: Would you like a few more minutes? I can come back after I bring your water.
examples.zh: 您需要再看几分钟吗？我给您送水后再回来。

definition.en: An offer of further food, drink or assistance.
definition.zh: 一轮服务完成后询问是否还需要其他东西。anything else 表示除此之外还有什么；可结合场景补充 dessert、coffee 或其他实际可提供的选项。

sources.title: British Council · Requests, offers and invitations
British Council · Ordering in a café

examples.en: Would you like anything else before I bring the dessert menu?
examples.zh: 在我拿甜品菜单之前，您还需要别的吗？

en: Would you like me to replace it?

definition.en: An offer to replace an unsatisfactory or incorrect item.
definition.zh: Would you like me to 后接动词原形，用来询问客人是否希望由你执行某个动作。replace it 是换掉目前这份，不等于自行承诺退款或免单。

sources.title: Cambridge Dictionary · Would: requests and offers
British Council · A response to a complaint

examples.en: Would you like me to replace it with a fresh portion? I can check the waiting time first.
examples.zh: 您希望我为您换一份新的吗？我可以先确认需要等多久。

en: Would you like that as a starter?
zh: 您想把这道作为前菜吗？

definition.en: A question about serving a chosen dish as the first course.
definition.zh: 确认一道菜是否安排在前菜阶段。as a starter 说明用餐中的角色，不自动表示餐厅一定可以改变分量或价格。

sources.title: British Council · Requests, offers and invitations
British Council · English for the World of Work: Tourism / Catering Services

examples.en: Would you like that as a starter, before your fish?
examples.zh: 您想把这道作为前菜，在鱼主菜之前上吗？

definition.en: A question about whether diners want to share the food.
definition.zh: 询问多人是否想共享一道或几道菜。Would you like to 后接动词原形；需要时进一步确认是否另配餐盘。

sources.title: British Council · Requests, offers and invitations
British Council · Ordering in a café

examples.en: Would you like to share? I can bring two extra plates.
examples.zh: 您几位想一起分享吗？我可以再拿两个餐盘。

en: Would you mind waiting a little longer?

definition.en: A considerate request for some additional waiting time.
definition.zh: would you mind 后接动词 -ing，因此是 waiting。字面在问“是否介意”；回答 No, not at all 通常表示愿意等，不能把 yes/no 机械对应成同意或拒绝。

sources.title: Cambridge Dictionary · Would: requests and offers
British Council · How to be polite in English

examples.en: Would you mind waiting a little longer while I get an accurate update from the kitchen?
examples.zh: 我去向厨房确认准确进度，您介意再等一会儿吗？

en: Would you prefer still or sparkling water?
zh: 您想要无气水还是气泡水？

definition.en: A question offering a choice of water styles.
definition.zh: 提供两种水供客人选择。still water 是无气水，sparkling water 是气泡水；在收费水服务中，还应说明品牌、容量及价格。

sources.title: Cambridge Dictionary · Would: requests and offers
British Council · Ordering in a café

examples.en: Would you prefer still or sparkling water? We have both in small bottles.
examples.zh: 您想要无气水还是气泡水？我们两种都有小瓶装。

definition.en: Key indigenous Catalan white grape important in Cava and Penedès sparkling wines.
definition.zh: Cava/Corpinnat 的核心本土品种之一，常带来酸度、结构、草本与陈年潜力。

definition.en: A savoury baked batter made from eggs, flour and milk, poured into hot fat so it rises with crisp edges. It is commonly served alongside a roast.
definition.zh: 将鸡蛋、面粉和牛奶调成面糊，倒入预热油脂的烤模中烤至膨起，形成酥脆边缘，常配烤肉供应。虽然名称有 pudding，但这里不是甜味奶冻。

examples.en: The Yorkshire pudding is a light, crisp baked batter served with the roast.
examples.zh: 约克郡布丁由面糊烤制，轻盈酥脆，与烤肉一起供应。

zh: 意式酒香蛋黄泡沫甜点

definition.en: An airy custard made by whisking egg yolks, sugar and wine over gentle heat, often using Marsala.
definition.zh: 把蛋黄、糖和葡萄酒隔水轻柔加热并不断打发，形成蓬松细腻的甜点或甜酱，常用马沙拉酒。可单独装杯或配水果；服务时应说明用酒，不应把加热视为无酒精保证。

examples.en: The zabaglione is a light egg-yolk dessert made with Marsala wine.
examples.zh: 这道甜点是用蛋黄打发制成的，口感轻盈，加入了马沙拉酒。

definition.en: Full of lively flavour; often used for bright citrus or assertively seasoned sauces, without necessarily meaning chilli heat.
definition.zh: 形容味道鲜明、有活力，常见于柑橘风味或调味鲜明的酱汁。虽然常与柠檬等搭配，但并不专指加了果皮，也不能只凭这个词判断菜品是否辣口。

examples.en: The fish comes with a zesty lemon and herb dressing.
examples.zh: 这份鱼配风味鲜明的柠檬香草汁。

definition.en: Thin veal strips in a creamy mushroom sauce, commonly served with rösti.
definition.zh: 苏黎世风味小牛肉条，短时煎炒后与蘑菇、奶油及常见的白葡萄酒酱汁结合，通常配瑞士土豆丝饼。Geschnetzeltes 单独只说明切条肉菜，不能把所有切条肉都当作苏黎世版本。

sources.title: Switzerland Tourism — This Is Swiss Cuisine

examples.en: The Zurich-style veal is served in a creamy mushroom sauce with rösti.
examples.zh: 苏黎世风味小牛肉配奶油蘑菇酱和瑞士土豆丝饼。
